```{r}
# =========================================================
# FOUNDATION.R
# - Build core derived objects from rawdata_* files
# - Save key figures as PNG and SVG
# - Save selected derived tables for supplementary use
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(sf)
  library(showtext)
  library(sysfonts)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(rnaturalearth)
  library(rnaturalearthdata)
  library(geodist)
  library(cluster)
  library(svglite)
  library(grid)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Global settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!"noto" %in% sysfonts::font_families()) {
  sysfonts::font_add_google("Noto Sans KR", "noto")
}

# Use showtext for screen/PNG output only
showtext_auto(TRUE)

base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "noto") +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text     = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title  = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text   = element_text(size = 14)
  )

clu_pal <- c(
  "1" = "#4E79A7",
  "2" = "#E15759",
  "3" = "#59A14F",
  "4" = "#B07AA1"
)

pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  n <- tolower(names(df))
  i <- match(tolower(candidates), n)
  i <- i[!is.na(i)]
  if (length(i)) return(names(df)[i[1]])

  j <- which(Reduce(`|`, lapply(tolower(candidates), function(x) grepl(x, n, fixed = TRUE))))
  if (length(j)) return(names(df)[j[1]])

  NA_character_
}

norm_name <- function(x) {
  str_squish(str_trim(as.character(x)))
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot, filename_base, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300,
                           bg = "white") {
  # PNG: use showtext
  showtext_auto(TRUE)
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(filename_base, ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = bg
  )

  # SVG: disable showtext and write through svglite directly
  showtext_auto(FALSE)
  svglite::svglite(
    file = paste0(filename_base, ".svg"),
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = bg,
    fix_text_size = FALSE,
    system_fonts = list(
      sans  = "Arial",
      serif = "Times New Roman",
      mono  = "Courier New"
    )
  )
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  showtext_auto(TRUE)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Load raw data
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("rawdata_metadata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    village_name_norm = norm_name(village_name)
  )

df_vil_coord <- read_csv("rawdata_village coord.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
asv_raw <- read_csv("rawdata_asv level.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Build village table
#    - vil_id assigned by longitude ASC, then latitude, then label
#    - vil_n obtained from metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vil_n_tbl <- meta %>%
  count(village_name_norm, name = "vil_n")

lat_col <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("latitude", "lat"))
lon_col <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("longitude", "lon", "long"))
lab_col <- pick_col(df_vil_coord, c("village_name", "village", "name"))

if (is.na(lat_col) || is.na(lon_col)) {
  stop("Latitude/longitude columns were not found in rawdata_village coord.csv.")
}
if (is.na(lab_col)) {
  lab_col <- names(df_vil_coord)[1]
}

vil_tbl <- df_vil_coord %>%
  rename(lat = !!lat_col, lon = !!lon_col, label = !!lab_col) %>%
  mutate(
    lat = as.numeric(lat),
    lon = as.numeric(lon),
    label = as.character(label),
    label_norm = norm_name(label)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon)) %>%
  arrange(lon, lat, label) %>%
  mutate(vil_id = sprintf("V%02d", row_number())) %>%
  left_join(vil_n_tbl, by = c("label_norm" = "village_name_norm")) %>%
  mutate(
    vil_n   = as.integer(vil_n),
    vil_lab = sprintf("%s (n=%s)", vil_id, ifelse(is.na(vil_n), "NA", vil_n))
  )

pts <- vil_tbl %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Build ASV objects
#    - asv_tax   : ASV-to-taxonomy table
#    - asv_abund : abundance matrix
#    - asv_pa    : presence/absence matrix using 0.001 threshold
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_cols <- grep("^S\\d{4}$", names(asv_raw), value = TRUE)
if (length(sample_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No sample columns matching the S0001 format were found.")
}
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "Taxon") %in% names(asv_raw)))

asv_tax <- asv_raw %>%
  select(ASV, Taxon) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(ASV)

asv_abund <- asv_raw %>%
  select(ASV, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(sample_cols), as.numeric)) %>%
  arrange(ASV)

asv_pa <- asv_abund %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ as.integer(. >= 0.001)))

stopifnot(identical(asv_tax$ASV, asv_abund$ASV))
stopifnot(identical(asv_abund$ASV, asv_pa$ASV))

# Derived tables for reproducibility / supplementary support
write_csv(vil_tbl,   "derived_village_table.csv")
write_csv(meta,      "derived_meta_norm.csv")
write_csv(asv_tax,   "derived_asv_tax.csv")
write_csv(asv_abund, "derived_asv_abund.csv")
write_csv(asv_pa,    "derived_asv_pa.csv")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Base map layers and location figures
# ---------------------------------------------------------
kr_land  <- ne_countries(scale = "large", country = "South Korea", returnclass = "sf")
kr_coast <- ne_coastline(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")

st_kr <- ne_states(country = "South Korea", returnclass = "sf")
jeolla <- st_kr %>%
  filter(
    grepl("Jeollabuk|North Jeolla|Jeonbuk", name, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("Jeollanam|South Jeolla|Jeonnam", name, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )

pts_in <- pts[st_within(pts, st_union(jeolla), sparse = FALSE)[, 1], ]

p_nation <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = kr_land, fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = kr_coast, color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(
    data = pts,
    shape = 21, size = 3,
    fill = "#1f78b4", color = "white", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(124, 132), ylim = c(33, 39), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Village locations in South Korea",
    x = "Longitude (°E)",
    y = "Latitude (°N)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eaf3ff", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90")
  )

print(p_nation)
save_plot_both(p_nation, "village_map_nation_highres", width = 8, height = 6)

p_jeolla <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = kr_land, fill = "grey95", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = jeolla, fill = NA, color = "#999999", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(
    data = pts,
    shape = 21, size = 3,
    fill = "#1f78b4", color = "white", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = pts_in,
    aes(label = vil_lab, geometry = geometry),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 10,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.size = 0.25,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.alpha = 0.6,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(126, 128.2), ylim = c(34.5, 35.5), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Village locations in Jeolla Province",
    x = "Longitude (°E)",
    y = "Latitude (°N)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eaf3ff", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90")
  )

print(p_jeolla)
save_plot_both(p_jeolla, "village_map_Jeolla_highres_zoom_with_labels", width = 8, height = 6)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Village clustering using Haversine distance and PAM
#    - Cluster labels assigned from west to east
# ---------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(2025)
user_k <- 4
best_k <- as.integer(user_k)

coords <- pts %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(lon, lat)

D_km <- geodist::geodist(coords, measure = "haversine") / 1000
D_km <- as.dist(D_km)

pam_fit <- pam(D_km, k = best_k, diss = TRUE)
cluster_new <- as.character(pam_fit$clustering)

cent <- pts %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(cluster_new = cluster_new) %>%
  group_by(cluster_new) %>%
  summarise(
    cen_lon = mean(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    cen_lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(cen_lon) %>%
  mutate(cluster = sprintf("%d", row_number()))

map_new_to_ordered <- setNames(cent$cluster, cent$cluster_new)

pts_cluster <- pts %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_new = factor(cluster_new, levels = cent$cluster_new),
    cluster     = factor(map_new_to_ordered[cluster_new], levels = as.character(1:best_k))
  )

p_map_hi <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = kr_land, fill = "grey95", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = kr_coast, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = jeolla, fill = NA, color = "#999999", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(
    data = pts_cluster,
    aes(fill = cluster),
    shape = 21, size = 3.5,
    color = "white", stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(126, 127.8), ylim = c(34.5, 35.5), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Cluster") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Village clusters in Jeolla Province (Haversine + PAM, k=%d)", best_k),
    x = "Longitude (°E)",
    y = "Latitude (°N)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#eaf3ff", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

print(p_map_hi)
save_plot_both(p_map_hi, sprintf("village_clusters_Jeolla_highres_k%d", best_k), width = 8, height = 6)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Merge cluster assignment into metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vil_map <- pts_cluster %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    village_name = as.character(label),
    village_name_norm = norm_name(label),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    cluster = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  distinct(village_name_norm, .keep_all = TRUE)

merged <- meta %>%
  left_join(
    vil_map %>% select(village_name_norm, vil_id, cluster),
    by = "village_name_norm"
  ) %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = names(clu_pal)))

miss_vil <- merged %>%
  filter(is.na(cluster)) %>%
  distinct(village_name)

if (nrow(miss_vil) > 0) {
  message(
    "Unmatched villages after normalization: ",
    paste(miss_vil$village_name, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

tbl_village <- merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
  count(village_name, vil_id, cluster, name = "n_samples") %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(n_samples))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Sample count plots and summary tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
v_cnt_all <- tbl_village %>%
  mutate(vil_index = row_number())

p_bar_all <- ggplot(v_cnt_all, aes(x = vil_index, y = n_samples, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Cluster") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of sample counts by village",
    x = "Village order (sorted index)",
    y = "Number of samples"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines"))

print(p_bar_all)
save_plot_both(p_bar_all, "bar_samples_per_village_indexed", width = 8, height = 6)

tbl_cluster <- tbl_village %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_villages     = n(),
    total_samples  = sum(n_samples),
    mean_samples   = mean(n_samples),
    sd_samples     = sd(n_samples),
    min_samples    = min(n_samples),
    max_samples    = max(n_samples),
    median_samples = median(n_samples),
    IQR_samples    = IQR(n_samples),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tbl_overall <- tibble(
  total_villages   = nrow(tbl_village),
  total_samples    = sum(tbl_village$n_samples),
  mean_per_village = mean(tbl_village$n_samples),
  sd_per_village   = sd(tbl_village$n_samples),
  min_per_village  = min(tbl_village$n_samples),
  max_per_village  = max(tbl_village$n_samples)
)

cat("\nOverall summary\n")
print(tbl_overall)

cat("\nCluster-wise summary\n")
print(tbl_cluster)

cat("\nTop 10 villages by sample count\n")
print(head(tbl_village, 10))

write_csv(vil_map,      "derived_village_cluster_map.csv")
write_csv(merged,       "derived_meta_with_cluster.csv")
write_csv(tbl_village,  "supplementary_sample_count_by_village.csv")
write_csv(tbl_cluster,  "supplementary_sample_count_by_cluster.csv")
write_csv(tbl_overall,  "supplementary_sample_count_overall.csv")

p_box <- ggplot(tbl_village, aes(x = cluster, y = n_samples, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Sample counts per village by cluster",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Number of samples"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_box)
save_plot_both(p_box, "box_samples_per_village_by_cluster", width = 8, height = 6)

v_cnt_clu <- tbl_village %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_samples), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(vil_index = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

p_bar_facet <- ggplot(v_cnt_clu, aes(x = vil_index, y = n_samples, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~cluster, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of village sample counts by cluster",
    x = "Village order within cluster",
    y = "Number of samples"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_bar_facet)
save_plot_both(p_bar_facet, "bar_samples_per_village_by_cluster_facet", width = 12, height = 6)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(vegan)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

# =========================================================
# Pairwise Jaccard similarity (sample-sample) using ASV P/A
# - required inputs from FOUNDATION: merged, asv_pa
# - output objects:
#     pa_mat, pw_anno,
#     vill_summary, clu_summary,
#     vill_pair, clu_pair,
#     wilcox_village, wilcox_cluster
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("merged"), exists("asv_pa"))
stopifnot("ASV" %in% names(asv_pa))
stopifnot("sampleid" %in% names(merged))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Keep only shared samples
# ---------------------------------------------------------
all_samples <- intersect(as.character(merged$sampleid), setdiff(names(asv_pa), "ASV"))
if (length(all_samples) == 0) {
  stop("No shared samples were found between merged$sampleid and asv_pa sample columns.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Build sample x ASV matrix
#    - rows: samples
#    - columns: ASVs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pa_mat <- asv_pa %>%
  select(ASV, all_of(all_samples)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ASV") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t()

# Defensive NA handling
pa_mat[is.na(pa_mat)] <- 0L
ids <- rownames(pa_mat)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1B) Remove all-zero samples to avoid NaN in Jaccard
# ---------------------------------------------------------
nz_mask <- rowSums(pa_mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
if (any(!nz_mask)) {
  message("Removing all-zero samples: ", paste(ids[!nz_mask], collapse = ", "))
}

pa_mat <- pa_mat[nz_mask, , drop = FALSE]
ids <- rownames(pa_mat)

if (nrow(pa_mat) < 2) {
  stop("Fewer than two valid samples remain after removing all-zero samples.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Compute Jaccard distance and similarity
# ---------------------------------------------------------
dist_jac <- vegdist(pa_mat, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

dist_to_long <- function(d, ids) {
  m <- as.matrix(d)
  ut <- which(upper.tri(m), arr.ind = TRUE)

  tibble(
    sample1 = ids[ut[, 1]],
    sample2 = ids[ut[, 2]],
    jaccard_dist = m[ut],
    jaccard_sim  = 1 - m[ut]
  )
}

pw <- dist_to_long(dist_jac, ids)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Annotate pairwise table with metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_min_pw <- merged %>%
  select(sampleid, village_name, cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    village_name = as.character(village_name)
  )

pw_anno <- pw %>%
  left_join(meta_min_pw, by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")) %>%
  rename(vil1 = village_name, clu1 = cluster) %>%
  left_join(meta_min_pw, by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")) %>%
  rename(vil2 = village_name, clu2 = cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    same_village = vil1 == vil2,
    same_cluster = clu1 == clu2
  )

if (any(is.na(pw_anno$vil1)) || any(is.na(pw_anno$vil2))) {
  warning("Missing village_name values were detected in the pairwise annotation table.")
}
if (any(is.na(pw_anno$clu1)) || any(is.na(pw_anno$clu2))) {
  warning("Missing cluster values were detected in the pairwise annotation table.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4A) Same-village vs different-village summary and test
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vill_summary <- pw_anno %>%
  group_by(same_village) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sim = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sim   = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    n        = n(),
    se_sim   = sd_sim / sqrt(n),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

wilcox_village <- wilcox.test(jaccard_sim ~ same_village, data = pw_anno)

print(vill_summary)
print(wilcox_village)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4B) Same-cluster vs different-cluster summary and test
# ---------------------------------------------------------
clu_summary <- pw_anno %>%
  group_by(same_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sim = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sim   = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    n        = n(),
    se_sim   = sd_sim / sqrt(n),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

wilcox_cluster <- wilcox.test(jaccard_sim ~ same_cluster, data = pw_anno)

print(clu_summary)
print(wilcox_cluster)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4C) Mean similarity by village pair and cluster pair
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vill_pair <- pw_anno %>%
  mutate(
    vil1  = as.character(vil1),
    vil2  = as.character(vil2),
    vpair = paste(pmin(vil1, vil2), pmax(vil1, vil2), sep = " vs ")
  ) %>%
  group_by(vpair) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sim = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_sim))

clu_pair <- pw_anno %>%
  mutate(
    clu1  = as.character(clu1),
    clu2  = as.character(clu2),
    cpair = paste(pmin(clu1, clu2), pmax(clu1, clu2), sep = " vs ")
  ) %>%
  group_by(cpair) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sim = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_sim))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Export tables
# - derived: large intermediate table for reproducibility
# - supplementary: compact summary/statistics tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(pw_anno,      "derived_pairwise_jaccard_annot.csv")
write_csv(vill_summary, "supplementary_jaccard_summary_same_village.csv")
write_csv(clu_summary,  "supplementary_jaccard_summary_same_cluster.csv")
write_csv(vill_pair,    "supplementary_jaccard_mean_by_village_pair.csv")
write_csv(clu_pair,     "supplementary_jaccard_mean_by_cluster_pair.csv")

write_csv(
  tibble(
    test = c("same_village", "same_cluster"),
    statistic = c(unname(wilcox_village$statistic), unname(wilcox_cluster$statistic)),
    p_value   = c(wilcox_village$p.value, wilcox_cluster$p.value)
  ),
  "supplementary_jaccard_wilcox_results.csv"
)
```

#Regression analysis
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(fixest)
  library(broom)
  library(forcats)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
})

# =========================================================
# Standalone regression analysis
# - reads metadata_ver2.csv
# - rebuilds pairwise joined dataset (pw2)
# - runs:
#     1) Base model
#     2) Full multivariable model
# - outcome: logit-transformed pairwise Jaccard similarity
# - SE clustered on sample1 and sample2
# - BH(FDR) applied to disease-related terms in full model
# - FDR-significant disease terms shown in red in plots
# - pair counts added for disease pair terms
#
# Required object in environment:
#   pw_anno
#
# Required columns in pw_anno:
#   sample1, sample2, jaccard_sim
#
# Required file:
#   metadata_ver2.csv
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) checks and output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("pw_anno"))

OUTDIR <- "regression analysis"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "supplementary"), showWarnings = FALSE)

meta_path <- "metadata_ver2.csv"
stopifnot(file.exists(meta_path))

stopifnot(all(c("sample1", "sample2", "jaccard_sim") %in% names(pw_anno)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

safe_abs_diff <- function(x, y) {
  ifelse(is.na(x) | is.na(y), NA_real_, abs(x - y))
}

pair_3level <- function(x, y, yes_value = 1) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) | is.na(y) ~ NA_character_,
    x == yes_value & y == yes_value ~ "yes_yes",
    x != yes_value & y != yes_value ~ "no_no",
    TRUE ~ "yes_no"
  )
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

make_model_info_tbl <- function(model_obj, model_name, n_pairs) {
  tibble(
    model = model_name,
    nobs = nobs(model_obj),
    n_pairs = n_pairs,
    r2 = tryCatch(unname(fixest::r2(model_obj, "r2")), error = function(e) NA_real_),
    ar2 = tryCatch(unname(fixest::r2(model_obj, "ar2")), error = function(e) NA_real_),
    wr2 = tryCatch(unname(fixest::r2(model_obj, "wr2")), error = function(e) NA_real_),
    war2 = tryCatch(unname(fixest::r2(model_obj, "war2")), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  )
}

build_pair_terms_formula <- function(vars) {
  paste0("i(", vars, ", ref = 'no_no')", collapse = " + ")
}

pretty_term_label <- function(term) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    term == "same_villageTRUE" ~ "same_village",
    term == "same_clusterTRUE" ~ "same_cluster",
    term == "same_sexTRUE" ~ "same_sex",
    term == "age_diff" ~ "age_diff",
    term == "bmi_diff" ~ "bmi_diff",

    str_detect(term, "^i\\(") & str_detect(term, "yes_no") ~
      str_replace_all(term, c("^i\\(" = "", ", ref = 'no_no'\\)::yes_no$" = " | yes_no vs no_no")),
    str_detect(term, "^i\\(") & str_detect(term, "yes_yes") ~
      str_replace_all(term, c("^i\\(" = "", ", ref = 'no_no'\\)::yes_yes$" = " | yes_yes vs no_no")),

    str_detect(term, "_pair::yes_no$") ~ str_replace(term, "_pair::yes_no$", " | yes_no vs no_no"),
    str_detect(term, "_pair::yes_yes$") ~ str_replace(term, "_pair::yes_yes$", " | yes_yes vs no_no"),

    str_detect(term, "_pairyes_no$") ~ str_replace(term, "_pairyes_no$", " | yes_no vs no_no"),
    str_detect(term, "_pairyes_yes$") ~ str_replace(term, "_pairyes_yes$", " | yes_yes vs no_no"),

    TRUE ~ term
  )
}

extract_pair_info_from_label <- function(label) {
  disease <- dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(label, " \\| ") ~ str_replace(label, " \\|.*$", ""),
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  contrast_type <- dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(label, "yes_no vs no_no") ~ "yes_no",
    str_detect(label, "yes_yes vs no_no") ~ "yes_yes",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  tibble(label = label, disease = disease, contrast_type = contrast_type)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) disease sets
# ---------------------------------------------------------
common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) read and clean metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv(meta_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "samplename", "sex", "age", "BMI", "vil_id", "cluster") %in% names(meta)))

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

meta_clean <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid    = as.character(sampleid),
    samplename  = as.character(samplename),
    sex = case_when(
      as.character(sex) %in% c("남", "M", "Male", "male", "1") ~ "M",
      as.character(sex) %in% c("여", "F", "Female", "female", "2") ~ "F",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    age         = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(age)),
    BMI         = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(BMI)),
    vil_id      = as.character(vil_id),
    cluster     = as.character(cluster),
    year_prefix = str_extract(samplename, "^[0-9]{2}"),
    sample_year = case_when(
      year_prefix == "22" ~ 2022L,
      year_prefix == "23" ~ 2023L,
      year_prefix == "24" ~ 2024L,
      year_prefix == "25" ~ 2025L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(all_disease_vars), yn_to_bin)
  ) %>%
  distinct(sampleid, .keep_all = TRUE)

write_csv(
  meta_clean,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "supplementary", "cleaned_metadata_used_for_regression.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) join metadata onto pairwise table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta1 <- meta_clean %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "1"), -sampleid) %>%
  rename(sample1 = sampleid)

meta2 <- meta_clean %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "2"), -sampleid) %>%
  rename(sample2 = sampleid)

pw2 <- pw_anno %>%
  mutate(
    sample1 = as.character(sample1),
    sample2 = as.character(sample2)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta1, by = "sample1") %>%
  left_join(meta2, by = "sample2")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) build pair-level covariates
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pw2 <- pw2 %>%
  mutate(
    same_village = case_when(
      is.na(vil_id1) | is.na(vil_id2) ~ NA,
      vil_id1 == vil_id2 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    same_cluster = case_when(
      is.na(cluster1) | is.na(cluster2) ~ NA,
      cluster1 == cluster2 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    same_sex = case_when(
      is.na(sex1) | is.na(sex2) ~ NA,
      sex1 == sex2 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    age_diff = safe_abs_diff(age1, age2),
    bmi_diff = safe_abs_diff(BMI1, BMI2),
    jaccard_sim_clip = pmin(pmax(jaccard_sim, 1e-6), 1 - 1e-6),
    jaccard_sim_logit = qlogis(jaccard_sim_clip)
  )

for (v in all_disease_vars) {
  v1 <- paste0(v, "1")
  v2 <- paste0(v, "2")
  pair_var <- paste0(v, "_pair")

  pw2[[pair_var]] <- pair_3level(pw2[[v1]], pw2[[v2]])
  pw2[[pair_var]] <- factor(pw2[[pair_var]], levels = c("no_no", "yes_no", "yes_yes"))
}

write_csv(
  pw2,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "supplementary", "pairwise_dataset_with_joined_covariates.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) define disease pair variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
all_pair_vars <- paste0(all_disease_vars, "_pair")

write_csv(
  tibble(variable = all_pair_vars),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_pair_variables_used.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) base model
# ---------------------------------------------------------
base_vars <- c(
  "jaccard_sim_logit",
  "sample1", "sample2",
  "same_village", "same_cluster", "same_sex",
  "age_diff", "bmi_diff"
)

dat_base <- pw2 %>%
  filter(if_all(any_of(base_vars), ~ !is.na(.x)))

fml_base <- as.formula(
  "jaccard_sim_logit ~ same_village + same_cluster + same_sex + age_diff + bmi_diff"
)

m_base <- feols(
  fml_base,
  data = dat_base,
  vcov = ~ sample1 + sample2
)

base_tidy <- tidy(m_base, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    model = "Base model",
    label = pretty_term_label(term),
    is_structural = TRUE,
    is_disease = FALSE,
    p_adj_bh = NA_real_,
    highlight = FALSE
  )

write_csv(
  base_tidy,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "base_model_coefficients.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) full multivariable model
# ---------------------------------------------------------
full_vars <- c(base_vars, all_pair_vars)

dat_full <- pw2 %>%
  filter(if_all(any_of(full_vars), ~ !is.na(.x)))

# pair counts from the actual full-model dataset
pair_count_long <- purrr::map_dfr(all_disease_vars, function(v) {
  pair_var <- paste0(v, "_pair")

  dat_full %>%
    count(.data[[pair_var]], name = "n_pairs") %>%
    transmute(
      disease = v,
      pair_group = as.character(.data[[pair_var]]),
      n_pairs = n_pairs
    )
})

pair_count_wide <- pair_count_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = pair_group,
    values_from = n_pairs,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  rename(
    n_no_no = no_no,
    n_yes_no = yes_no,
    n_yes_yes = yes_yes
  )

write_csv(
  pair_count_wide,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "full_model_pair_counts_by_disease.csv")
)

fml_full <- as.formula(
  paste0(
    "jaccard_sim_logit ~ same_village + same_cluster + same_sex + age_diff + bmi_diff + ",
    build_pair_terms_formula(all_pair_vars)
  )
)

m_full <- feols(
  fml_full,
  data = dat_full,
  vcov = ~ sample1 + sample2
)

full_tidy <- tidy(m_full, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    model = "Full multivariable model",
    label = pretty_term_label(term),
    is_structural = term %in% c("same_villageTRUE", "same_clusterTRUE", "same_sexTRUE", "age_diff", "bmi_diff"),
    is_disease = !is_structural,
    p_adj_bh = NA_real_,
    highlight = FALSE
  )

disease_idx <- which(full_tidy$is_disease)
if (length(disease_idx) > 0) {
  full_tidy$p_adj_bh[disease_idx] <- p.adjust(full_tidy$p.value[disease_idx], method = "BH")
  full_tidy$highlight[disease_idx] <- full_tidy$p_adj_bh[disease_idx] < 0.05
}

# add pair counts to disease labels
label_info <- extract_pair_info_from_label(full_tidy$label)

full_tidy <- bind_cols(full_tidy, label_info %>% select(disease, contrast_type)) %>%
  left_join(pair_count_wide, by = "disease") %>%
  mutate(
    pair_n_for_label = case_when(
      contrast_type == "yes_no" ~ n_yes_no,
      contrast_type == "yes_yes" ~ n_yes_yes,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    label_with_n = case_when(
      is_disease & contrast_type == "yes_no" ~ paste0(label, " [yn n=", pair_n_for_label, "]"),
      is_disease & contrast_type == "yes_yes" ~ paste0(label, " [yy n=", pair_n_for_label, "]"),
      TRUE ~ label
    )
  )

write_csv(
  full_tidy,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "full_multivariable_model_coefficients_with_fdr.csv")
)

write_csv(
  full_tidy %>%
    filter(is_disease) %>%
    select(model, term, label, label_with_n, disease, contrast_type,
           n_no_no, n_yes_no, n_yes_yes,
           estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, p_adj_bh, conf.low, conf.high, highlight),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "full_multivariable_model_disease_terms_with_fdr_and_pair_counts.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) model summaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------
model_info_tbl <- bind_rows(
  make_model_info_tbl(m_base, "Base model", nrow(dat_base)),
  make_model_info_tbl(m_full, "Full multivariable model", nrow(dat_full))
)

write_csv(
  model_info_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "model_fit_summary.csv")
)

same_village_compare <- bind_rows(
  base_tidy %>% filter(term == "same_villageTRUE"),
  full_tidy %>% filter(term == "same_villageTRUE")
) %>%
  select(model, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high)

write_csv(
  same_village_compare,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "same_village_comparison_base_vs_full.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) plotting tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
base_plot_tbl <- base_tidy %>%
  transmute(
    model,
    term,
    label = label,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    highlight
  )

full_plot_tbl <- full_tidy %>%
  transmute(
    model,
    term,
    label = label_with_n,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    highlight
  )

base_label_levels <- c(
  "same_village",
  "same_cluster",
  "same_sex",
  "age_diff",
  "bmi_diff"
)

base_plot_tbl <- base_plot_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(base_label_levels))
  )

full_label_levels <- full_plot_tbl %>%
  arrange(
    case_when(
      str_detect(label, "^same_village") ~ 1,
      str_detect(label, "^same_cluster") ~ 2,
      str_detect(label, "^same_sex") ~ 3,
      str_detect(label, "^age_diff") ~ 4,
      str_detect(label, "^bmi_diff") ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ 6
    ),
    label
  ) %>%
  pull(label) %>%
  unique()

full_plot_tbl <- full_plot_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(full_label_levels))
  )

all_plot_tbl <- bind_rows(base_plot_tbl, full_plot_tbl) %>%
  mutate(
    model = factor(model, levels = c("Base model", "Full multivariable model"))
  )

write_csv(
  bind_rows(base_plot_tbl, full_plot_tbl) %>%
    mutate(label = as.character(label)),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "plotting_table_all_coefficients.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10-b) additional plotting table:
#      full model, excluding yes_no disease contrasts
#      keep only structural terms + yes_yes disease contrasts
#      disease terms ordered by coefficient (descending)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
full_yesyes_plot_tbl <- full_tidy %>%
  transmute(
    model,
    term,
    label = label_with_n,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    highlight,
    is_structural,
    is_disease,
    contrast_type
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is_structural | (is_disease & contrast_type == "yes_yes")
  )

# fixed order for structural terms
structural_label_levels_yesyes <- c(
  "same_village",
  "same_cluster",
  "same_sex",
  "age_diff",
  "bmi_diff"
)

# disease labels ordered by regression coefficient (descending)
disease_label_levels_yesyes <- full_yesyes_plot_tbl %>%
  filter(is_disease) %>%
  arrange(desc(estimate)) %>%
  pull(label) %>%
  unique()

full_yesyes_label_levels <- c(
  structural_label_levels_yesyes,
  disease_label_levels_yesyes
)

full_yesyes_plot_tbl <- full_yesyes_plot_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(full_yesyes_label_levels))
  )

write_csv(
  full_yesyes_plot_tbl %>%
    mutate(label = as.character(label)),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "plotting_table_full_model_yesyes_only.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# 11-1. same_village comparison only
p_same_village <- bind_rows(
  base_tidy %>% filter(term == "same_villageTRUE"),
  full_tidy %>% filter(term == "same_villageTRUE")
) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Base model", "Full multivariable model"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6) +
  labs(
    x = "Regression coefficient (logit Jaccard similarity)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "same_village in base and full multivariable models"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans")

save_plot_both(
  p_same_village,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "same_village_base_vs_full"),
  width = 7,
  height = 4
)

# 11-2. base model: all variables
p_base <- ggplot(base_plot_tbl, aes(x = estimate, y = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Regression coefficient (logit Jaccard similarity)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Base model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans")

save_plot_both(
  p_base,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "base_model_all_variables"),
  width = 8,
  height = 4.5
)

# 11-3. full model: all variables, FDR-significant disease terms in red
full_height <- max(6, 0.22 * nrow(full_plot_tbl) + 1.5)

p_full <- ggplot(full_plot_tbl, aes(x = estimate, y = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(color = highlight), size = 2.0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "firebrick", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Regression coefficient (logit Jaccard similarity)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Full multivariable model",
    subtitle = "Red points indicate disease-related terms with BH-adjusted P < 0.05"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_full,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "full_multivariable_model_all_variables"),
  width = 11,
  height = full_height
)

# 11-3b. full model: structural terms + yes_yes disease contrasts only
#        disease terms ordered by coefficient (descending)
full_yesyes_height <- max(6, 0.22 * nrow(full_yesyes_plot_tbl) + 1.5)

p_full_yesyes <- ggplot(full_yesyes_plot_tbl, aes(x = estimate, y = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(color = highlight), size = 2.0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "firebrick", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Regression coefficient (logit Jaccard similarity)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Full multivariable model (yes_yes disease contrasts only)",
    subtitle = "Only yes_yes vs no_no disease terms are shown. Disease terms are ordered by regression coefficient (descending). Red points indicate disease-related terms with BH-adjusted P < 0.05"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_full_yesyes,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "full_multivariable_model_yesyes_only"),
  width = 11,
  height = full_yesyes_height
)

# 11-4. combined faceted plot
combined_height <- max(8, 0.18 * nrow(full_plot_tbl) + 4)

p_combined <- ggplot(all_plot_tbl, aes(x = estimate, y = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(color = highlight), size = 2.0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "firebrick", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Regression coefficient (logit Jaccard similarity)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Base and full multivariable regression models",
    subtitle = "In the full model, red points indicate disease-related terms with BH-adjusted P < 0.05"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_combined,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "base_and_full_models_all_variables"),
  width = 11,
  height = combined_height
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) compact structural comparison table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
structural_terms <- c("same_villageTRUE", "same_clusterTRUE", "same_sexTRUE", "age_diff", "bmi_diff")

structural_compare_tbl <- bind_rows(base_tidy, full_tidy) %>%
  filter(term %in% structural_terms) %>%
  transmute(
    model,
    variable = pretty_term_label(term),
    estimate,
    std.error,
    statistic,
    p.value,
    conf.low,
    conf.high
  )

write_csv(
  structural_compare_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "structural_terms_base_vs_full.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
message("DONE: regression analysis complete.")
message("Outputs saved to: ", OUTDIR)
message("Key files:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "same_village_comparison_base_vs_full.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "full_model_pair_counts_by_disease.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "full_multivariable_model_disease_terms_with_fdr_and_pair_counts.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "same_village_base_vs_full.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "base_model_all_variables.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "full_multivariable_model_all_variables.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "full_multivariable_model_yesyes_only.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "base_and_full_models_all_variables.png"))
```

#disease distribution
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)
})

stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_ver2.csv"))

OUTDIR <- "disease count summary"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

meta <- read_csv("metadata_ver2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

common_base_vars <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "osteoporosis",
  "diabetes"
)
common_base_vars <- common_base_vars[common_base_vars %in% all_disease_vars]

non_common_vars <- setdiff(all_disease_vars, common_base_vars)

meta_count <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(all_disease_vars), yn_to_bin)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_count_all = rowSums(across(all_of(all_disease_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    disease_count_non_common = rowSums(across(all_of(non_common_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

write_csv(
  meta_count,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "metadata_with_disease_counts.csv")
)

# 1) exact count distribution
count_dist_all <- meta_count %>%
  count(disease_count_all, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  arrange(disease_count_all)

count_dist_non_common <- meta_count %>%
  count(disease_count_non_common, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  arrange(disease_count_non_common)

write_csv(
  count_dist_all,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "disease_count_all_distribution.csv")
)

write_csv(
  count_dist_non_common,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "disease_count_non_common_distribution.csv")
)

# 2) grouped summary
meta_count_grouped <- meta_count %>%
  mutate(
    disease_count_all_group = case_when(
      disease_count_all == 0 ~ "0",
      disease_count_all == 1 ~ "1",
      disease_count_all == 2 ~ "2",
      disease_count_all == 3 ~ "3",
      disease_count_all >= 4 ~ "4+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    disease_count_non_common_group = case_when(
      disease_count_non_common == 0 ~ "0",
      disease_count_non_common == 1 ~ "1",
      disease_count_non_common == 2 ~ "2",
      disease_count_non_common == 3 ~ "3",
      disease_count_non_common >= 4 ~ "4+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

grouped_all <- meta_count_grouped %>%
  count(disease_count_all_group, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

grouped_non_common <- meta_count_grouped %>%
  count(disease_count_non_common_group, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

write_csv(
  grouped_all,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "disease_count_all_grouped_distribution.csv")
)

write_csv(
  grouped_non_common,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "disease_count_non_common_grouped_distribution.csv")
)

# 3) compact summary table
summary_tbl <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "N individuals",
    "Mean disease_count_all",
    "Median disease_count_all",
    "Max disease_count_all",
    "Mean disease_count_non_common",
    "Median disease_count_non_common",
    "Max disease_count_non_common"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(meta_count),
    mean(meta_count$disease_count_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    median(meta_count$disease_count_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(meta_count$disease_count_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(meta_count$disease_count_non_common, na.rm = TRUE),
    median(meta_count$disease_count_non_common, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(meta_count$disease_count_non_common, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

write_csv(
  summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "disease_count_summary_table.csv")
)

print(count_dist_all)
print(count_dist_non_common)
print(grouped_all)
print(grouped_non_common)
print(summary_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
```
