#individual sharing analysis
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
})

# =========================================================
# Individual village-centered sharing score
# - loops over all disease variables
# - computes per-person within-village mean sharing score
# - centers it by village mean
# - outputs summary / Wilcoxon / plot for each disease
#
# Required:
#   pw_anno  : sample1, sample2, jaccard_sim
#   metadata_ver2.csv
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("pw_anno"))
stopifnot(all(c("sample1", "sample2", "jaccard_sim") %in% names(pw_anno)))
stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_ver2.csv"))

OUTDIR <- "individual sharing analysis"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_disease"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 6.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) metadata and disease variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("metadata_ver2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "vil_id") %in% names(meta)))

common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) build core individual score once
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_core <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id)
  ) %>%
  select(sampleid, vil_id)

pw_long <- pw_anno %>%
  transmute(
    sample1 = as.character(sample1),
    sample2 = as.character(sample2),
    jaccard_sim = as.numeric(jaccard_sim)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% rename(vil1 = vil_id), by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% rename(vil2 = vil_id), by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil1), !is.na(vil2)) %>%
  filter(vil1 == vil2) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2)

# one pair contributes to both individuals
indiv_pairs <- bind_rows(
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample1,
      partner = sample2,
      vil_id = vil1,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    ),
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample2,
      partner = sample1,
      vil_id = vil2,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    )
)

indiv_score <- indiv_pairs %>%
  group_by(sampleid, vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_partners = n(),
    mean_within_village_sharing = mean(sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

indiv_centered_core <- indiv_score %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  mutate(
    village_mean_sharing = mean(mean_within_village_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    centered_sharing = mean_within_village_sharing - village_mean_sharing
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(
  indiv_centered_core,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "individual_centered_sharing_core.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) loop over all diseases
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_list <- list()
test_list <- list()

for (disease_var in all_disease_vars) {

  message("Running: ", disease_var)

  meta_disease <- meta %>%
    mutate(
      sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
      vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
      disease = yn_to_bin(.data[[disease_var]])
    ) %>%
    select(sampleid, vil_id, disease)

  indiv_centered <- indiv_centered_core %>%
    left_join(meta_disease, by = c("sampleid", "vil_id")) %>%
    mutate(
      disease_group = case_when(
        disease == 1 ~ "Disease yes",
        disease == 0 ~ "Disease no",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      disease_var = disease_var
    )

  # save per-disease individual table
  write_csv(
    indiv_centered,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_disease", paste0("individual_centered_sharing_", disease_var, ".csv"))
  )

  # summary
  summary_tbl <- indiv_centered %>%
    filter(!is.na(disease_group)) %>%
    group_by(disease_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_individuals = n(),
      mean_centered = mean(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_centered = median(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_centered = sd(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(disease_var = disease_var) %>%
    relocate(disease_var)

  write_csv(
    summary_tbl,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_disease", paste0("summary_centered_sharing_", disease_var, ".csv"))
  )

  summary_list[[disease_var]] <- summary_tbl

  # Wilcoxon test
  test_tbl <- indiv_centered %>%
    filter(!is.na(disease_group), is.finite(centered_sharing))

  if (length(unique(test_tbl$disease_group)) == 2) {
    wt <- wilcox.test(centered_sharing ~ disease_group, data = test_tbl, exact = FALSE)

    test_out <- tibble(
      disease_var = disease_var,
      p_value = wt$p.value,
      n_yes = sum(test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease yes", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_no = sum(test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease no", na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_yes = mean(test_tbl$centered_sharing[test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_no = mean(test_tbl$centered_sharing[test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease no"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_yes = median(test_tbl$centered_sharing[test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_no = median(test_tbl$centered_sharing[test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease no"], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  } else {
    test_out <- tibble(
      disease_var = disease_var,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      n_yes = sum(test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease yes", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_no = sum(test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease no", na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_yes = mean(test_tbl$centered_sharing[test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_no = mean(test_tbl$centered_sharing[test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease no"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_yes = median(test_tbl$centered_sharing[test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_no = median(test_tbl$centered_sharing[test_tbl$disease_group == "Disease no"], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }

  write_csv(
    test_out,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_disease", paste0("wilcox_centered_sharing_", disease_var, ".csv"))
  )

  test_list[[disease_var]] <- test_out

  # plot
  p <- indiv_centered %>%
    filter(!is.na(disease_group), is.finite(centered_sharing)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = disease_group, y = centered_sharing, color = disease_group)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.35, color = "black", fill = "white") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.18, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Village-centered within-village sharing score",
      title = paste0("Individual within-village sharing: ", disease_var),
      subtitle = "0 indicates the village mean"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", paste0("plot_centered_sharing_", disease_var))
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) combined outputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_all <- bind_rows(summary_list)
write_csv(
  summary_all,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "summary_centered_sharing_all_diseases.csv")
)

test_all <- bind_rows(test_list) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_bh, p_value)

write_csv(
  test_all,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "wilcox_centered_sharing_all_diseases.csv")
)

message("DONE: individual sharing analysis completed.")
message("Output folder: ", OUTDIR)
message("Key files:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "summary_centered_sharing_all_diseases.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "wilcox_centered_sharing_all_diseases.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"))
```

#individual sharing analysis by village
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
})

# =========================================================
# Individual village-centered sharing score by village
# - loops over all disease variables
# - computes per-person within-village mean sharing score
# - centers it by village mean
# - for each disease:
#     * keep only villages with >=1 disease-positive individual
#     * x-axis = village (vil_id)
#     * y-axis = village-centered sharing score
#     * point color = disease yes/no
#     * light boxplot background
#     * village order = cluster first, then mean_yes within cluster
#
# Required:
#   pw_anno  : sample1, sample2, jaccard_sim
#   metadata_ver2.csv
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("pw_anno"))
stopifnot(all(c("sample1", "sample2", "jaccard_sim") %in% names(pw_anno)))
stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_ver2.csv"))

OUTDIR <- "individual sharing analysis by village"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_disease"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 10, height = 5.8, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

# cluster sorting helper:
# if cluster values look numeric, sort numerically; otherwise alphabetically
make_cluster_factor <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))

  if (all(is.na(x_num) == is.na(x_chr)) && any(!is.na(x_num))) {
    factor(x_chr, levels = unique(x_chr[order(x_num)]))
  } else {
    factor(x_chr, levels = sort(unique(x_chr)))
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) metadata and disease variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("metadata_ver2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "vil_id", "cluster") %in% names(meta)))

common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

meta_core <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    cluster = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  select(sampleid, vil_id, cluster)

village_cluster_tbl <- meta_core %>%
  distinct(vil_id, cluster)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) build core individual centered sharing score once
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pw_long <- pw_anno %>%
  transmute(
    sample1 = as.character(sample1),
    sample2 = as.character(sample2),
    jaccard_sim = as.numeric(jaccard_sim)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% select(sampleid, vil_id) %>% rename(vil1 = vil_id), by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% select(sampleid, vil_id) %>% rename(vil2 = vil_id), by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil1), !is.na(vil2)) %>%
  filter(vil1 == vil2) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2)

# one pair contributes to both individuals
indiv_pairs <- bind_rows(
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample1,
      partner = sample2,
      vil_id = vil1,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    ),
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample2,
      partner = sample1,
      vil_id = vil2,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    )
)

indiv_score <- indiv_pairs %>%
  group_by(sampleid, vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_partners = n(),
    mean_within_village_sharing = mean(sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

indiv_centered_core <- indiv_score %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  mutate(
    village_mean_sharing = mean(mean_within_village_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    centered_sharing = mean_within_village_sharing - village_mean_sharing
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(meta_core, by = c("sampleid", "vil_id"))

write_csv(
  indiv_centered_core,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "individual_centered_sharing_core.csv")
)

# quick check: village means should be ~0
village_mean_check <- indiv_centered_core %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    centered_mean_check = mean(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  village_mean_check,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_centered_mean_check.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) loop over diseases
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_list <- list()
village_summary_list <- list()
plot_subset_summary_list <- list()

for (disease_var in all_disease_vars) {

  message("Running: ", disease_var)

  meta_disease <- meta %>%
    mutate(
      sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
      vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
      disease = yn_to_bin(.data[[disease_var]])
    ) %>%
    select(sampleid, vil_id, disease)

  indiv_centered <- indiv_centered_core %>%
    left_join(meta_disease, by = c("sampleid", "vil_id")) %>%
    mutate(
      disease_group = case_when(
        disease == 1 ~ "Disease yes",
        disease == 0 ~ "Disease no",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      disease_var = disease_var
    )

  # villages containing >=1 disease-positive individual
  villages_with_case <- indiv_centered %>%
    filter(disease == 1) %>%
    distinct(vil_id) %>%
    pull(vil_id)

  plot_df <- indiv_centered %>%
    filter(vil_id %in% villages_with_case) %>%
    filter(!is.na(disease_group), is.finite(centered_sharing))

  # if no usable villages, skip
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    message("  -> skipped (no eligible villages)")
    next
  }

  # village summary used for ordering
  village_summary <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(vil_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_yes = sum(disease_group == "Disease yes", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_no = sum(disease_group == "Disease no", na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_yes = mean(centered_sharing[disease_group == "Disease yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_no = mean(centered_sharing[disease_group == "Disease no"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_yes = median(centered_sharing[disease_group == "Disease yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_no = median(centered_sharing[disease_group == "Disease no"], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      disease_var = disease_var
    ) %>%
    arrange(mean_yes)

  village_order <- village_summary$vil_id

  # prepare plotting data
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      vil_id = factor(vil_id, levels = village_order),
      disease_group = factor(disease_group, levels = c("Disease no", "Disease yes")),
      cluster = as.character(cluster)
    )

  # save individual-level plot subset
  write_csv(
    plot_df %>%
      mutate(vil_id = as.character(vil_id)),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_disease", paste0("individual_centered_sharing_plot_subset_", disease_var, ".csv"))
  )

  # save village summary
  write_csv(
    village_summary,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_disease", paste0("village_summary_", disease_var, ".csv"))
  )

  # overall summary on plotted subset
  summary_tbl <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(disease_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_individuals = n(),
      mean_centered = mean(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_centered = median(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_centered = sd(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(disease_var = disease_var) %>%
    relocate(disease_var)

  write_csv(
    summary_tbl,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_disease", paste0("summary_plot_subset_", disease_var, ".csv"))
  )

  summary_list[[disease_var]] <- summary_tbl
  village_summary_list[[disease_var]] <- village_summary
  plot_subset_summary_list[[disease_var]] <- tibble(
    disease_var = disease_var,
    n_villages = n_distinct(plot_df$vil_id),
    n_individuals = nrow(plot_df),
    n_yes = sum(plot_df$disease_group == "Disease yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_no = sum(plot_df$disease_group == "Disease no", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  # plot width based on number of villages
  plot_width <- max(8, length(village_order) * 0.45)

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = vil_id, y = centered_sharing)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.55,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      fill = "grey85",
      color = "grey65",
      alpha = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = disease_group),
      width = 0.18,
      height = 0,
      alpha = 0.8,
      size = 2
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Village ID",
      y = "Village-centered within-village sharing score",
      title = paste0("Individual within-village sharing by village: ", disease_var),
      subtitle = "Only villages with at least one disease-positive individual are shown; village order = cluster, then mean_yes within cluster; 0 indicates the village mean",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", paste0("plot_by_village_centered_sharing_", disease_var)),
    width = plot_width,
    height = 5.8
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) combined tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (length(summary_list) > 0) {
  summary_all <- bind_rows(summary_list)
  write_csv(
    summary_all,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "summary_plot_subset_all_diseases.csv")
  )
}

if (length(village_summary_list) > 0) {
  village_summary_all <- bind_rows(village_summary_list)
  write_csv(
    village_summary_all,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_summary_all_diseases.csv")
  )
}

if (length(plot_subset_summary_list) > 0) {
  plot_subset_summary_all <- bind_rows(plot_subset_summary_list)
  write_csv(
    plot_subset_summary_all,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "plot_subset_summary_all_diseases.csv")
  )
}

message("DONE: individual sharing analysis by village completed.")
message("Output folder: ", OUTDIR)
message("Key files:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "individual_centered_sharing_core.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "summary_plot_subset_all_diseases.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_summary_all_diseases.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "plot_subset_summary_all_diseases.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"))
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
})

# =========================================================
# Disease-wise summary figure
# - saved under:
#     individual sharing analysis by village/summary_figure
# - for each disease:
#     * keep only villages with >=1 disease-positive individual
#     * compare Disease no vs Disease yes
#     * violin + boxplot + jitter
#
# Required:
#   pw_anno
#   metadata_ver2.csv
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("pw_anno"))
stopifnot(all(c("sample1", "sample2", "jaccard_sim") %in% names(pw_anno)))
stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_ver2.csv"))

BASE_OUTDIR <- "individual sharing analysis by village"
SUMMARY_DIR <- file.path(BASE_OUTDIR, "summary_figure")
dir.create(SUMMARY_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 6.8, height = 5.5, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) metadata and disease list
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("metadata_ver2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "vil_id") %in% names(meta)))

common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

meta_core <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id)
  ) %>%
  select(sampleid, vil_id)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) core individual centered sharing score
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pw_long <- pw_anno %>%
  transmute(
    sample1 = as.character(sample1),
    sample2 = as.character(sample2),
    jaccard_sim = as.numeric(jaccard_sim)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% rename(vil1 = vil_id), by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% rename(vil2 = vil_id), by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil1), !is.na(vil2)) %>%
  filter(vil1 == vil2) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2)

indiv_pairs <- bind_rows(
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample1,
      partner = sample2,
      vil_id = vil1,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    ),
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample2,
      partner = sample1,
      vil_id = vil2,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    )
)

indiv_score <- indiv_pairs %>%
  group_by(sampleid, vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_partners = n(),
    mean_within_village_sharing = mean(sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

indiv_centered_core <- indiv_score %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  mutate(
    village_mean_sharing = mean(mean_within_village_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    centered_sharing = mean(mean_within_village_sharing, na.rm = TRUE) * 0 + mean_within_village_sharing - village_mean_sharing
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(
  indiv_centered_core,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "tables", "individual_centered_sharing_core.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) loop over diseases
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_list <- list()
test_list <- list()

for (disease_var in all_disease_vars) {

  message("Running: ", disease_var)

  meta_disease <- meta %>%
    mutate(
      sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
      vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
      disease = yn_to_bin(.data[[disease_var]])
    ) %>%
    select(sampleid, vil_id, disease)

  indiv_centered <- indiv_centered_core %>%
    left_join(meta_disease, by = c("sampleid", "vil_id")) %>%
    mutate(
      disease_group = case_when(
        disease == 1 ~ "Disease yes",
        disease == 0 ~ "Disease no",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      disease_var = disease_var
    )

  villages_with_case <- indiv_centered %>%
    filter(disease == 1) %>%
    distinct(vil_id) %>%
    pull(vil_id)

  plot_df <- indiv_centered %>%
    filter(vil_id %in% villages_with_case) %>%
    filter(!is.na(disease_group), is.finite(centered_sharing))

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) next

  # summary
  summary_tbl <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(disease_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_individuals = n(),
      n_villages = n_distinct(vil_id),
      mean_centered = mean(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_centered = median(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_centered = sd(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(disease_var = disease_var) %>%
    relocate(disease_var)

  summary_list[[disease_var]] <- summary_tbl

  write_csv(
    summary_tbl,
    file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "tables", paste0("summary_", disease_var, ".csv"))
  )

  # test
  if (n_distinct(plot_df$disease_group) == 2) {
    wt <- wilcox.test(centered_sharing ~ disease_group, data = plot_df, exact = FALSE)

    test_tbl <- tibble(
      disease_var = disease_var,
      p_value = wt$p.value,
      n_yes = sum(plot_df$disease_group == "Disease yes", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_no = sum(plot_df$disease_group == "Disease no", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_villages = n_distinct(plot_df$vil_id),
      mean_yes = mean(plot_df$centered_sharing[plot_df$disease_group == "Disease yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_no = mean(plot_df$centered_sharing[plot_df$disease_group == "Disease no"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_yes = median(plot_df$centered_sharing[plot_df$disease_group == "Disease yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_no = median(plot_df$centered_sharing[plot_df$disease_group == "Disease no"], na.rm = TRUE),
      delta_mean = mean_yes - mean_no,
      delta_median = median_yes - median_no
    )
  } else {
    test_tbl <- tibble(
      disease_var = disease_var,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      n_yes = sum(plot_df$disease_group == "Disease yes", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_no = sum(plot_df$disease_group == "Disease no", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_villages = n_distinct(plot_df$vil_id),
      mean_yes = mean(plot_df$centered_sharing[plot_df$disease_group == "Disease yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_no = mean(plot_df$centered_sharing[plot_df$disease_group == "Disease no"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_yes = median(plot_df$centered_sharing[plot_df$disease_group == "Disease yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_no = median(plot_df$centered_sharing[plot_df$disease_group == "Disease no"], na.rm = TRUE),
      delta_mean = mean_yes - mean_no,
      delta_median = median_yes - median_no
    )
  }

  test_list[[disease_var]] <- test_tbl

  # plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = disease_group, y = centered_sharing)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_violin(fill = "grey90", color = "grey70", alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "black") +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = disease_group), width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Village-centered within-village sharing score",
      title = paste0("Disease-wise summary: ", disease_var),
      subtitle = "Only villages with at least one disease-positive individual are included; 0 indicates the village mean",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "plots", paste0("summary_figure_", disease_var))
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) combined tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_all <- bind_rows(summary_list)

write_csv(
  summary_all,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "tables", "summary_all_diseases.csv")
)

test_all <- bind_rows(test_list) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_bh, delta_mean)

write_csv(
  test_all,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "tables", "test_results_all_diseases.csv")
)

message("DONE: disease-wise summary figures completed.")
message("Saved under: ", SUMMARY_DIR)
message("Key files:")
message(" - ", file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "tables", "summary_all_diseases.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "tables", "test_results_all_diseases.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "plots"))
```



#individual sharing burden analysis
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
})

# =========================================================
# Individual village-centered sharing score by village
# - burden variables:
#     1) any_disease
#     2) common_disease_any
#     3) non_common_disease_any
#     4) disease_count_all
#     5) disease_count_non_common
#
# Common diseases are defined here as prevalence >= 20%:
#   hypertension, osteoarthritis, dyslipidemia, osteoporosis, diabetes
#
# Required:
#   pw_anno  : sample1, sample2, jaccard_sim
#   metadata_ver2.csv
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("pw_anno"))
stopifnot(all(c("sample1", "sample2", "jaccard_sim") %in% names(pw_anno)))
stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_ver2.csv"))

OUTDIR <- "individual sharing burden analysis"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_variable"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 10, height = 5.8, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

make_cluster_factor <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))

  if (sum(!is.na(x_num)) > 0) {
    factor(x_chr, levels = unique(x_chr[order(x_num, x_chr)]))
  } else {
    factor(x_chr, levels = sort(unique(x_chr)))
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) metadata and disease sets
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("metadata_ver2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "vil_id", "cluster") %in% names(meta)))

common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

# prevalence >= 20% based common disease set
common_base_vars <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "osteoporosis",
  "diabetes"
)
common_base_vars <- common_base_vars[common_base_vars %in% all_disease_vars]

non_common_vars <- setdiff(all_disease_vars, common_base_vars)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) metadata clean + burden variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_clean <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    cluster = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(all_disease_vars), yn_to_bin)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_count_all = rowSums(across(all_of(all_disease_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    disease_count_non_common = rowSums(across(all_of(non_common_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_disease = if_else(disease_count_all > 0, 1, 0),
    common_disease_any = if_else(
      rowSums(across(all_of(common_base_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0
    ),
    non_common_disease_any = if_else(
      rowSums(across(all_of(non_common_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0
    )
  )

write_csv(
  meta_clean,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "metadata_with_burden_variables.csv")
)

meta_core <- meta_clean %>%
  select(sampleid, vil_id, cluster)

village_cluster_tbl <- meta_core %>%
  distinct(vil_id, cluster)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) build core individual centered sharing score once
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pw_long <- pw_anno %>%
  transmute(
    sample1 = as.character(sample1),
    sample2 = as.character(sample2),
    jaccard_sim = as.numeric(jaccard_sim)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% select(sampleid, vil_id) %>% rename(vil1 = vil_id), by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% select(sampleid, vil_id) %>% rename(vil2 = vil_id), by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil1), !is.na(vil2)) %>%
  filter(vil1 == vil2) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2)

indiv_pairs <- bind_rows(
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample1,
      partner = sample2,
      vil_id = vil1,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    ),
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample2,
      partner = sample1,
      vil_id = vil2,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    )
)

indiv_score <- indiv_pairs %>%
  group_by(sampleid, vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_partners = n(),
    mean_within_village_sharing = mean(sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

indiv_centered_core <- indiv_score %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  mutate(
    village_mean_sharing = mean(mean_within_village_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    centered_sharing = mean_within_village_sharing - village_mean_sharing
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(meta_clean, by = c("sampleid", "vil_id"))

write_csv(
  indiv_centered_core,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "individual_centered_sharing_core.csv")
)

village_mean_check <- indiv_centered_core %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    centered_mean_check = mean(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  village_mean_check,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_centered_mean_check.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) variables to loop over
# ---------------------------------------------------------
burden_vars <- c(
  "any_disease",
  "common_disease_any",
  "non_common_disease_any",
  "disease_count_all",
  "disease_count_non_common"
)

summary_list <- list()
village_summary_list <- list()
subset_summary_list <- list()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) loop
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (var_name in burden_vars) {

  message("Running: ", var_name)

  df <- indiv_centered_core

  # ---- binary variables ----
  if (var_name %in% c("any_disease", "common_disease_any", "non_common_disease_any")) {

    df2 <- df %>%
      mutate(
        exposure = .data[[var_name]],
        group = case_when(
          exposure == 1 ~ "Yes",
          exposure == 0 ~ "No",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      )

    villages_with_case <- df2 %>%
      filter(exposure == 1) %>%
      distinct(vil_id) %>%
      pull(vil_id)

    plot_df <- df2 %>%
      filter(vil_id %in% villages_with_case) %>%
      filter(!is.na(group), is.finite(centered_sharing))

    if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) next

    village_summary <- plot_df %>%
      group_by(vil_id) %>%
      summarise(
        n_total = n(),
        n_yes = sum(group == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
        n_no = sum(group == "No", na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_yes = mean(centered_sharing[group == "Yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_no = mean(centered_sharing[group == "No"], na.rm = TRUE),
        median_yes = median(centered_sharing[group == "Yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
        median_no = median(centered_sharing[group == "No"], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        variable = var_name
      ) %>%
      arrange(mean_yes)

    village_order <- village_summary$vil_id

    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(
        vil_id = factor(vil_id, levels = village_order),
        group = factor(group, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
      )

    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = vil_id, y = centered_sharing)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
      geom_boxplot(
        width = 0.55,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        fill = "grey85",
        color = "grey65",
        alpha = 0.45
      ) +
      geom_jitter(
        aes(color = group),
        width = 0.18,
        height = 0,
        alpha = 0.8,
        size = 2
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "Village ID",
        y = "Village-centered within-village sharing score",
        title = paste0("Individual within-village sharing by village: ", var_name),
        subtitle = "Only villages with at least one positive individual are shown; village order = cluster, then mean_yes within cluster; 0 indicates the village mean",
        color = NULL
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )

    save_plot_both(
      p,
      file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", paste0("plot_by_village_", var_name)),
      width = max(8, length(village_order) * 0.45),
      height = 5.8
    )

    summary_tbl <- plot_df %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(
        n_individuals = n(),
        mean_centered = mean(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_centered = median(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_centered = sd(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(variable = var_name) %>%
      relocate(variable)

    summary_list[[var_name]] <- summary_tbl
    village_summary_list[[var_name]] <- village_summary
    subset_summary_list[[var_name]] <- tibble(
      variable = var_name,
      n_villages = n_distinct(plot_df$vil_id),
      n_individuals = nrow(plot_df),
      n_positive = sum(plot_df$group == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_negative = sum(plot_df$group == "No", na.rm = TRUE)
    )

    write_csv(
      plot_df %>% mutate(vil_id = as.character(vil_id)),
      file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_variable", paste0("plot_df_", var_name, ".csv"))
    )

    write_csv(
      village_summary,
      file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_variable", paste0("village_summary_", var_name, ".csv"))
    )

    write_csv(
      summary_tbl,
      file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_variable", paste0("summary_", var_name, ".csv"))
    )
  }

  # ---- count variables ----
  if (var_name %in% c("disease_count_all", "disease_count_non_common")) {

    df2 <- df %>%
      mutate(
        exposure = .data[[var_name]],
        group = case_when(
          exposure == 0 ~ "0",
          exposure == 1 ~ "1",
          exposure >= 2 ~ "2+",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      )

    villages_with_case <- df2 %>%
      filter(exposure >= 1) %>%
      distinct(vil_id) %>%
      pull(vil_id)

    plot_df <- df2 %>%
      filter(vil_id %in% villages_with_case) %>%
      filter(!is.na(group), is.finite(centered_sharing))

    if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) next

    village_summary <- plot_df %>%
      group_by(vil_id) %>%
      summarise(
        n_total = n(),
        n_0 = sum(group == "0", na.rm = TRUE),
        n_1 = sum(group == "1", na.rm = TRUE),
        n_2plus = sum(group == "2+", na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_positive = mean(centered_sharing[exposure >= 1], na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_zero = mean(centered_sharing[exposure == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      left_join(village_cluster_tbl, by = "vil_id") %>%
      mutate(
        cluster = make_cluster_factor(cluster),
        variable = var_name
      ) %>%
      arrange(cluster, mean_positive)

    village_order <- village_summary$vil_id

    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      mutate(
        vil_id = factor(vil_id, levels = village_order),
        group = factor(group, levels = c("0", "1", "2+"))
      )

    p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = vil_id, y = centered_sharing)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
      geom_boxplot(
        width = 0.55,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        fill = "grey85",
        color = "grey65",
        alpha = 0.45
      ) +
      geom_jitter(
        aes(color = group),
        width = 0.18,
        height = 0,
        alpha = 0.8,
        size = 2
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "Village ID",
        y = "Village-centered within-village sharing score",
        title = paste0("Individual within-village sharing by village: ", var_name),
        subtitle = "Only villages with at least one positive individual are shown; village order = cluster, then mean_positive within cluster; 0 indicates the village mean",
        color = NULL
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )

    save_plot_both(
      p,
      file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", paste0("plot_by_village_", var_name)),
      width = max(8, length(village_order) * 0.45),
      height = 5.8
    )

    summary_tbl <- plot_df %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(
        n_individuals = n(),
        mean_centered = mean(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_centered = median(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_centered = sd(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(variable = var_name) %>%
      relocate(variable)

    summary_list[[var_name]] <- summary_tbl
    village_summary_list[[var_name]] <- village_summary
    subset_summary_list[[var_name]] <- tibble(
      variable = var_name,
      n_villages = n_distinct(plot_df$vil_id),
      n_individuals = nrow(plot_df),
      n_0 = sum(plot_df$group == "0", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_1 = sum(plot_df$group == "1", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_2plus = sum(plot_df$group == "2+", na.rm = TRUE)
    )

    write_csv(
      plot_df %>% mutate(vil_id = as.character(vil_id)),
      file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_variable", paste0("plot_df_", var_name, ".csv"))
    )

    write_csv(
      village_summary,
      file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_variable", paste0("village_summary_", var_name, ".csv"))
    )

    write_csv(
      summary_tbl,
      file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_variable", paste0("summary_", var_name, ".csv"))
    )
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) combined outputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (length(summary_list) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    bind_rows(summary_list),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "summary_all_burden_variables.csv")
  )
}

if (length(village_summary_list) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    bind_rows(village_summary_list),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_summary_all_burden_variables.csv")
  )
}

if (length(subset_summary_list) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    bind_rows(subset_summary_list),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "plot_subset_summary_all_burden_variables.csv")
  )
}

message("DONE: burden-variable village plots completed.")
message("Output folder: ", OUTDIR)
message("Key files:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "metadata_with_burden_variables.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "summary_all_burden_variables.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_summary_all_burden_variables.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "plot_subset_summary_all_burden_variables.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"))
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Summary figure for burden variables
# - one combined figure
# - violin + boxplot + jitter
# - uses village-centered sharing score
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
})

SUMMARY_DIR <- file.path(OUTDIR, "summary_figure")
dir.create(SUMMARY_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) build long table for burden variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
burden_long_list <- list()

# binary burden vars
binary_vars <- c("any_disease", "common_disease_any", "non_common_disease_any")

for (var_name in binary_vars) {
  tmp <- indiv_centered_core %>%
    mutate(
      variable = var_name,
      group = case_when(
        .data[[var_name]] == 0 ~ "No",
        .data[[var_name]] == 1 ~ "Yes",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group), is.finite(centered_sharing)) %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid,
      vil_id,
      cluster,
      variable,
      group,
      centered_sharing
    )

  burden_long_list[[var_name]] <- tmp
}

# count burden vars
count_vars <- c("disease_count_all", "disease_count_non_common")

for (var_name in count_vars) {
  tmp <- indiv_centered_core %>%
    mutate(
      variable = var_name,
      group = case_when(
        .data[[var_name]] == 0 ~ "0",
        .data[[var_name]] == 1 ~ "1",
        .data[[var_name]] >= 2 ~ "2+",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group), is.finite(centered_sharing)) %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid,
      vil_id,
      cluster,
      variable,
      group,
      centered_sharing
    )

  burden_long_list[[var_name]] <- tmp
}

burden_long <- bind_rows(burden_long_list)

# prettier labels
burden_long <- burden_long %>%
  mutate(
    variable_label = case_when(
      variable == "any_disease" ~ "Any disease",
      variable == "common_disease_any" ~ "Common disease any",
      variable == "non_common_disease_any" ~ "Non-common disease any",
      variable == "disease_count_all" ~ "Disease count all",
      variable == "disease_count_non_common" ~ "Disease count non-common",
      TRUE ~ variable
    )
  )

write_csv(
  burden_long,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "burden_long_individual_centered_sharing.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) summary table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_burden_tbl <- burden_long %>%
  group_by(variable, variable_label, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_individuals = n(),
    mean_centered = mean(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_centered = median(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_centered = sd(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  summary_burden_tbl,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "summary_burden_variables.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Wilcoxon / Kruskal tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------
test_results <- bind_rows(
  purrr::map_dfr(binary_vars, function(v) {
    d <- burden_long %>%
      filter(variable == v, !is.na(group), is.finite(centered_sharing))

    if (n_distinct(d$group) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        variable = v,
        test = "wilcox",
        p_value = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    wt <- wilcox.test(centered_sharing ~ group, data = d, exact = FALSE)

    tibble(
      variable = v,
      test = "wilcox",
      p_value = wt$p.value
    )
  }),
  purrr::map_dfr(count_vars, function(v) {
    d <- burden_long %>%
      filter(variable == v, !is.na(group), is.finite(centered_sharing))

    if (n_distinct(d$group) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        variable = v,
        test = "kruskal",
        p_value = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    kt <- kruskal.test(centered_sharing ~ group, data = d)

    tibble(
      variable = v,
      test = "kruskal",
      p_value = kt$p.value
    )
  })
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

write_csv(
  test_results,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "test_results_burden_variables.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) set factor orders
# ---------------------------------------------------------
burden_long <- burden_long %>%
  mutate(
    variable_label = factor(
      variable_label,
      levels = c(
        "Any disease",
        "Common disease any",
        "Non-common disease any",
        "Disease count all",
        "Disease count non-common"
      )
    ),
    group = case_when(
      variable %in% binary_vars ~ factor(group, levels = c("No", "Yes")),
      variable %in% count_vars ~ factor(group, levels = c("0", "1", "2+")),
      TRUE ~ factor(group)
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) combined summary plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_summary <- ggplot(burden_long, aes(x = group, y = centered_sharing)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_violin(fill = "grey90", color = "grey70", alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = group), width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.35, size = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable_label, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Village-centered within-village sharing score",
    title = "Burden-variable summary of individual within-village sharing",
    subtitle = "0 indicates the village mean"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "burden_variable_summary_figure.png"),
  p_summary,
  width = 11,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "burden_variable_summary_figure.svg"),
  p_summary,
  width = 11,
  height = 9,
  bg = "white"
)

print(p_summary)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) compact coefficient-like summary for plotting/reporting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
effect_summary_tbl <- summary_burden_tbl %>%
  select(variable, variable_label, group, n_individuals, mean_centered, median_centered, sd_centered)

write_csv(
  effect_summary_tbl,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "effect_summary_burden_variables.csv")
)

message("DONE: burden summary figure completed.")
message("Key files:")
message(" - ", file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "burden_variable_summary_figure.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "summary_burden_variables.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "test_results_burden_variables.csv"))
```
