# individual sharing burden analysis ver2
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
})

# =========================================================
# burden analysis ver2
# - individual village-centered sharing score by village
# - binary burden variables:
#     1) any_disease
#     2) common_disease_any
#     3) non_common_disease_any
#     4) disease_count_all_high         (>= 4 vs <= 3)
#     5) disease_count_non_common_high  (>= 2 vs <= 1)
#
# Common diseases are defined as prevalence >= 20%:
#   hypertension, osteoarthritis, dyslipidemia, osteoporosis, diabetes
#
# Required:
#   pw_anno  : sample1, sample2, jaccard_sim
#   metadata_ver2.csv
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("pw_anno"))
stopifnot(all(c("sample1", "sample2", "jaccard_sim") %in% names(pw_anno)))
stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_ver2.csv"))

OUTDIR <- "burden analysis ver2"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_variable"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 10, height = 5.8, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

make_cluster_factor <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))

  if (sum(!is.na(x_num)) > 0) {
    factor(x_chr, levels = unique(x_chr[order(x_num, x_chr)]))
  } else {
    factor(x_chr, levels = sort(unique(x_chr)))
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) metadata and disease sets
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("metadata_ver2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "vil_id", "cluster") %in% names(meta)))

common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

# prevalence >= 20% based common disease set
common_base_vars <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "osteoporosis",
  "diabetes"
)
common_base_vars <- common_base_vars[common_base_vars %in% all_disease_vars]

non_common_vars <- setdiff(all_disease_vars, common_base_vars)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) metadata clean + burden variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_clean <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    cluster = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(all_disease_vars), yn_to_bin)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_count_all = rowSums(across(all_of(all_disease_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    disease_count_non_common = rowSums(across(all_of(non_common_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    any_disease = if_else(disease_count_all > 0, 1, 0),
    common_disease_any = if_else(
      rowSums(across(all_of(common_base_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0
    ),
    non_common_disease_any = if_else(
      rowSums(across(all_of(non_common_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      1, 0
    ),
    disease_count_all_high = if_else(disease_count_all >= 4, 1, 0),
    disease_count_non_common_high = if_else(disease_count_non_common >= 2, 1, 0)
  )

write_csv(
  meta_clean,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "metadata_with_burden_variables.csv")
)

meta_core <- meta_clean %>%
  select(sampleid, vil_id, cluster)

village_cluster_tbl <- meta_core %>%
  distinct(vil_id, cluster)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) build core individual centered sharing score once
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pw_long <- pw_anno %>%
  transmute(
    sample1 = as.character(sample1),
    sample2 = as.character(sample2),
    jaccard_sim = as.numeric(jaccard_sim)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% select(sampleid, vil_id) %>% rename(vil1 = vil_id), by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% select(sampleid, vil_id) %>% rename(vil2 = vil_id), by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil1), !is.na(vil2)) %>%
  filter(vil1 == vil2) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2)

indiv_pairs <- bind_rows(
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample1,
      partner = sample2,
      vil_id = vil1,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    ),
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample2,
      partner = sample1,
      vil_id = vil2,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    )
)

indiv_score <- indiv_pairs %>%
  group_by(sampleid, vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_partners = n(),
    mean_within_village_sharing = mean(sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

indiv_centered_core <- indiv_score %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  mutate(
    village_mean_sharing = mean(mean_within_village_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    centered_sharing = mean_within_village_sharing - village_mean_sharing
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(meta_clean, by = c("sampleid", "vil_id"))

write_csv(
  indiv_centered_core,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "individual_centered_sharing_core.csv")
)

village_mean_check <- indiv_centered_core %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    centered_mean_check = mean(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  village_mean_check,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_centered_mean_check.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) variables to loop over
# ---------------------------------------------------------
burden_vars <- c(
  "any_disease",
  "common_disease_any",
  "non_common_disease_any",
  "disease_count_all_high",
  "disease_count_non_common_high"
)

summary_list <- list()
village_summary_list <- list()
subset_summary_list <- list()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) loop
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (var_name in burden_vars) {

  message("Running: ", var_name)

  df2 <- indiv_centered_core %>%
    mutate(
      exposure = .data[[var_name]],
      group = case_when(
        exposure == 1 ~ "Yes",
        exposure == 0 ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  villages_with_case <- df2 %>%
    filter(exposure == 1) %>%
    distinct(vil_id) %>%
    pull(vil_id)

  plot_df <- df2 %>%
    filter(vil_id %in% villages_with_case) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group), is.finite(centered_sharing))

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) next

  village_summary <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(vil_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_yes = sum(group == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_no = sum(group == "No", na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_yes = mean(centered_sharing[group == "Yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_no = mean(centered_sharing[group == "No"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_yes = median(centered_sharing[group == "Yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_no = median(centered_sharing[group == "No"], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      variable = var_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(mean_yes)

  village_order <- village_summary$vil_id

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      vil_id = factor(vil_id, levels = village_order),
      group = factor(group, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
    )

  # nicer labels for title/subtitle
  variable_label <- case_when(
    var_name == "any_disease" ~ "Any disease",
    var_name == "common_disease_any" ~ "Common disease any",
    var_name == "non_common_disease_any" ~ "Non-common disease any",
    var_name == "disease_count_all_high" ~ "Disease count all high (>=4)",
    var_name == "disease_count_non_common_high" ~ "Disease count non-common high (>=2)",
    TRUE ~ var_name
  )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = vil_id, y = centered_sharing)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.55,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      fill = "grey85",
      color = "grey65",
      alpha = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = group),
      width = 0.18,
      height = 0,
      alpha = 0.8,
      size = 2
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Village ID",
      y = "Village-centered within-village sharing score",
      title = paste0("Individual within-village sharing by village: ", variable_label),
      subtitle = "Only villages with at least one positive individual are shown; village order = cluster, then mean_yes within cluster; 0 indicates the village mean",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  save_plot_both(
    p,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", paste0("plot_by_village_", var_name)),
    width = max(8, length(village_order) * 0.45),
    height = 5.8
  )

  summary_tbl <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_individuals = n(),
      mean_centered = mean(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_centered = median(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_centered = sd(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(variable = var_name) %>%
    relocate(variable)

  summary_list[[var_name]] <- summary_tbl
  village_summary_list[[var_name]] <- village_summary
  subset_summary_list[[var_name]] <- tibble(
    variable = var_name,
    n_villages = n_distinct(plot_df$vil_id),
    n_individuals = nrow(plot_df),
    n_positive = sum(plot_df$group == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_negative = sum(plot_df$group == "No", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  write_csv(
    plot_df %>% mutate(vil_id = as.character(vil_id)),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_variable", paste0("plot_df_", var_name, ".csv"))
  )

  write_csv(
    village_summary,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_variable", paste0("village_summary_", var_name, ".csv"))
  )

  write_csv(
    summary_tbl,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "per_variable", paste0("summary_", var_name, ".csv"))
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) combined outputs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (length(summary_list) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    bind_rows(summary_list),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "summary_all_burden_variables.csv")
  )
}

if (length(village_summary_list) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    bind_rows(village_summary_list),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_summary_all_burden_variables.csv")
  )
}

if (length(subset_summary_list) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    bind_rows(subset_summary_list),
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "plot_subset_summary_all_burden_variables.csv")
  )
}

message("DONE: burden analysis ver2 completed.")
message("Output folder: ", OUTDIR)
message("Key files:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "metadata_with_burden_variables.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "summary_all_burden_variables.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_summary_all_burden_variables.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "plot_subset_summary_all_burden_variables.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"))
```
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Summary figure for burden analysis ver2
# - variables:
#     1) any_disease
#     2) common_disease_any
#     3) non_common_disease_any
#     4) disease_count_all_high
#     5) disease_count_non_common_high
# - one combined figure
# - violin + boxplot + jitter
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
})

SUMMARY_DIR <- file.path(OUTDIR, "summary_figure")
dir.create(SUMMARY_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) build long table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_vars <- c(
  "any_disease",
  "common_disease_any",
  "non_common_disease_any",
  "disease_count_all_high",
  "disease_count_non_common_high"
)

burden_long <- purrr::map_dfr(summary_vars, function(v) {
  indiv_centered_core %>%
    mutate(
      variable = v,
      group = case_when(
        .data[[v]] == 1 ~ "Yes",
        .data[[v]] == 0 ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group), is.finite(centered_sharing)) %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid,
      vil_id,
      cluster,
      variable,
      group,
      centered_sharing
    )
})

burden_long <- burden_long %>%
  mutate(
    variable_label = case_when(
      variable == "any_disease" ~ "Any disease",
      variable == "common_disease_any" ~ "Common disease any",
      variable == "non_common_disease_any" ~ "Non-common disease any",
      variable == "disease_count_all_high" ~ "Disease count all high (>=4)",
      variable == "disease_count_non_common_high" ~ "Disease count non-common high (>=2)",
      TRUE ~ variable
    ),
    variable_label = factor(
      variable_label,
      levels = c(
        "Any disease",
        "Common disease any",
        "Non-common disease any",
        "Disease count all high (>=4)",
        "Disease count non-common high (>=2)"
      )
    ),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )

write_csv(
  burden_long,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "burden_ver2_long_individual_centered_sharing.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) summary table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_tbl <- burden_long %>%
  group_by(variable, variable_label, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_individuals = n(),
    mean_centered = mean(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_centered = median(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_centered = sd(centered_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  summary_tbl,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "summary_burden_ver2_variables.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Wilcoxon tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------
test_results <- purrr::map_dfr(summary_vars, function(v) {
  d <- burden_long %>%
    filter(variable == v, !is.na(group), is.finite(centered_sharing))

  if (n_distinct(d$group) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      variable = v,
      test = "wilcox",
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  wt <- wilcox.test(centered_sharing ~ group, data = d, exact = FALSE)

  tibble(
    variable = v,
    test = "wilcox",
    p_value = wt$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

write_csv(
  test_results,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "test_results_burden_ver2_variables.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) annotation labels for facet subtitles if needed
# ---------------------------------------------------------
facet_n_tbl <- burden_long %>%
  group_by(variable, variable_label, group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  rename(n_no = No, n_yes = Yes)

write_csv(
  facet_n_tbl,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "facet_group_counts_burden_ver2.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) combined summary plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_summary <- ggplot(burden_long, aes(x = group, y = centered_sharing)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_violin(fill = "grey90", color = "grey70", alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = group), width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.35, size = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable_label, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Village-centered within-village sharing score",
    title = "Burden analysis ver2 summary",
    subtitle = "0 indicates the village mean"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_summary,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "burden_analysis_ver2_summary_figure"),
  width = 11,
  height = 8.5
)

print(p_summary)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) optional compact effect-like table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
effect_tbl <- summary_tbl %>%
  select(variable, variable_label, group, n_individuals, mean_centered, median_centered, sd_centered)

write_csv(
  effect_tbl,
  file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "effect_summary_burden_ver2_variables.csv")
)

message("DONE: burden analysis ver2 summary figure completed.")
message("Key files:")
message(" - ", file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "burden_analysis_ver2_summary_figure.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "summary_burden_ver2_variables.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "test_results_burden_ver2_variables.csv"))
```

#bottom1 pattern
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
})

# =========================================================
# Bottom1 pattern exploration (corrected version)
#
# Questions:
# 1) What disease / disease-pattern does the bottom1 individual
#    in each village have?
# 2) If another person in the same village has the same pattern,
#    is that person also below 0 or above 0?
#
# Required:
#   pw_anno  : sample1, sample2, jaccard_sim
#   metadata_ver2.csv
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("pw_anno"))
stopifnot(all(c("sample1", "sample2", "jaccard_sim") %in% names(pw_anno)))
stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_ver2.csv"))

OUTDIR <- "bottom1 pattern exploration"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

make_pattern_string <- function(df_row, disease_vars) {
  yes_vars <- disease_vars[which(df_row[disease_vars] == 1)]
  if (length(yes_vars) == 0) return("none")
  paste(sort(yes_vars), collapse = ";")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) metadata and disease list
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("metadata_ver2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "vil_id") %in% names(meta)))

common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

meta_clean <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(all_disease_vars), yn_to_bin)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_count_all = rowSums(across(all_of(all_disease_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

write_csv(
  meta_clean,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "metadata_with_binary_diseases.csv")
)

meta_core <- meta_clean %>%
  select(sampleid, vil_id)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) individual village-centered sharing score
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pw_long <- pw_anno %>%
  transmute(
    sample1 = as.character(sample1),
    sample2 = as.character(sample2),
    jaccard_sim = as.numeric(jaccard_sim)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% rename(vil1 = vil_id), by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% rename(vil2 = vil_id), by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil1), !is.na(vil2)) %>%
  filter(vil1 == vil2) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2)

indiv_pairs <- bind_rows(
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample1,
      partner = sample2,
      vil_id = vil1,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    ),
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample2,
      partner = sample1,
      vil_id = vil2,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    )
)

indiv_score <- indiv_pairs %>%
  group_by(sampleid, vil_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_partners = n(),
    mean_within_village_sharing = mean(sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

indiv_centered <- indiv_score %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  arrange(mean_within_village_sharing, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    village_mean_sharing = mean(mean_within_village_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    centered_sharing = mean_within_village_sharing - village_mean_sharing
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(meta_clean, by = c("sampleid", "vil_id"))

# add rank and below/above flag within village
indiv_centered <- indiv_centered %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  arrange(centered_sharing, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_in_village = row_number(),
    below_zero = centered_sharing < 0,
    above_zero = centered_sharing > 0,
    zero_flag = centered_sharing == 0
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# disease pattern string
indiv_centered$disease_pattern <- apply(
  indiv_centered[, all_disease_vars, drop = FALSE],
  1,
  function(x) {
    yes_vars <- all_disease_vars[which(x == 1)]
    if (length(yes_vars) == 0) "none" else paste(sort(yes_vars), collapse = ";")
  }
)

write_csv(
  indiv_centered,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "individual_centered_sharing_with_patterns.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) bottom1 per village
# ---------------------------------------------------------
bottom1_tbl <- indiv_centered %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = centered_sharing, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    vil_id,
    sampleid_bottom1 = sampleid,
    rank_in_village_bottom1 = rank_in_village,
    centered_sharing_bottom1 = centered_sharing,
    mean_within_village_sharing_bottom1 = mean_within_village_sharing,
    disease_count_all_bottom1 = disease_count_all,
    disease_pattern_bottom1 = disease_pattern
  )

write_csv(
  bottom1_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_bottom1_individuals.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) find same-pattern individuals in the same village
# ---------------------------------------------------------
same_pattern_matches <- bottom1_tbl %>%
  select(vil_id, sampleid_bottom1, disease_pattern_bottom1) %>%
  left_join(
    indiv_centered %>%
      select(
        vil_id, sampleid, centered_sharing, mean_within_village_sharing,
        rank_in_village, below_zero, above_zero, zero_flag,
        disease_count_all, disease_pattern
      ),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(disease_pattern == disease_pattern_bottom1) %>%
  mutate(
    is_bottom1 = sampleid == sampleid_bottom1
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    vil_id,
    disease_pattern = disease_pattern_bottom1,
    sampleid_bottom1,
    sampleid_match = sampleid,
    is_bottom1,
    rank_in_village_match = rank_in_village,
    centered_sharing_match = centered_sharing,
    mean_within_village_sharing_match = mean_within_village_sharing,
    below_zero_match = below_zero,
    above_zero_match = above_zero,
    zero_flag_match = zero_flag,
    disease_count_all_match = disease_count_all
  ) %>%
  arrange(vil_id, rank_in_village_match)

write_csv(
  same_pattern_matches,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_bottom1_same_pattern_matches.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) summary of same-pattern matches within village
# ---------------------------------------------------------
same_pattern_summary <- same_pattern_matches %>%
  group_by(vil_id, disease_pattern, sampleid_bottom1) %>%
  summarise(
    n_same_pattern_total = n(),
    n_same_pattern_other = sum(!is_bottom1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_same_pattern_other_below0 = sum(!is_bottom1 & below_zero_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_same_pattern_other_above0 = sum(!is_bottom1 & above_zero_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_same_pattern_other_eq0 = sum(!is_bottom1 & zero_flag_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_rank_same_pattern = min(rank_in_village_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rank_same_pattern = max(rank_in_village_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_same_pattern_other), vil_id)

write_csv(
  same_pattern_summary,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_bottom1_same_pattern_summary.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) top patterns among village bottom1 individuals
# ---------------------------------------------------------
bottom1_pattern_top <- bottom1_tbl %>%
  count(disease_pattern_bottom1, name = "n_bottom1_villages") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_bottom1_villages), disease_pattern_bottom1)

write_csv(
  bottom1_pattern_top,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_bottom1_pattern_top_counts.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) optional: same exact pattern anywhere in dataset
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pattern_global_summary <- indiv_centered %>%
  count(disease_pattern, name = "n_total_pattern") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_total_pattern), disease_pattern)

write_csv(
  pattern_global_summary,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "pattern_global_counts.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) merged overview table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
bottom1_overview <- bottom1_tbl %>%
  left_join(
    same_pattern_summary,
    by = c(
      "vil_id",
      "sampleid_bottom1",
      "disease_pattern_bottom1" = "disease_pattern"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    pattern_global_summary,
    by = c("disease_pattern_bottom1" = "disease_pattern")
  ) %>%
  arrange(centered_sharing_bottom1)

write_csv(
  bottom1_overview,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_bottom1_overview.csv")
)

message("DONE: bottom1 pattern exploration completed.")
message("Key files:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_bottom1_individuals.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_bottom1_same_pattern_matches.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_bottom1_same_pattern_summary.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_bottom1_pattern_top_counts.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_bottom1_overview.csv"))
```

#below vs above disease analysis
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(forcats)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
})

# =========================================================
# Below0 vs Above0 disease analysis
# - village-centered within-village sharing score 기준
# - below0 (< 0) vs above0 (> 0) 그룹의 질환 prevalence 비교
#
# Required:
#   pw_anno object in environment
#   metadata_ver2.csv in working directory
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) checks and output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("pw_anno"))
stopifnot(all(c("sample1", "sample2", "jaccard_sim") %in% names(pw_anno)))
stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_ver2.csv"))

OUTDIR <- "below_above_disease_analysis"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

safe_wilcox_against_zero <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  if (length(unique(x)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  out <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(x, mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  out
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) disease variable definitions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

pretty_disease_labels <- c(
  hypertension = "Hypertension",
  dyslipidemia = "Dyslipidemia",
  cancer = "Cancer",
  cerebrovascular_disease = "Cerebrovascular disease",
  osteoarthritis = "Osteoarthritis",
  diabetes = "Diabetes",
  thyroid_disease = "Thyroid disease",
  skin_disease = "Skin disease",
  liver_cirrhosis = "Liver cirrhosis",
  chronic_kidney_failure = "Chronic kidney failure",
  cardiovascular_disease = "Cardiovascular disease",
  dementia = "Dementia",
  rheumatoid_arthritis = "Rheumatoid arthritis",
  osteoporosis = "Osteoporosis",
  chronic_respiratory_disease = "Chronic respiratory disease",
  parkinsons_disease = "Parkinson's disease",
  bowel_disease = "Bowel disease",
  depression = "Depression"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) read and clean metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("metadata_ver2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "vil_id") %in% names(meta)))

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

meta_clean <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id)
  )

if ("cluster" %in% names(meta_clean)) {
  meta_clean <- meta_clean %>%
    mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster))
} else {
  meta_clean$cluster <- NA_character_
}

meta_clean <- meta_clean %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(all_disease_vars), yn_to_bin)
  ) %>%
  distinct(sampleid, .keep_all = TRUE)

write_csv(
  meta_clean,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "cleaned_metadata_used.csv")
)

meta_core <- meta_clean %>%
  select(sampleid, vil_id, cluster)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) compute individual village-centered within-village sharing score
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pw_long <- pw_anno %>%
  transmute(
    sample1 = as.character(sample1),
    sample2 = as.character(sample2),
    jaccard_sim = as.numeric(jaccard_sim)
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% rename(vil1 = vil_id, clu1 = cluster),
            by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")) %>%
  left_join(meta_core %>% rename(vil2 = vil_id, clu2 = cluster),
            by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil1), !is.na(vil2)) %>%
  filter(vil1 == vil2) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2)

# pairwise table may have each unordered pair only once,
# so create both directions explicitly
indiv_pairs <- bind_rows(
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample1,
      partner = sample2,
      vil_id = vil1,
      cluster = clu1,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    ),
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample2,
      partner = sample1,
      vil_id = vil2,
      cluster = clu2,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    )
)

indiv_score <- indiv_pairs %>%
  group_by(sampleid, vil_id, cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_partners = n(),
    mean_within_village_sharing = mean(sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

indiv_centered <- indiv_score %>%
  group_by(vil_id) %>%
  mutate(
    village_mean_sharing = mean(mean_within_village_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    centered_sharing = mean_within_village_sharing - village_mean_sharing
  ) %>%
  arrange(centered_sharing, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_in_village = row_number(),
    group_0 = case_when(
      centered_sharing < 0 ~ "below0",
      centered_sharing > 0 ~ "above0",
      TRUE ~ "eq0"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(meta_clean, by = c("sampleid", "vil_id", "cluster"))

write_csv(
  indiv_centered,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "individual_centered_sharing_scores.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) disease prevalence difference: below0 vs above0 within each village
# ---------------------------------------------------------
indiv_long <- indiv_centered %>%
  filter(group_0 %in% c("below0", "above0")) %>%
  select(sampleid, vil_id, cluster, group_0, centered_sharing, all_of(all_disease_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(all_disease_vars),
    names_to = "disease_var",
    values_to = "disease_yes"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(disease_yes))

# group-wise counts and prevalence
village_disease_group_tbl <- indiv_long %>%
  group_by(vil_id, cluster, disease_var, group_0) %>%
  summarise(
    n_individuals = n(),
    n_yes = sum(disease_yes == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_no = sum(disease_yes == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prevalence = n_yes / n_individuals,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# wide format for below0 / above0 comparison
village_disease_diff <- village_disease_group_tbl %>%
  mutate(group_0 = factor(group_0, levels = c("below0", "above0"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group_0,
    values_from = c(n_individuals, n_yes, n_no, prevalence),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{group_0}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    analyzable = !is.na(prevalence_below0) & !is.na(prevalence_above0) &
      n_individuals_below0 > 0 & n_individuals_above0 > 0,
    delta_prev = ifelse(analyzable, prevalence_below0 - prevalence_above0, NA_real_),
    direction = case_when(
      is.na(delta_prev) ~ NA_character_,
      delta_prev > 0 ~ "below0_enriched",
      delta_prev < 0 ~ "above0_enriched",
      TRUE ~ "equal"
    ),
    disease_label = recode(disease_var, !!!pretty_disease_labels, .default = disease_var)
  ) %>%
  arrange(disease_var, cluster, vil_id)

write_csv(
  village_disease_diff,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_disease_prevalence_below_vs_above.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) disease-level summary across villages
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_summary <- village_disease_diff %>%
  filter(analyzable) %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_villages_testable = n(),
    n_delta_positive = sum(delta_prev > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_delta_negative = sum(delta_prev < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_delta_zero = sum(delta_prev == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_positive_among_nonzero = ifelse(
      (n_delta_positive + n_delta_negative) > 0,
      n_delta_positive / (n_delta_positive + n_delta_negative),
      NA_real_
    ),
    mean_delta_prev = mean(delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_delta_prev = median(delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_delta_prev = sd(delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_delta_prev = quantile(delta_prev, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75_delta_prev = quantile(delta_prev, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_delta_prev = min(delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_delta_prev = max(delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_wilcox = safe_wilcox_against_zero(delta_prev),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_wilcox, method = "BH"),
    highlight = p_adj_bh < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_delta_prev))

write_csv(
  disease_summary,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_summary_across_villages.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) plotting tables and ordering
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# disease order by median delta_prev
disease_order <- disease_summary %>%
  arrange(median_delta_prev) %>%
  pull(disease_label)

# village ordering
village_order_tbl <- village_disease_diff %>%
  filter(analyzable) %>%
  group_by(vil_id, cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_delta_all_diseases = mean(delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (all(is.na(village_order_tbl$cluster))) {
  village_levels <- village_order_tbl %>%
    arrange(mean_delta_all_diseases, vil_id) %>%
    pull(vil_id)
} else {
  village_levels <- village_order_tbl %>%
    arrange(cluster, mean_delta_all_diseases, vil_id) %>%
    pull(vil_id)
}

heatmap_tbl <- village_disease_diff %>%
  filter(analyzable) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label = factor(disease_label, levels = disease_order),
    vil_id = factor(vil_id, levels = village_levels)
  )

summary_plot_tbl <- disease_summary %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label = factor(disease_label, levels = disease_order)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) figure 1: heatmap by village and disease
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (all(is.na(heatmap_tbl$cluster))) {
  p_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_tbl, aes(x = vil_id, y = disease_label, fill = delta_prev)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#4575B4",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#D73027",
      midpoint = 0,
      name = "prev_below0 -\nprev_above0"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Village ID",
      y = NULL,
      title = "Village-level disease prevalence differences by within-village sharing position",
      subtitle = "Positive values indicate higher disease prevalence among individuals with centered sharing < 0"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
    )
} else {
  heatmap_tbl$cluster <- factor(heatmap_tbl$cluster)

  p_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_tbl, aes(x = vil_id, y = disease_label, fill = delta_prev)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#4575B4",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#D73027",
      midpoint = 0,
      name = "prev_below0 -\nprev_above0"
    ) +
    facet_grid(. ~ cluster, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    labs(
      x = "Village ID",
      y = NULL,
      title = "Village-level disease prevalence differences by within-village sharing position",
      subtitle = "Positive values indicate higher disease prevalence among individuals with centered sharing < 0"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

save_plot_both(
  p_heatmap,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "heatmap_delta_prev_by_village_and_disease"),
  width = 16,
  height = 8
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) figure 2: disease summary dot plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_summary <- ggplot(summary_plot_tbl, aes(x = median_delta_prev, y = disease_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = q25_delta_prev, xmax = q75_delta_prev),
    height = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = n_villages_testable, color = highlight),
    shape = 16
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "firebrick", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Testable villages") +
  labs(
    x = "Median (prev_below0 - prev_above0) across villages",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Disease-level summary of within-village prevalence differences",
    subtitle = "Error bars show IQR across villages. Red points indicate BH-adjusted P < 0.05 from exploratory Wilcoxon tests."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_summary,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_summary_dotplot"),
  width = 9,
  height = 7.5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) extra compact table for easier manuscript use
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_summary_compact <- disease_summary %>%
  select(
    disease_var, disease_label,
    n_villages_testable,
    n_delta_positive, n_delta_negative, n_delta_zero,
    prop_positive_among_nonzero,
    mean_delta_prev, median_delta_prev,
    q25_delta_prev, q75_delta_prev,
    p_wilcox, p_adj_bh, highlight
  )

write_csv(
  disease_summary_compact,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_summary_compact.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) console message
# ---------------------------------------------------------
message("DONE: below0 vs above0 disease analysis complete.")
message("Key outputs:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "individual_centered_sharing_scores.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_disease_prevalence_below_vs_above.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_summary_across_villages.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "heatmap_delta_prev_by_village_and_disease.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_summary_dotplot.png"))
```

#Village-level sharing vs disease correlation analysis
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(forcats)
})

# =========================================================
# Village-level sharing vs disease correlation analysis
# complete version with:
#   1) all-village correlations
#   2) positive-only correlations
#   3) all-village summary plot
#   4) positive-only summary plot
#   5) combined summary plot (all-village vs positive-only)
#
# Questions:
# 1) Is higher village mean sharing associated with higher/lower
#    prevalence of each specific disease?
# 2) Is higher village mean sharing associated with higher/lower
#    overall disease burden?
#
# Included variables:
# - all disease-specific prevalence variables
# - mean_disease_count_all
#
# Required:
#   pw_anno object in environment
#   metadata_ver2.csv in working directory
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) checks and output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("pw_anno"))
stopifnot(all(c("sample1", "sample2", "jaccard_sim") %in% names(pw_anno)))
stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_ver2.csv"))

OUTDIR <- "village_sharing_disease_correlation_final"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "all_scatterplots_all_villages"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "all_scatterplots_positive_only"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 6.8, height = 5.5, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

safe_spearman <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]

  if (length(x) < 5 || length(unique(x)) < 3 || length(unique(y)) < 3) {
    return(tibble(rho = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_, n = length(x)))
  }

  out <- tryCatch(
    cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(out)) {
    tibble(rho = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_, n = length(x))
  } else {
    tibble(
      rho = unname(out$estimate),
      p_value = out$p.value,
      n = length(x)
    )
  }
}

safe_lm_stats <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]

  if (length(x) < 5 || length(unique(x)) < 3 || length(unique(y)) < 3) {
    return(tibble(slope = NA_real_, r_squared = NA_real_))
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    lm(y ~ x),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    tibble(slope = NA_real_, r_squared = NA_real_)
  } else {
    tibble(
      slope = unname(coef(fit)[2]),
      r_squared = summary(fit)$r.squared
    )
  }
}

get_metric_df <- function(df, metric_var, positive_only = FALSE) {
  out <- df %>%
    filter(is.finite(village_mean_sharing), is.finite(.data[[metric_var]]))

  if (positive_only) {
    out <- out %>% filter(.data[[metric_var]] > 0)
  }

  out
}

make_scatter_plot <- function(plot_df, xvar, xlab, title_txt, subtitle_txt) {
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = village_mean_sharing)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(
      x = xlab,
      y = "Village mean within-village sharing",
      title = title_txt,
      subtitle = subtitle_txt
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  if (
    nrow(plot_df) >= 5 &&
    length(unique(plot_df[[xvar]])) >= 3 &&
    length(unique(plot_df$village_mean_sharing)) >= 3
  ) {
    p <- p + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8)
  }

  p
}

calc_metric_stats <- function(df, metric_var, metric_label) {
  x <- df[[metric_var]]
  y <- df$village_mean_sharing

  sp <- safe_spearman(x, y)
  lm_stats <- safe_lm_stats(x, y)

  tibble(
    metric_var = metric_var,
    metric_label = metric_label,
    rho = sp$rho,
    p_value = sp$p_value,
    n_villages = sp$n,
    slope = lm_stats$slope,
    r_squared = lm_stats$r_squared
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) disease variable definitions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

pretty_labels <- c(
  hypertension_prev = "Hypertension prevalence",
  dyslipidemia_prev = "Dyslipidemia prevalence",
  cancer_prev = "Cancer prevalence",
  cerebrovascular_disease_prev = "Cerebrovascular disease prevalence",
  osteoarthritis_prev = "Osteoarthritis prevalence",
  diabetes_prev = "Diabetes prevalence",
  thyroid_disease_prev = "Thyroid disease prevalence",
  skin_disease_prev = "Skin disease prevalence",
  liver_cirrhosis_prev = "Liver cirrhosis prevalence",
  chronic_kidney_failure_prev = "Chronic kidney failure prevalence",
  cardiovascular_disease_prev = "Cardiovascular disease prevalence",
  dementia_prev = "Dementia prevalence",
  rheumatoid_arthritis_prev = "Rheumatoid arthritis prevalence",
  osteoporosis_prev = "Osteoporosis prevalence",
  chronic_respiratory_disease_prev = "Chronic respiratory disease prevalence",
  parkinsons_disease_prev = "Parkinson's disease prevalence",
  bowel_disease_prev = "Bowel disease prevalence",
  depression_prev = "Depression prevalence",
  mean_disease_count_all = "Mean disease count"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) read and clean metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("metadata_ver2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "vil_id") %in% names(meta)))

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

meta_clean <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id)
  )

if ("cluster" %in% names(meta_clean)) {
  meta_clean <- meta_clean %>% mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster))
} else {
  meta_clean$cluster <- NA_character_
}

meta_clean <- meta_clean %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(all_disease_vars), yn_to_bin)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_count_all = rowSums(across(all_of(all_disease_vars)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  distinct(sampleid, .keep_all = TRUE)

write_csv(
  meta_clean,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "cleaned_metadata_with_disease_count.csv")
)

meta_core <- meta_clean %>%
  select(sampleid, vil_id, cluster)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) compute indiv_score
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pw_long <- pw_anno %>%
  transmute(
    sample1 = as.character(sample1),
    sample2 = as.character(sample2),
    jaccard_sim = as.numeric(jaccard_sim)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_core %>% rename(vil1 = vil_id, clu1 = cluster),
    by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_core %>% rename(vil2 = vil_id, clu2 = cluster),
    by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vil1), !is.na(vil2)) %>%
  filter(vil1 == vil2) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2)

indiv_pairs <- bind_rows(
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample1,
      partner = sample2,
      vil_id = vil1,
      cluster = clu1,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    ),
  pw_long %>%
    transmute(
      sampleid = sample2,
      partner = sample1,
      vil_id = vil2,
      cluster = clu2,
      sharing = jaccard_sim
    )
)

indiv_score <- indiv_pairs %>%
  group_by(sampleid, vil_id, cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_partners = n(),
    mean_within_village_sharing = mean(sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  indiv_score,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "individual_mean_within_village_sharing.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) village-level sharing summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_sharing <- indiv_score %>%
  group_by(vil_id, cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_individuals = n(),
    village_mean_sharing = mean(mean_within_village_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    village_median_sharing = median(mean_within_village_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    village_sd_sharing = sd(mean_within_village_sharing, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(village_mean_sharing)) %>%
  mutate(
    sharing_rank_desc = row_number()
  )

write_csv(
  village_sharing,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_sharing_summary.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) village-level disease metrics
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_disease_prev <- meta_clean %>%
  group_by(vil_id, cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(all_disease_vars),
      ~ mean(.x == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{.col}_prev"
    ),
    mean_disease_count_all = mean(disease_count_all, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  village_disease_prev,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_disease_metrics.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) join village-level sharing + disease metrics
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_level_tbl <- village_sharing %>%
  left_join(village_disease_prev, by = c("vil_id", "cluster"))

write_csv(
  village_level_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_joined_sharing_and_disease_metrics.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) metric list
# ---------------------------------------------------------
metric_vars <- c(
  paste0(all_disease_vars, "_prev"),
  "mean_disease_count_all"
)

nonzero_tbl <- map_dfr(metric_vars, function(v) {
  tibble(
    metric_var = v,
    n_nonzero_villages = sum(is.finite(village_level_tbl[[v]]) & village_level_tbl[[v]] > 0)
  )
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) correlation tables
#     A) all villages
#     B) positive-only villages (>0)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cor_tbl_all <- map_dfr(metric_vars, function(v) {
  plot_df <- get_metric_df(village_level_tbl, v, positive_only = FALSE)
  calc_metric_stats(
    df = plot_df,
    metric_var = v,
    metric_label = recode(v, !!!pretty_labels, .default = v)
  )
}) %>%
  left_join(nonzero_tbl, by = "metric_var") %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    abs_rho = abs(rho)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_rho))

cor_tbl_positive_only <- map_dfr(metric_vars, function(v) {
  plot_df <- get_metric_df(village_level_tbl, v, positive_only = TRUE)
  calc_metric_stats(
    df = plot_df,
    metric_var = v,
    metric_label = recode(v, !!!pretty_labels, .default = v)
  )
}) %>%
  left_join(nonzero_tbl, by = "metric_var") %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    abs_rho = abs(rho)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_rho))

write_csv(
  cor_tbl_all,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlations_all_villages.csv")
)

write_csv(
  cor_tbl_positive_only,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlations_positive_only.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) scatter plots
#      A) all villages
#      B) positive-only villages (>0)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# ---- A. all villages ----
for (i in seq_len(nrow(cor_tbl_all))) {
  v <- cor_tbl_all$metric_var[i]
  lab <- cor_tbl_all$metric_label[i]
  rho <- cor_tbl_all$rho[i]
  p <- cor_tbl_all$p_value[i]
  p_adj <- cor_tbl_all$p_adj_bh[i]
  slope <- cor_tbl_all$slope[i]
  r2 <- cor_tbl_all$r_squared[i]
  n_used <- cor_tbl_all$n_villages[i]

  plot_df <- get_metric_df(village_level_tbl, v, positive_only = FALSE)

  subtitle_txt <- paste0(
    "All villages included\n",
    "Spearman rho = ", ifelse(is.finite(rho), sprintf("%.3f", rho), "NA"),
    ", raw p = ", ifelse(is.finite(p), format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 1e-300), "NA"),
    ", BH-adjusted p = ", ifelse(is.finite(p_adj), format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 1e-300), "NA"),
    "\nLinear slope = ", ifelse(is.finite(slope), sprintf("%.3f", slope), "NA"),
    ", R² = ", ifelse(is.finite(r2), sprintf("%.3f", r2), "NA"),
    ", n villages = ", n_used
  )

  p_scatter <- make_scatter_plot(
    plot_df = plot_df,
    xvar = v,
    xlab = lab,
    title_txt = paste0("Village sharing vs ", lab),
    subtitle_txt = subtitle_txt
  )

  save_plot_both(
    p_scatter,
    file.path(
      OUTDIR, "plots", "all_scatterplots_all_villages",
      paste0(sprintf("%02d", i), "_", v, "_all_villages")
    )
  )
}

# ---- B. positive-only villages ----
for (i in seq_len(nrow(cor_tbl_positive_only))) {
  v <- cor_tbl_positive_only$metric_var[i]
  lab <- cor_tbl_positive_only$metric_label[i]
  rho <- cor_tbl_positive_only$rho[i]
  p <- cor_tbl_positive_only$p_value[i]
  p_adj <- cor_tbl_positive_only$p_adj_bh[i]
  slope <- cor_tbl_positive_only$slope[i]
  r2 <- cor_tbl_positive_only$r_squared[i]
  n_used <- cor_tbl_positive_only$n_villages[i]

  plot_df <- get_metric_df(village_level_tbl, v, positive_only = TRUE)

  subtitle_txt <- paste0(
    "Only villages with metric > 0 included\n",
    "Spearman rho = ", ifelse(is.finite(rho), sprintf("%.3f", rho), "NA"),
    ", raw p = ", ifelse(is.finite(p), format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 1e-300), "NA"),
    ", BH-adjusted p = ", ifelse(is.finite(p_adj), format.pval(p_adj, digits = 3, eps = 1e-300), "NA"),
    "\nLinear slope = ", ifelse(is.finite(slope), sprintf("%.3f", slope), "NA"),
    ", R² = ", ifelse(is.finite(r2), sprintf("%.3f", r2), "NA"),
    ", n villages = ", n_used
  )

  p_scatter <- make_scatter_plot(
    plot_df = plot_df,
    xvar = v,
    xlab = lab,
    title_txt = paste0("Village sharing vs ", lab, " (>0 villages only)"),
    subtitle_txt = subtitle_txt
  )

  save_plot_both(
    p_scatter,
    file.path(
      OUTDIR, "plots", "all_scatterplots_positive_only",
      paste0(sprintf("%02d", i), "_", v, "_positive_only")
    )
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) summary correlation plot
#     all-village version
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_tbl <- cor_tbl_all %>%
  filter(is.finite(rho)) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label_with_n = paste0(metric_label, " [", n_nonzero_villages, "]"),
    metric_label_with_n = fct_reorder(metric_label_with_n, rho)
  )

p_summary <- ggplot(plot_tbl, aes(x = rho, y = metric_label_with_n)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(color = p_adj_bh < 0.05), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "firebrick", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman rho with village mean sharing",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Village-level correlations between sharing and disease metrics",
    subtitle = "All-village analysis. Labels in brackets indicate the number of villages with metric > 0. Red points indicate BH-adjusted P < 0.05."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_summary,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_correlation_summary"),
  width = 9.5,
  height = 8.5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) summary correlation plot
#     positive-only version
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_tbl_positive <- cor_tbl_positive_only %>%
  filter(is.finite(rho)) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label_with_n = paste0(metric_label, " [", n_nonzero_villages, "]"),
    metric_label_with_n = forcats::fct_reorder(metric_label_with_n, rho)
  )

p_summary_positive <- ggplot(plot_tbl_positive, aes(x = rho, y = metric_label_with_n)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(color = p_adj_bh < 0.05), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "firebrick", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman rho with village mean sharing",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Village-level correlations between sharing and disease metrics",
    subtitle = "Positive-only analysis. Labels in brackets indicate the number of villages included in the positive-only analysis (metric > 0). Red points indicate BH-adjusted P < 0.05."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_summary_positive,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_correlation_summary_positive_only"),
  width = 9.5,
  height = 8.5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) combined summary plot
#     all villages vs positive-only
#     open point   = BH-adjusted P >= 0.05
#     filled point = BH-adjusted P < 0.05
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_wide <- cor_tbl_all %>%
  select(metric_var, metric_label, rho, p_adj_bh, n_nonzero_villages) %>%
  rename(
    rho_all = rho,
    p_adj_bh_all = p_adj_bh,
    n_nonzero_villages_all = n_nonzero_villages
  ) %>%
  full_join(
    cor_tbl_positive_only %>%
      select(metric_var, metric_label, rho, p_adj_bh, n_nonzero_villages) %>%
      rename(
        rho_pos = rho,
        p_adj_bh_pos = p_adj_bh,
        n_nonzero_villages_pos = n_nonzero_villages
      ),
    by = c("metric_var", "metric_label")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_nonzero_villages = coalesce(n_nonzero_villages_all, n_nonzero_villages_pos),
    metric_label_n = if_else(
      is.na(n_nonzero_villages),
      metric_label,
      paste0(metric_label, " [", n_nonzero_villages, "]")
    )
  )

metric_order <- plot_wide %>%
  arrange(rho_all) %>%
  pull(metric_label_n)

plot_wide <- plot_wide %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label_n = factor(metric_label_n, levels = metric_order)
  )

plot_long <- plot_wide %>%
  select(
    metric_var, metric_label_n,
    rho_all, rho_pos,
    p_adj_bh_all, p_adj_bh_pos
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(rho_all, rho_pos),
    names_to = "analysis",
    values_to = "rho"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = case_when(
      analysis == "rho_all" ~ p_adj_bh_all,
      analysis == "rho_pos" ~ p_adj_bh_pos,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    analysis = recode(
      analysis,
      rho_all = "All villages",
      rho_pos = "Positive-only"
    ),
    sig = if_else(!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < 0.05, "sig", "ns"),
    fill_group = case_when(
      analysis == "All villages"  & sig == "sig" ~ "all_sig",
      analysis == "All villages"  & sig == "ns"  ~ "all_ns",
      analysis == "Positive-only" & sig == "sig" ~ "pos_sig",
      analysis == "Positive-only" & sig == "ns"  ~ "pos_ns",
      TRUE ~ "all_ns"
    )
  )

p_summary_combined <- ggplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_segment(
    data = plot_wide,
    aes(
      x = rho_all, xend = rho_pos,
      y = metric_label_n, yend = metric_label_n
    ),
    color = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_long,
    aes(
      x = rho,
      y = metric_label_n,
      color = analysis,
      fill = fill_group
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.8,
    stroke = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "All villages" = "black",
      "Positive-only" = "royalblue"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      all_sig = "black",
      all_ns  = "white",
      pos_sig = "royalblue",
      pos_ns  = "white"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman rho with village mean sharing",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Village-level correlations between sharing and disease metrics",
    subtitle = "Black = all villages, blue = positive-only. Filled points indicate BH-adjusted P < 0.05; open points indicate BH-adjusted P >= 0.05. Labels in brackets indicate the number of villages with metric > 0."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_summary_combined,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_correlation_summary_combined"),
  width = 10,
  height = 8.5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) compact tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
compact_tbl_all <- cor_tbl_all %>%
  select(
    metric_var, metric_label,
    n_villages, n_nonzero_villages,
    rho, p_value, p_adj_bh,
    slope, r_squared
  )

compact_tbl_positive_only <- cor_tbl_positive_only %>%
  select(
    metric_var, metric_label,
    n_villages, n_nonzero_villages,
    rho, p_value, p_adj_bh,
    slope, r_squared
  )

write_csv(
  compact_tbl_all,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlation_compact_all_villages.csv")
)

write_csv(
  compact_tbl_positive_only,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlation_compact_positive_only.csv")
)

write_csv(
  plot_wide,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlation_summary_combined_wide.csv")
)

write_csv(
  plot_long,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlation_summary_combined_long.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 15) console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
message("DONE: village-level sharing vs disease correlation analysis complete.")
message("Key outputs:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_sharing_summary.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_disease_metrics.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlations_all_villages.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlations_positive_only.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlation_compact_all_villages.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlation_compact_positive_only.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlation_summary_combined_wide.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_correlation_summary_combined_long.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_correlation_summary.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_correlation_summary_positive_only.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_correlation_summary_combined.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "all_scatterplots_all_villages"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "all_scatterplots_positive_only"))
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Step 1. Burden-adjusted village-level regression
# Model for each disease:
#   village_mean_sharing ~ disease_prevalence + mean_disease_count_all
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(broom)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(forcats)
  library(readr)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("village_level_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("all_disease_vars"))
stopifnot(exists("pretty_labels"))
stopifnot(exists("OUTDIR"))
stopifnot(exists("save_plot_both"))

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
safe_fit_lm <- function(df, disease_var) {
  xvar <- paste0(disease_var, "_prev")

  dat <- df %>%
    select(village_mean_sharing, mean_disease_count_all, all_of(xvar)) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(village_mean_sharing),
      is.finite(mean_disease_count_all),
      is.finite(.data[[xvar]])
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < 10 || length(unique(dat[[xvar]])) < 3) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    lm(as.formula(paste0("village_mean_sharing ~ ", xvar, " + mean_disease_count_all")), data = dat),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  list(
    fit = fit,
    data = dat,
    xvar = xvar
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# run one model per disease
# ---------------------------------------------------------
reg_tbl <- map_dfr(all_disease_vars, function(dv) {
  res <- safe_fit_lm(village_level_tbl, dv)

  if (is.null(res)) {
    return(tibble(
      disease_var = dv,
      metric_label = recode(paste0(dv, "_prev"), !!!pretty_labels, .default = dv),
      term = NA_character_,
      estimate = NA_real_,
      std.error = NA_real_,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_,
      conf.low = NA_real_,
      conf.high = NA_real_,
      n_villages = NA_integer_,
      r_squared = NA_real_,
      adj_r_squared = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  fit <- res$fit
  dat <- res$data
  xvar <- res$xvar

  tidy_fit <- broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      disease_var = dv,
      metric_label = recode(xvar, !!!pretty_labels, .default = dv),
      n_villages = nrow(dat),
      r_squared = summary(fit)$r.squared,
      adj_r_squared = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
    )

  tidy_fit
}) %>%
  relocate(disease_var, metric_label, term)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# focus table: disease term only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
reg_tbl_disease <- reg_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(term)) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "_prev$")) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_bh, p.value)

write_csv(
  reg_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_full.csv")
)

write_csv(
  reg_tbl_disease,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_disease_terms.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# summary plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_tbl <- reg_tbl_disease %>%
  filter(is.finite(estimate)) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label = fct_reorder(metric_label, estimate)
  )

p_reg <- ggplot(plot_tbl, aes(x = estimate, y = metric_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = p_adj_bh < 0.05), shape = 21, size = 2.8, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "white"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Burden-adjusted regression coefficient for disease prevalence",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Village-level regression adjusted for mean disease count",
    subtitle = "Model: village_mean_sharing ~ disease prevalence + mean_disease_count_all. Filled points indicate BH-adjusted P < 0.05."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_reg,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_summary"),
  width = 9,
  height = 8
)

message("DONE: burden-adjusted village-level regression.")
message("Key outputs:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_full.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_disease_terms.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_summary.png"))
```

#Burden-adjusted village-level regression
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Step 1. Burden-adjusted village-level regression
# Model for each disease:
#   village_mean_sharing ~ disease_prevalence + mean_disease_count_all
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(broom)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(forcats)
  library(readr)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("village_level_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("all_disease_vars"))
stopifnot(exists("pretty_labels"))
stopifnot(exists("OUTDIR"))
stopifnot(exists("save_plot_both"))

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------
safe_fit_lm <- function(df, disease_var) {
  xvar <- paste0(disease_var, "_prev")

  dat <- df %>%
    select(village_mean_sharing, mean_disease_count_all, all_of(xvar)) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(village_mean_sharing),
      is.finite(mean_disease_count_all),
      is.finite(.data[[xvar]])
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < 10 || length(unique(dat[[xvar]])) < 3) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    lm(as.formula(paste0("village_mean_sharing ~ ", xvar, " + mean_disease_count_all")), data = dat),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  list(
    fit = fit,
    data = dat,
    xvar = xvar
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# run one model per disease
# ---------------------------------------------------------
reg_tbl <- map_dfr(all_disease_vars, function(dv) {
  res <- safe_fit_lm(village_level_tbl, dv)

  if (is.null(res)) {
    return(tibble(
      disease_var = dv,
      metric_label = recode(paste0(dv, "_prev"), !!!pretty_labels, .default = dv),
      term = NA_character_,
      estimate = NA_real_,
      std.error = NA_real_,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_,
      conf.low = NA_real_,
      conf.high = NA_real_,
      n_villages = NA_integer_,
      r_squared = NA_real_,
      adj_r_squared = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  fit <- res$fit
  dat <- res$data
  xvar <- res$xvar

  tidy_fit <- broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      disease_var = dv,
      metric_label = recode(xvar, !!!pretty_labels, .default = dv),
      n_villages = nrow(dat),
      r_squared = summary(fit)$r.squared,
      adj_r_squared = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
    )

  tidy_fit
}) %>%
  relocate(disease_var, metric_label, term)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# focus table: disease term only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
reg_tbl_disease <- reg_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(term)) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "_prev$")) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_bh, p.value)

write_csv(
  reg_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_full.csv")
)

write_csv(
  reg_tbl_disease,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_disease_terms.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# summary plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_tbl <- reg_tbl_disease %>%
  filter(is.finite(estimate)) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label = fct_reorder(metric_label, estimate)
  )

p_reg <- ggplot(plot_tbl, aes(x = estimate, y = metric_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = p_adj_bh < 0.05), shape = 21, size = 2.8, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "white"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Burden-adjusted regression coefficient for disease prevalence",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Village-level regression adjusted for mean disease count",
    subtitle = "Model: village_mean_sharing ~ disease prevalence + mean_disease_count_all. Filled points indicate BH-adjusted P < 0.05."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_reg,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_summary"),
  width = 9,
  height = 8
)

message("DONE: burden-adjusted village-level regression.")
message("Key outputs:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_full.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_disease_terms.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_regression_burden_adjusted_summary.png"))
```

#composition-adjusted regression
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Step 2. Composition-adjusted village-level regression
# Model for each disease:
#   village_mean_sharing ~ disease_prevalence + PC1 + PC2
#
# PCA is built from village x disease prevalence matrix
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(purrr)
  library(broom)
  library(forcats)
  library(tibble)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("village_level_tbl"))
```
