```{r}
stopifnot(exists("all_disease_vars"))
stopifnot(exists("pretty_labels"))
stopifnot(exists("OUTDIR"))
stopifnot(exists("save_plot_both"))

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) build village x disease prevalence matrix for PCA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_prev_vars <- paste0(all_disease_vars, "_prev")
disease_prev_vars <- disease_prev_vars[disease_prev_vars %in% names(village_level_tbl)]

pca_input_tbl <- village_level_tbl %>%
  select(vil_id, cluster, all_of(disease_prev_vars))

# keep villages with complete data across selected disease prevalence vars
pca_complete_tbl <- pca_input_tbl %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(disease_prev_vars), ~ is.finite(.x)))

if (nrow(pca_complete_tbl) < 10) {
  stop("Too few villages with complete disease prevalence data for PCA.")
}

pca_mat <- pca_complete_tbl %>%
  select(all_of(disease_prev_vars)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(pca_mat) <- pca_complete_tbl$vil_id

# PCA on scaled village-level prevalence matrix
pca_fit <- prcomp(pca_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# village scores
pca_scores_tbl <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("vil_id") %>%
  rename(
    disease_PC1 = PC1,
    disease_PC2 = PC2
  )

# variance explained
pca_var_tbl <- tibble(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(pca_fit$sdev)),
  variance_explained = (pca_fit$sdev^2) / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2),
  cumulative_variance = cumsum((pca_fit$sdev^2) / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2))
)

write_csv(
  pca_var_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_variance_explained.csv")
)

# loadings
pca_loadings_tbl <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$rotation[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("metric_var") %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label = recode(metric_var, !!!pretty_labels, .default = metric_var)
  ) %>%
  select(metric_var, metric_label, PC1, PC2)

write_csv(
  pca_loadings_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_loadings.csv")
)

write_csv(
  pca_scores_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_scores_by_village.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) merge PCA scores into village-level table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_level_pca_tbl <- village_level_tbl %>%
  left_join(pca_scores_tbl, by = "vil_id")

write_csv(
  village_level_pca_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_with_composition_pcs.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) helper: safe lm per disease
# ---------------------------------------------------------
safe_fit_comp_lm <- function(df, disease_var) {
  xvar <- paste0(disease_var, "_prev")

  dat <- df %>%
    select(village_mean_sharing, disease_PC1, disease_PC2, all_of(xvar)) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(village_mean_sharing),
      is.finite(disease_PC1),
      is.finite(disease_PC2),
      is.finite(.data[[xvar]])
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < 10 || length(unique(dat[[xvar]])) < 3) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    lm(as.formula(paste0("village_mean_sharing ~ ", xvar, " + disease_PC1 + disease_PC2")), data = dat),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  list(
    fit = fit,
    data = dat,
    xvar = xvar
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) run one composition-adjusted model per disease
# ---------------------------------------------------------
comp_reg_tbl <- map_dfr(all_disease_vars, function(dv) {
  res <- safe_fit_comp_lm(village_level_pca_tbl, dv)

  if (is.null(res)) {
    return(tibble(
      disease_var = dv,
      metric_label = recode(paste0(dv, "_prev"), !!!pretty_labels, .default = dv),
      term = NA_character_,
      estimate = NA_real_,
      std.error = NA_real_,
      statistic = NA_real_,
      p.value = NA_real_,
      conf.low = NA_real_,
      conf.high = NA_real_,
      n_villages = NA_integer_,
      r_squared = NA_real_,
      adj_r_squared = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  fit <- res$fit
  dat <- res$data
  xvar <- res$xvar

  broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      disease_var = dv,
      metric_label = recode(xvar, !!!pretty_labels, .default = dv),
      n_villages = nrow(dat),
      r_squared = summary(fit)$r.squared,
      adj_r_squared = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
    )
}) %>%
  relocate(disease_var, metric_label, term)

write_csv(
  comp_reg_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_composition_adjusted_full.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) focus on disease term only
# ---------------------------------------------------------
comp_reg_tbl_disease <- comp_reg_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(term)) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "_prev$")) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_bh, p.value)

write_csv(
  comp_reg_tbl_disease,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_composition_adjusted_disease_terms.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) summary plot: disease coefficients after composition adjustment
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_tbl <- comp_reg_tbl_disease %>%
  filter(is.finite(estimate)) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label = fct_reorder(metric_label, estimate)
  )

p_comp_reg <- ggplot(plot_tbl, aes(x = estimate, y = metric_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = p_adj_bh < 0.05), shape = 21, size = 2.8, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "white"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Composition-adjusted regression coefficient for disease prevalence",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Village-level regression adjusted for disease composition",
    subtitle = "Model: village_mean_sharing ~ disease prevalence + disease PC1 + disease PC2. Filled points indicate BH-adjusted P < 0.05."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_comp_reg,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_regression_composition_adjusted_summary"),
  width = 9,
  height = 8
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) optional PCA score plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if ("cluster" %in% names(village_level_pca_tbl)) {
  p_pca_scores <- ggplot(
    village_level_pca_tbl %>% filter(is.finite(disease_PC1), is.finite(disease_PC2)),
    aes(x = disease_PC1, y = disease_PC2, label = vil_id)
  ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = cluster), size = 2.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("Disease composition PC1 (", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * pca_var_tbl$variance_explained[1]), "%)"),
      y = paste0("Disease composition PC2 (", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * pca_var_tbl$variance_explained[2]), "%)"),
      title = "Village-level PCA of disease prevalence composition"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans")
} else {
  p_pca_scores <- ggplot(
    village_level_pca_tbl %>% filter(is.finite(disease_PC1), is.finite(disease_PC2)),
    aes(x = disease_PC1, y = disease_PC2, label = vil_id)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 2.3, alpha = 0.9) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("Disease composition PC1 (", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * pca_var_tbl$variance_explained[1]), "%)"),
      y = paste0("Disease composition PC2 (", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * pca_var_tbl$variance_explained[2]), "%)"),
      title = "Village-level PCA of disease prevalence composition"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans")
}

save_plot_both(
  p_pca_scores,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "composition_pca_scores"),
  width = 7,
  height = 6
)

message("DONE: composition-adjusted village-level regression.")
message("Key outputs:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_variance_explained.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_loadings.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_scores_by_village.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_composition_adjusted_full.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "village_level_regression_composition_adjusted_disease_terms.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "village_level_regression_composition_adjusted_summary.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "composition_pca_scores.png"))
```

#disease composition heatmap + PCA loading plots
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Step 3. Disease composition heatmap + PCA loading plots
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(forcats)
  library(tibble)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("OUTDIR"))
stopifnot(exists("village_level_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("all_disease_vars"))
stopifnot(exists("pretty_labels"))
stopifnot(exists("save_plot_both"))

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) build village x disease prevalence matrix
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_prev_vars <- paste0(all_disease_vars, "_prev")
disease_prev_vars <- disease_prev_vars[disease_prev_vars %in% names(village_level_tbl)]

heat_tbl <- village_level_tbl %>%
  select(vil_id, cluster, village_mean_sharing, all_of(disease_prev_vars))

# complete cases for PCA
pca_complete_tbl <- heat_tbl %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(disease_prev_vars), ~ is.finite(.x)))

if (nrow(pca_complete_tbl) < 10) {
  stop("Too few villages with complete disease prevalence data for PCA/heatmap.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) PCA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pca_mat <- pca_complete_tbl %>%
  select(all_of(disease_prev_vars)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(pca_mat) <- pca_complete_tbl$vil_id

pca_fit <- prcomp(pca_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pca_var_tbl <- tibble(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(pca_fit$sdev)),
  variance_explained = (pca_fit$sdev^2) / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2),
  cumulative_variance = cumsum((pca_fit$sdev^2) / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2))
)

pca_scores_tbl <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("vil_id") %>%
  rename(
    disease_PC1 = PC1,
    disease_PC2 = PC2
  )

pca_loadings_tbl <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$rotation[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("metric_var") %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label = recode(metric_var, !!!pretty_labels, .default = metric_var),
    abs_PC1 = abs(PC1),
    abs_PC2 = abs(PC2)
  ) %>%
  select(metric_var, metric_label, PC1, PC2, abs_PC1, abs_PC2)

write_csv(
  pca_var_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_variance_explained.csv")
)

write_csv(
  pca_scores_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_scores_by_village.csv")
)

write_csv(
  pca_loadings_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_loadings.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) order villages for heatmap
#    order by PC1, then PC2
# ---------------------------------------------------------
village_order_tbl <- pca_scores_tbl %>%
  arrange(disease_PC1, disease_PC2) %>%
  mutate(village_order = row_number())

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) heatmap long table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
heat_long <- pca_complete_tbl %>%
  left_join(village_order_tbl, by = "vil_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(disease_prev_vars),
    names_to = "metric_var",
    values_to = "prevalence"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label = recode(metric_var, !!!pretty_labels, .default = metric_var),
    vil_id = factor(vil_id, levels = village_order_tbl$vil_id),
    metric_label = factor(metric_label, levels = rev(unique(recode(disease_prev_vars, !!!pretty_labels, .default = disease_prev_vars))))
  )

write_csv(
  heat_long,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_heatmap_long.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) village heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_heat <- ggplot(heat_long, aes(x = vil_id, y = metric_label, fill = prevalence)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    x = "Village ID",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Prevalence",
    title = "Village-by-disease prevalence heatmap",
    subtitle = "Villages ordered by disease composition PCA (PC1, then PC2)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_heat,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "composition_heatmap_village_disease"),
  width = 14,
  height = 7.5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) top loading plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
top_n <- 10

pc1_plot_tbl <- pca_loadings_tbl %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_PC1)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
  mutate(metric_label = fct_reorder(metric_label, PC1))

p_pc1 <- ggplot(pc1_plot_tbl, aes(x = PC1, y = metric_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 loading (", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * pca_var_tbl$variance_explained[1]), "% variance explained)"),
    y = NULL,
    title = "Top disease loadings for PC1"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans")

save_plot_both(
  p_pc1,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "composition_pca_top_loadings_PC1"),
  width = 8,
  height = 5.5
)

pc2_plot_tbl <- pca_loadings_tbl %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_PC2)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
  mutate(metric_label = fct_reorder(metric_label, PC2))

p_pc2 <- ggplot(pc2_plot_tbl, aes(x = PC2, y = metric_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC2 loading (", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * pca_var_tbl$variance_explained[2]), "% variance explained)"),
    y = NULL,
    title = "Top disease loadings for PC2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans")

save_plot_both(
  p_pc2,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "composition_pca_top_loadings_PC2"),
  width = 8,
  height = 5.5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) optional signed loading table for quick interpretation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pc1_signed_tbl <- pca_loadings_tbl %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_PC1)) %>%
  select(metric_label, PC1, abs_PC1)

pc2_signed_tbl <- pca_loadings_tbl %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_PC2)) %>%
  select(metric_label, PC2, abs_PC2)

write_csv(
  pc1_signed_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_loadings_PC1_ranked.csv")
)

write_csv(
  pc2_signed_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_loadings_PC2_ranked.csv")
)

message("DONE: disease composition heatmap and PCA loading plots created.")
message("Key outputs:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "composition_heatmap_village_disease.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "composition_pca_top_loadings_PC1.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "composition_pca_top_loadings_PC2.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_pca_loadings.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "composition_heatmap_long.csv"))
```

#PCA biplot
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
  library(forcats)
  library(stringr)
})

# =========================================================
# PCA biplot of village-level disease prevalence composition
# - Version 1: top loadings only
# - Version 2: all loadings
#
# Required object:
#   village_level_tbl
#
# Required columns in village_level_tbl:
#   - vil_id
#   - cluster   (optional but recommended)
#   - disease prevalence columns ending with "_prev"
#
# Outputs:
#   - pca_scores.csv
#   - pca_loadings.csv
#   - village_disease_pca_biplot_topLoadings.png/.svg
#   - village_disease_pca_biplot_allLoadings.png/.svg
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) checks and output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("village_level_tbl"))
stopifnot("vil_id" %in% names(village_level_tbl))

OUTDIR <- "village_disease_pca_biplot"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext,
                           width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) disease prevalence columns
# ---------------------------------------------------------
prev_cols <- names(village_level_tbl) %>%
  .[str_detect(., "_prev$")]

if (length(prev_cols) < 2) {
  stop("At least two *_prev columns are required for PCA.")
}

# pretty labels
pretty_labels <- c(
  hypertension_prev = "Hypertension prevalence",
  dyslipidemia_prev = "Dyslipidemia prevalence",
  cancer_prev = "Cancer prevalence",
  cerebrovascular_disease_prev = "Cerebrovascular disease prevalence",
  osteoarthritis_prev = "Osteoarthritis prevalence",
  diabetes_prev = "Diabetes prevalence",
  thyroid_disease_prev = "Thyroid disease prevalence",
  skin_disease_prev = "Skin disease prevalence",
  liver_cirrhosis_prev = "Liver cirrhosis prevalence",
  chronic_kidney_failure_prev = "Chronic kidney failure prevalence",
  cardiovascular_disease_prev = "Cardiovascular disease prevalence",
  dementia_prev = "Dementia prevalence",
  rheumatoid_arthritis_prev = "Rheumatoid arthritis prevalence",
  osteoporosis_prev = "Osteoporosis prevalence",
  chronic_respiratory_disease_prev = "Chronic respiratory disease prevalence",
  parkinsons_disease_prev = "Parkinson's disease prevalence",
  bowel_disease_prev = "Bowel disease prevalence",
  depression_prev = "Depression prevalence"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) prepare PCA input
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_cols <- c("vil_id", "cluster")
meta_cols <- meta_cols[meta_cols %in% names(village_level_tbl)]

pca_input_tbl <- village_level_tbl %>%
  select(all_of(meta_cols), all_of(prev_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(prev_cols), as.numeric))

# complete cases only
pca_complete <- pca_input_tbl %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(prev_cols), ~ is.finite(.x)))

if (nrow(pca_complete) < 3) {
  stop("Too few complete villages for PCA.")
}

# matrix for PCA
X <- pca_complete %>%
  select(all_of(prev_cols)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(X) <- pca_complete$vil_id

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) run PCA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pca_res <- prcomp(X, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

var_expl <- summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) scores and loadings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("vil_id") %>%
  left_join(
    pca_complete %>% select(any_of(c("vil_id", "cluster"))),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  rename(PC1 = PC1, PC2 = PC2)

loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_res$rotation[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("metric_var") %>%
  rename(PC1_loading = PC1, PC2_loading = PC2) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label = recode(metric_var, !!!pretty_labels, .default = metric_var),
    loading_strength = sqrt(PC1_loading^2 + PC2_loading^2),
    abs_PC1 = abs(PC1_loading),
    abs_PC2 = abs(PC2_loading)
  )

write_csv(scores, file.path(OUTDIR, "pca_scores.csv"))
write_csv(loadings, file.path(OUTDIR, "pca_loadings.csv"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) helper: make scaled arrows
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_scaled_loadings <- function(scores_df, loadings_df, arrow_fraction = 0.38) {

  score_range_x <- max(scores_df$PC1, na.rm = TRUE) - min(scores_df$PC1, na.rm = TRUE)
  score_range_y <- max(scores_df$PC2, na.rm = TRUE) - min(scores_df$PC2, na.rm = TRUE)

  loading_range_x <- max(loadings_df$PC1_loading, na.rm = TRUE) - min(loadings_df$PC1_loading, na.rm = TRUE)
  loading_range_y <- max(loadings_df$PC2_loading, na.rm = TRUE) - min(loadings_df$PC2_loading, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.finite(loading_range_x) || loading_range_x == 0) loading_range_x <- 1
  if (!is.finite(loading_range_y) || loading_range_y == 0) loading_range_y <- 1

  arrow_scale <- arrow_fraction * min(score_range_x / loading_range_x,
                                      score_range_y / loading_range_y)

  loadings_df %>%
    mutate(
      PC1_arrow = PC1_loading * arrow_scale,
      PC2_arrow = PC2_loading * arrow_scale
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) helper: common plotting function
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_biplot <- function(scores_df, loadings_df, title_txt) {

  use_cluster <- "cluster" %in% names(scores_df)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey60")

  if (use_cluster) {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(
        data = scores_df,
        aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = factor(cluster)),
        size = 2.8,
        alpha = 0.9
      )
  } else {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(
        data = scores_df,
        aes(x = PC1, y = PC2),
        size = 2.8,
        alpha = 0.9
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    geom_segment(
      data = loadings_df,
      aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1_arrow, yend = PC2_arrow),
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.18, "cm")),
      linewidth = 0.6,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = loadings_df,
      aes(x = PC1_arrow, y = PC2_arrow, label = metric_label),
      size = 3.3,
      color = "black",
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      segment.color = "grey50",
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_txt,
      x = paste0("Disease composition PC1 (", sprintf("%.1f", var_expl[1]), "%)"),
      y = paste0("Disease composition PC2 (", sprintf("%.1f", var_expl[2]), "%)")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  if (use_cluster) {
    p <- p + labs(color = "cluster")
  }

  p
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Version 1: top loadings only
#    choose top variables by loading strength in PC1-PC2 plane
# ---------------------------------------------------------
top_n <- 10

loadings_top <- loadings %>%
  arrange(desc(loading_strength)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n)

loadings_top_scaled <- make_scaled_loadings(scores, loadings_top)

p_biplot_top <- make_biplot(
  scores_df   = scores,
  loadings_df = loadings_top_scaled,
  title_txt   = "Village-level PCA biplot of disease prevalence composition (top loadings)"
)

save_plot_both(
  p_biplot_top,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "village_disease_pca_biplot_topLoadings"),
  width = 10,
  height = 7.5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Version 2: all loadings
# ---------------------------------------------------------
loadings_all_scaled <- make_scaled_loadings(scores, loadings)

p_biplot_all <- make_biplot(
  scores_df   = scores,
  loadings_df = loadings_all_scaled,
  title_txt   = "Village-level PCA biplot of disease prevalence composition (all loadings)"
)

save_plot_both(
  p_biplot_all,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "village_disease_pca_biplot_allLoadings"),
  width = 11,
  height = 8
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) optional: separate loading summary tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
loadings_top_summary <- loadings %>%
  arrange(desc(loading_strength)) %>%
  select(metric_var, metric_label, PC1_loading, PC2_loading,
         abs_PC1, abs_PC2, loading_strength)

write_csv(
  loadings_top_summary,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "pca_loadings_ranked.csv")
)

message("DONE: PCA biplot generation complete.")
message("Outputs saved in: ", OUTDIR)
message(" - village_disease_pca_biplot_topLoadings.png/.svg")
message(" - village_disease_pca_biplot_allLoadings.png/.svg")
message(" - pca_scores.csv")
message(" - pca_loadings.csv")
message(" - pca_loadings_ranked.csv")
```

#sharing-related ASV vs disease
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(forcats)
})

# =========================================================
# ASV-level disease association analysis
# for sharing-related ASVs
#
# Main question:
#   Which sharing-related ASVs are positively or negatively
#   associated with each disease?
#
# Input required:
#   - asv_pa object in environment
#   - metadata_ver2.csv
#   - sharing_asv.csv
#
# sharing_asv.csv columns:
#   - ASV
#   - label
#   - type
#
# asv_pa:
#   - first column: ASV
#   - other columns: sample IDs
#   - values: 0/1 presence-absence
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) checks and output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("asv_pa"))
stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_ver2.csv"))
stopifnot(file.exists("sharing_asv.csv"))

OUTDIR <- "sharing_asv_disease_association"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "volcano_by_disease"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "top_asv_by_disease"), showWarnings = FALSE)

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

safe_fisher <- function(a, b, c, d) {
  mat <- matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

  out <- tryCatch(
    fisher.test(mat),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(out)) {
    tibble(
      odds_ratio = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    )
  } else {
    tibble(
      odds_ratio = unname(out$estimate),
      p_value = out$p.value
    )
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) disease variable definitions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

pretty_labels <- c(
  hypertension = "Hypertension",
  dyslipidemia = "Dyslipidemia",
  cancer = "Cancer",
  cerebrovascular_disease = "Cerebrovascular disease",
  osteoarthritis = "Osteoarthritis",
  diabetes = "Diabetes",
  thyroid_disease = "Thyroid disease",
  skin_disease = "Skin disease",
  liver_cirrhosis = "Liver cirrhosis",
  chronic_kidney_failure = "Chronic kidney failure",
  cardiovascular_disease = "Cardiovascular disease",
  dementia = "Dementia",
  rheumatoid_arthritis = "Rheumatoid arthritis",
  osteoporosis = "Osteoporosis",
  chronic_respiratory_disease = "Chronic respiratory disease",
  parkinsons_disease = "Parkinson's disease",
  bowel_disease = "Bowel disease",
  depression = "Depression"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) read metadata and sharing ASV annotation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("metadata_ver2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
sharing_anno <- read_csv("sharing_asv.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot("sampleid" %in% names(meta))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "label", "type") %in% names(sharing_anno)))

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

meta_clean <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    across(all_of(all_disease_vars), yn_to_bin)
  ) %>%
  distinct(sampleid, .keep_all = TRUE)

write_csv(
  meta_clean,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "metadata_cleaned_for_disease_analysis.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) prepare sharing ASV presence/absence table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_col <- names(asv_pa)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), asv_col)

sharing_asvs <- unique(as.character(sharing_anno$ASV))

asv_pa_sub <- asv_pa %>%
  rename(ASV = !!asv_col) %>%
  mutate(ASV = as.character(ASV)) %>%
  filter(ASV %in% sharing_asvs)

if (nrow(asv_pa_sub) == 0) {
  stop("No ASVs from sharing_asv.csv were found in asv_pa.")
}

sample_cols_use <- intersect(sample_cols, meta_clean$sampleid)

if (length(sample_cols_use) < 5) {
  stop("Too few overlapping sample IDs between asv_pa and metadata.")
}

asv_pa_sub <- asv_pa_sub %>%
  select(ASV, all_of(sample_cols_use))

# force 0/1
asv_pa_sub <- asv_pa_sub %>%
  mutate(across(-ASV, ~ ifelse(as.numeric(.) > 0, 1, 0)))

write_csv(
  asv_pa_sub,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_pa_subset.csv")
)

# long format
asv_long <- asv_pa_sub %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ASV,
    names_to = "sampleid",
    values_to = "present"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    present = as.integer(present)
  ) %>%
  left_join(sharing_anno, by = "ASV")

write_csv(
  asv_long,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_pa_long.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) ASV-level prevalence association by disease
# ---------------------------------------------------------
run_one_disease <- function(disease_var) {
  disease_lab <- recode(disease_var, !!!pretty_labels, .default = disease_var)

  dat <- asv_long %>%
    left_join(
      meta_clean %>% select(sampleid, all_of(disease_var)),
      by = "sampleid"
    ) %>%
    rename(disease = !!disease_var) %>%
    filter(!is.na(disease))

  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  out <- dat %>%
    group_by(ASV, label, type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_yes = sum(disease == 1),
      n_no = sum(disease == 0),

      prev_yes = mean(present[disease == 1] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      prev_no  = mean(present[disease == 0] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),

      detected_yes = sum(present == 1 & disease == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      notdetected_yes = sum(present == 0 & disease == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      detected_no = sum(present == 1 & disease == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      notdetected_no = sum(present == 0 & disease == 0, na.rm = TRUE),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      delta_prev = prev_yes - prev_no,
      direction = case_when(
        delta_prev > 0 ~ "Higher in disease",
        delta_prev < 0 ~ "Lower in disease",
        TRUE ~ "No difference"
      )
    )

  fisher_tbl <- pmap_dfr(
    list(out$detected_yes, out$notdetected_yes, out$detected_no, out$notdetected_no),
    ~ safe_fisher(..1, ..2, ..3, ..4)
  )

  out <- bind_cols(out, fisher_tbl) %>%
    mutate(
      disease_var = disease_var,
      disease_label = disease_lab,
      p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      neglog10_padj = -log10(p_adj_bh),
      neglog10_padj = ifelse(is.infinite(neglog10_padj), NA_real_, neglog10_padj),
      sig = if_else(!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < 0.05, "sig", "ns")
    ) %>%
    relocate(disease_var, disease_label)

  out
}

asv_assoc_tbl <- map_dfr(all_disease_vars, run_one_disease)

write_csv(
  asv_assoc_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_prevalence_association_all_diseases.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) disease-level summary of ASV association results
# ---------------------------------------------------------
assoc_summary_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tested_asv = n(),
    n_sig_total = sum(sig == "sig", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_higher_in_disease = sum(sig == "sig" & delta_prev > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_lower_in_disease = sum(sig == "sig" & delta_prev < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_delta_prev = median(delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_delta_prev = mean(delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sig_total), disease_label)

write_csv(
  assoc_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_prevalence_association_summary_by_disease.csv")
)

# optional type breakdown as annotation
assoc_type_summary_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label, type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tested_asv = n(),
    n_sig_total = sum(sig == "sig", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_higher_in_disease = sum(sig == "sig" & delta_prev > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_lower_in_disease = sum(sig == "sig" & delta_prev < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(disease_label, type)

write_csv(
  assoc_type_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_prevalence_association_summary_by_disease_and_type.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) summary plot across diseases
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_summary_tbl <- assoc_summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label = fct_reorder(disease_label, median_delta_prev)
  )

p_summary <- ggplot(plot_summary_tbl, aes(x = median_delta_prev, y = disease_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_sig_total), color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Median ASV-level prevalence difference (disease yes - disease no)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Disease-level summary of sharing-ASV prevalence associations",
    subtitle = "Point size indicates the number of BH-significant ASVs within each disease."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_summary,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "sharing_asv_disease_association_summary"),
  width = 9,
  height = 7
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) volcano-like plot for each disease
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (dv in unique(asv_assoc_tbl$disease_var)) {
  plot_df <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == dv) %>%
    mutate(
      label_plot = if_else(sig == "sig", label, NA_character_)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) next

  p_vol <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = delta_prev, y = neglog10_padj)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 3, color = "grey60") +
    geom_point(aes(color = type, shape = sig), size = 2.3, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("ns" = 1, "sig" = 16)) +
    labs(
      x = "Prevalence difference (disease yes - disease no)",
      y = expression(-log[10]("BH-adjusted p")),
      title = paste0("Sharing-ASV prevalence association: ", unique(plot_df$disease_label)),
      subtitle = "Points to the left indicate ASVs less prevalent in the disease group."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  save_plot_both(
    p_vol,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "volcano_by_disease", paste0("volcano_", dv)),
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) top ASVs per disease plot
#    show strongest positive and negative delta_prev
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (dv in unique(asv_assoc_tbl$disease_var)) {
  plot_df <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == dv) %>%
    arrange(delta_prev) %>%
    slice_head(n = 8) %>%
    bind_rows(
      asv_assoc_tbl %>%
        filter(disease_var == dv) %>%
        arrange(desc(delta_prev)) %>%
        slice_head(n = 8)
    ) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      label_show = paste0(label, " (", type, ")"),
      label_show = fct_reorder(label_show, delta_prev)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) next

  p_top <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = delta_prev, y = label_show)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(aes(fill = sig == "sig"), shape = 21, size = 2.8, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "white"), guide = "none") +
    labs(
      x = "Prevalence difference (disease yes - disease no)",
      y = NULL,
      title = paste0("Top sharing-ASV prevalence differences: ", unique(plot_df$disease_label)),
      subtitle = "Filled points indicate BH-adjusted P < 0.05."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
    )

  save_plot_both(
    p_top,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "top_asv_by_disease", paste0("top_asv_", dv)),
    width = 9,
    height = 6.5
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) save top hit tables per disease
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (dv in unique(asv_assoc_tbl$disease_var)) {
  top_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == dv) %>%
    arrange(p_adj_bh, desc(abs(delta_prev)))

  write_csv(
    top_tbl,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", paste0("top_hits_", dv, ".csv"))
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
message("DONE: sharing-related ASV disease association analysis complete.")
message("Key outputs:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_prevalence_association_all_diseases.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_prevalence_association_summary_by_disease.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_prevalence_association_summary_by_disease_and_type.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "sharing_asv_disease_association_summary.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "volcano_by_disease"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "top_asv_by_disease"))
```

#sharing-related ASV vs diseases ver.2
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(forcats)
})

# =========================================================
# sharing_asv_disease_association_ver.2
#
# Main idea:
#   For each sharing-related ASV and each disease,
#   compare disease yes vs no WITHIN VILLAGE.
#
# Core question:
#   Within villages where both disease-yes and disease-no individuals exist,
#   is each sharing-related ASV more or less prevalent in the disease group?
#
# Inputs required:
#   - asv_pa object in environment
#       * first column = ASV
#       * other columns = sample IDs
#       * values = 0/1 or coercible to presence/absence
#   - metadata_ver2.csv
#   - sharing_asv.csv
#
# sharing_asv.csv columns:
#   - ASV
#   - label
#   - type
#
# metadata_ver2.csv required columns:
#   - sampleid
#   - vil_id
#   - disease columns
#
# Output folder:
#   sharing_asv_disease_association_ver.2
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) checks and output directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("asv_pa"))
stopifnot(file.exists("metadata_ver2.csv"))
stopifnot(file.exists("sharing_asv.csv"))

OUTDIR <- "sharing_asv_disease_association_ver.2"
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "volcano_by_disease"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "top_asv_by_disease"), showWarnings = FALSE)

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

yn_to_bin <- function(x) {
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ NA_real_,
    x_num == 1 ~ 1,
    x_num == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

safe_wilcox_signed <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 3) {
    return(tibble(
      p_value = NA_real_,
      n_used = length(x)
    ))
  }

  out <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x, mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(out)) {
    tibble(
      p_value = NA_real_,
      n_used = length(x)
    )
  } else {
    tibble(
      p_value = out$p.value,
      n_used = length(x)
    )
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) disease variable definitions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
common_disease_vars_all <- c(
  "hypertension",
  "dyslipidemia",
  "cancer",
  "cerebrovascular_disease",
  "osteoarthritis",
  "diabetes",
  "thyroid_disease",
  "skin_disease",
  "liver_cirrhosis",
  "chronic_kidney_failure"
)

extended_disease_vars <- c(
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "dementia",
  "rheumatoid_arthritis",
  "osteoporosis",
  "chronic_respiratory_disease",
  "parkinsons_disease",
  "bowel_disease",
  "depression"
)

pretty_labels <- c(
  hypertension = "Hypertension",
  dyslipidemia = "Dyslipidemia",
  cancer = "Cancer",
  cerebrovascular_disease = "Cerebrovascular disease",
  osteoarthritis = "Osteoarthritis",
  diabetes = "Diabetes",
  thyroid_disease = "Thyroid disease",
  skin_disease = "Skin disease",
  liver_cirrhosis = "Liver cirrhosis",
  chronic_kidney_failure = "Chronic kidney failure",
  cardiovascular_disease = "Cardiovascular disease",
  dementia = "Dementia",
  rheumatoid_arthritis = "Rheumatoid arthritis",
  osteoporosis = "Osteoporosis",
  chronic_respiratory_disease = "Chronic respiratory disease",
  parkinsons_disease = "Parkinson's disease",
  bowel_disease = "Bowel disease",
  depression = "Depression"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) read metadata and sharing ASV annotation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- read_csv("metadata_ver2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
sharing_anno <- read_csv("sharing_asv.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "vil_id") %in% names(meta)))
stopifnot(all(c("ASV", "label", "type") %in% names(sharing_anno)))

all_disease_vars <- unique(c(common_disease_vars_all, extended_disease_vars))
all_disease_vars <- all_disease_vars[all_disease_vars %in% names(meta)]

meta_clean <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    across(all_of(all_disease_vars), yn_to_bin)
  ) %>%
  distinct(sampleid, .keep_all = TRUE)

write_csv(
  meta_clean,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "metadata_cleaned_for_disease_analysis.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) prepare sharing ASV presence/absence table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_col <- names(asv_pa)[1]
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_pa), asv_col)

sharing_asvs <- unique(as.character(sharing_anno$ASV))

asv_pa_sub <- asv_pa %>%
  rename(ASV = !!asv_col) %>%
  mutate(ASV = as.character(ASV)) %>%
  filter(ASV %in% sharing_asvs)

if (nrow(asv_pa_sub) == 0) {
  stop("No ASVs from sharing_asv.csv were found in asv_pa.")
}

sample_cols_use <- intersect(sample_cols, meta_clean$sampleid)

if (length(sample_cols_use) < 5) {
  stop("Too few overlapping sample IDs between asv_pa and metadata.")
}

asv_pa_sub <- asv_pa_sub %>%
  select(ASV, all_of(sample_cols_use)) %>%
  mutate(across(-ASV, ~ ifelse(as.numeric(.) > 0, 1L, 0L)))

write_csv(
  asv_pa_sub,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_pa_subset.csv")
)

asv_long <- asv_pa_sub %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ASV,
    names_to = "sampleid",
    values_to = "present"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    present = as.integer(present)
  ) %>%
  left_join(sharing_anno, by = "ASV")

write_csv(
  asv_long,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_pa_long.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) helper: run one disease analysis
# ---------------------------------------------------------
run_one_disease_within_village <- function(disease_var) {
  disease_lab <- recode(disease_var, !!!pretty_labels, .default = disease_var)

  dat <- asv_long %>%
    left_join(
      meta_clean %>% select(sampleid, vil_id, all_of(disease_var)),
      by = "sampleid"
    ) %>%
    rename(disease = !!disease_var) %>%
    filter(!is.na(disease), !is.na(vil_id))

  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    return(list(
      asv_tbl = tibble(),
      village_tbl = tibble(),
      village_check_tbl = tibble()
    ))
  }

  # testable villages: both disease yes and no exist within village
  village_check_tbl <- dat %>%
    distinct(sampleid, vil_id, disease) %>%
    group_by(vil_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_yes = sum(disease == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_no  = sum(disease == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      analyzable = n_yes > 0 & n_no > 0,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      disease_var = disease_var,
      disease_label = disease_lab
    )

  dat_use <- dat %>%
    semi_join(
      village_check_tbl %>% filter(analyzable) %>% select(vil_id),
      by = "vil_id"
    )

  if (nrow(dat_use) == 0) {
    return(list(
      asv_tbl = tibble(),
      village_tbl = village_check_tbl,
      village_check_tbl = village_check_tbl
    ))
  }

  # ASV x village summaries
  asv_village_tbl <- dat_use %>%
    group_by(ASV, label, type, vil_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_yes = sum(disease == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_no  = sum(disease == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      prev_yes = mean(present[disease == 1] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      prev_no  = mean(present[disease == 0] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      delta_prev = prev_yes - prev_no,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      disease_var = disease_var,
      disease_label = disease_lab
    )

  # ASV-level across villages
  asv_tbl <- asv_village_tbl %>%
    group_by(disease_var, disease_label, ASV, label, type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_testable_villages = sum(is.finite(delta_prev)),
      median_delta_prev = median(delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_delta_prev = mean(delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_prev_yes = mean(prev_yes, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_prev_no  = mean(prev_no, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_villages_positive_delta = sum(delta_prev > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_villages_negative_delta = sum(delta_prev < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  p_tbl <- asv_village_tbl %>%
    group_by(ASV, label, type) %>%
    summarise(
      test_out = list(safe_wilcox_signed(delta_prev)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    unnest(test_out)

  asv_tbl <- asv_tbl %>%
    left_join(p_tbl, by = c("ASV", "label", "type")) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      direction = case_when(
        mean_delta_prev > 0 ~ "Higher in disease",
        mean_delta_prev < 0 ~ "Lower in disease",
        TRUE ~ "No difference"
      ),
      neglog10_padj = -log10(p_adj_bh),
      neglog10_padj = ifelse(is.infinite(neglog10_padj), NA_real_, neglog10_padj),
      sig = if_else(!is.na(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < 0.05, "sig", "ns")
    ) %>%
    arrange(p_adj_bh, desc(abs(mean_delta_prev)))

  list(
    asv_tbl = asv_tbl,
    village_tbl = asv_village_tbl,
    village_check_tbl = village_check_tbl
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) run all diseases
# ---------------------------------------------------------
all_results <- map(all_disease_vars, run_one_disease_within_village)
names(all_results) <- all_disease_vars

asv_assoc_tbl <- map_dfr(all_results, "asv_tbl")
asv_village_tbl_all <- map_dfr(all_results, "village_tbl")
village_check_tbl_all <- map_dfr(all_results, "village_check_tbl")

write_csv(
  asv_assoc_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_within_village_association_all_diseases.csv")
)

write_csv(
  asv_village_tbl_all,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_within_village_delta_by_village.csv")
)

write_csv(
  village_check_tbl_all,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_within_village_testable_villages.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) disease-level summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
assoc_summary_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tested_asv = n(),
    median_testable_villages = median(n_testable_villages, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_total = sum(sig == "sig", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_higher_in_disease = sum(sig == "sig" & mean_delta_prev > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_lower_in_disease = sum(sig == "sig" & mean_delta_prev < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_mean_delta_prev = median(mean_delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mean_delta_prev = mean(mean_delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    village_check_tbl_all %>%
      group_by(disease_var, disease_label) %>%
      summarise(
        n_villages_total = n_distinct(vil_id),
        n_villages_testable = sum(analyzable, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("disease_var", "disease_label")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_sig_total), disease_label)

write_csv(
  assoc_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_within_village_association_summary_by_disease.csv")
)

# optional type summary as annotation only
assoc_type_summary_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label, type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tested_asv = n(),
    n_sig_total = sum(sig == "sig", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_higher_in_disease = sum(sig == "sig" & mean_delta_prev > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig_lower_in_disease = sum(sig == "sig" & mean_delta_prev < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(disease_label, type)

write_csv(
  assoc_type_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_within_village_association_summary_by_disease_and_type.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) summary plot across diseases
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_summary_tbl <- assoc_summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label = fct_reorder(disease_label, median_mean_delta_prev)
  )

p_summary <- ggplot(plot_summary_tbl, aes(x = median_mean_delta_prev, y = disease_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_sig_total), color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Median ASV-level within-village prevalence difference (yes - no)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Disease-level summary of within-village sharing-ASV associations",
    subtitle = "Each ASV was tested using village-level delta prevalence (disease yes - disease no) across villages with both groups present. Point size indicates the number of BH-significant ASVs."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_summary,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "sharing_asv_within_village_association_summary"),
  width = 9,
  height = 7
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) volcano-like plot for each disease
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (dv in unique(asv_assoc_tbl$disease_var)) {
  plot_df <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == dv)

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) next

  p_vol <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = mean_delta_prev, y = neglog10_padj)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 3, color = "grey60") +
    geom_point(aes(color = type, shape = sig), size = 2.3, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("ns" = 1, "sig" = 16)) +
    labs(
      x = "Mean within-village prevalence difference (disease yes - disease no)",
      y = expression(-log[10]("BH-adjusted p")),
      title = paste0("Within-village sharing-ASV association: ", unique(plot_df$disease_label)),
      subtitle = "Points to the left indicate ASVs less prevalent in disease individuals within the same village."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  save_plot_both(
    p_vol,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "volcano_by_disease", paste0("volcano_", dv)),
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) top ASVs per disease plot
#    strongest negative and positive mean_delta_prev
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (dv in unique(asv_assoc_tbl$disease_var)) {
  plot_df <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == dv) %>%
    arrange(mean_delta_prev) %>%
    slice_head(n = 8) %>%
    bind_rows(
      asv_assoc_tbl %>%
        filter(disease_var == dv) %>%
        arrange(desc(mean_delta_prev)) %>%
        slice_head(n = 8)
    ) %>%
    distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      label_show = paste0(label, " (", type, ")"),
      label_show = fct_reorder(label_show, mean_delta_prev)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) next

  p_top <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = mean_delta_prev, y = label_show)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(aes(fill = sig == "sig"), shape = 21, size = 2.8, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "white"), guide = "none") +
    labs(
      x = "Mean within-village prevalence difference (disease yes - disease no)",
      y = NULL,
      title = paste0("Top within-village sharing-ASV differences: ", unique(plot_df$disease_label)),
      subtitle = "Filled points indicate BH-adjusted P < 0.05."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
    )

  save_plot_both(
    p_top,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "top_asv_by_disease", paste0("top_asv_", dv)),
    width = 9,
    height = 6.5
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) save per-disease full tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
for (dv in unique(asv_assoc_tbl$disease_var)) {
  top_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == dv) %>%
    arrange(p_adj_bh, desc(abs(mean_delta_prev)))

  write_csv(
    top_tbl,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", paste0("top_hits_", dv, ".csv"))
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
message("DONE: sharing_asv_disease_association_ver.2 complete.")
message("Key outputs:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_within_village_association_all_diseases.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_within_village_delta_by_village.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_within_village_testable_villages.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_within_village_association_summary_by_disease.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "sharing_asv_within_village_association_summary.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "volcano_by_disease"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "top_asv_by_disease"))
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Disease-positive / disease-negative composition
# among testable villages
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
})

disease_testable_composition_summary <- village_check_tbl_all %>%
  filter(analyzable) %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_testable_villages = n_distinct(vil_id),
    total_positive_individuals = sum(n_yes, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_negative_individuals = sum(n_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_positive_per_village = median(n_yes, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_positive_per_village = IQR(n_yes, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_positive_per_village = min(n_yes, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_positive_per_village = max(n_yes, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_negative_per_village = median(n_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_negative_per_village = IQR(n_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_negative_per_village = min(n_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_negative_per_village = max(n_no, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_positive_fraction = median(n_yes / n_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_positive_fraction = IQR(n_yes / n_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_villages_with_one_positive = sum(n_yes == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_villages_with_one_positive = 100 * mean(n_yes == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(median_positive_per_village, disease_label)

print(disease_testable_composition_summary, n = Inf)

write_csv(
  disease_testable_composition_summary,
  file.path('sharing_asv_disease_association_ver.2', "tables", "disease_testable_village_positive_negative_composition_summary.csv")
)
```

#sig_only_across_disease
```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK A
# sig-only plot for each disease
# =========================================================

# Nature-style palettes
type_pal <- c(
  "global core" = "#4DBBD5",
  "village_enriched" = "#E64B35"
)

type_levels <- c("global core", "village_enriched")

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "sig_only_by_disease"), showWarnings = FALSE)

for (dv in unique(asv_assoc_tbl$disease_var)) {
  plot_df <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == dv, sig == "sig") %>%
    mutate(
      type = factor(type, levels = type_levels)
    ) %>%
    arrange(mean_delta_prev) %>%
    mutate(
      label_show = paste0(label, " (", type, ")"),
      label_show = fct_reorder(label_show, mean_delta_prev)
    )

  disease_title <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == dv) %>%
    distinct(disease_label) %>%
    pull(disease_label)

  if (length(disease_title) == 0) disease_title <- dv

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    p_empty <- ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No BH-significant ASVs", size = 6) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Significant within-village sharing-ASVs: ", disease_title)
      ) +
      theme_void()

    save_plot_both(
      p_empty,
      file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "sig_only_by_disease", paste0("sig_only_", dv)),
      width = 7,
      height = 4
    )

    next
  }

  p_sig <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = mean_delta_prev, y = label_show)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = type),
      shape = 21,
      size = 3.2,
      stroke = 0.4,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = type_pal,
      limits = type_levels,
      breaks = type_levels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Mean within-village prevalence difference (disease yes - disease no)",
      y = NULL,
      fill = "ASV type",
      title = paste0("Significant within-village sharing-ASVs: ", disease_title),
      subtitle = "Only BH-significant ASVs are shown."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  save_plot_both(
    p_sig,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "sig_only_by_disease", paste0("sig_only_", dv)),
    width = 9,
    height = max(4, 0.35 * nrow(plot_df))
  )
}
```

#sig_only_across_disease_heatmap
```{r}
# =========================================================
# CHUNK B
# sig-only heatmap across diseases
# - full grid version (not tile borders)
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(forcats)
})

# Nature-style palettes
type_pal <- c(
  "global core" = "#4DBBD5",
  "village_enriched" = "#E64B35"
)

type_levels <- c("global core", "village_enriched")

effect_low  <- "#3C5488"
effect_mid  <- "white"
effect_high <- "#BC3C29"

sig_heat_df <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  filter(sig == "sig") %>%
  select(disease_label, ASV, label, type, mean_delta_prev, p_adj_bh) %>%
  mutate(
    type = factor(type, levels = type_levels)
  )

if (nrow(sig_heat_df) > 0) {

  # y-axis order:
  # type grouped -> more diseases first -> stronger average effect first -> label
  asv_order <- sig_heat_df %>%
    group_by(ASV, label, type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_sig = n(),
      mean_abs_effect = mean(abs(mean_delta_prev), na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_signed_effect = mean(mean_delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(type, desc(n_sig), desc(mean_abs_effect), label) %>%
    mutate(
      label_show = paste0(label, " (", type, ")")
    )

  disease_order <- sig_heat_df %>%
    distinct(disease_label)

  sig_heat_plot_df <- sig_heat_df %>%
    left_join(asv_order %>% select(ASV, label_show), by = "ASV") %>%
    mutate(
      label_show = factor(label_show, levels = rev(asv_order$label_show)),
      disease_label = factor(disease_label, levels = disease_order$disease_label)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      x_id = as.integer(disease_label),
      y_id = as.integer(label_show)
    )

  max_abs_effect <- max(abs(sig_heat_plot_df$mean_delta_prev), na.rm = TRUE)

  nx <- nlevels(sig_heat_plot_df$disease_label)
  ny <- nlevels(sig_heat_plot_df$label_show)

  p_sig_heat <- ggplot(
    sig_heat_plot_df,
    aes(x = x_id, y = y_id, fill = mean_delta_prev)
  ) +
    geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1, color = NA) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = seq(0.5, nx + 0.5, by = 1),
      color = "grey85",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = seq(0.5, ny + 0.5, by = 1),
      color = "grey85",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = effect_low,
      mid = effect_mid,
      high = effect_high,
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-max_abs_effect, max_abs_effect)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(nx),
      labels = levels(sig_heat_plot_df$disease_label),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(ny),
      labels = levels(sig_heat_plot_df$label_show),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Mean prevalence\ndifference",
      title = "BH-significant sharing-ASVs across diseases",
      subtitle = "Only disease-ASV pairs with BH-adjusted P < 0.05 are shown."
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )

  save_plot_both(
    p_sig_heat,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "sig_only_heatmap_across_diseases"),
    width = 10,
    height = max(5, 0.3 * nrow(asv_order))
  )
}
```
