#sig_ASV by disease specific
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(forcats)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
})

# =========================================================
# CHUNK 1
# - clean annotation map
# - build summary tables
# - disease-specific plots only
#
# Required objects:
#   asv_assoc_tbl
#   asv_village_tbl_all
#   OUTDIR
#
# Optional object:
#   sharing_anno
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("asv_assoc_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("asv_village_tbl_all"))
stopifnot(exists("OUTDIR"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) clean annotation map
# ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("sharing_anno")) {
  anno_map <- sharing_anno %>%
    select(ASV, label, type) %>%
    distinct()
} else {
  stopifnot(file.exists("sharing_asv.csv"))
  anno_map <- read_csv("sharing_asv.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(ASV, label, type) %>%
    distinct()
}

bad_anno <- anno_map %>%
  count(ASV) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(bad_anno) > 0) {
  stop("sharing_asv annotation is not unique by ASV. Fix sharing_asv.csv first.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0-1) helper: detect prevalence columns for both-zero -> NA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pick_first_existing <- function(candidates, df) {
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NULL)
  hit[1]
}

prev_yes_col <- pick_first_existing(
  c("prev_yes", "prev_case", "prev_disease_yes", "yes_prev", "disease_prev_yes"),
  asv_village_tbl_all
)

prev_no_col <- pick_first_existing(
  c("prev_no", "prev_control", "prev_disease_no", "no_prev", "disease_prev_no"),
  asv_village_tbl_all
)

testable_col <- pick_first_existing(
  c("testable", "comparable", "analyzable"),
  asv_village_tbl_all
)

if (is.null(prev_yes_col) || is.null(prev_no_col)) {
  message("NOTE: prev_yes / prev_no columns were not found in asv_village_tbl_all.")
  message("      both-zero -> NA reclassification will be skipped, and Zero will follow delta_prev only.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0-2) labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# bubble label: no type
make_plot_label_bubble <- function(label) {
  label
}

# stacked / heatmap label: keep type
make_plot_label_typed <- function(label, type) {
  paste0(label, " (", type, ")")
}

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "stacked_barplot_by_disease"),
           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "consistency_bubble_by_disease"),
           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "sign_heatmap_by_disease"),
           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "integrated_across_disease"),
           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"),
           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Nature-style palette
dir_pal <- c(
  "Positive" = "#BC3C29",
  "Negative" = "#3C5488",
  "Zero"     = "#B09C85",
  "NA"       = "#D9D9D9"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) one clean row per disease_var + ASV
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sig_asv_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  filter(is.finite(p_adj_bh), p_adj_bh < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(disease_var, ASV, p_adj_bh, desc(abs(mean_delta_prev))) %>%
  group_by(disease_var, ASV) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    disease_var, disease_label, ASV,
    mean_delta_prev, median_delta_prev, p_adj_bh,
    any_of("n_testable_villages")
  ) %>%
  left_join(anno_map, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    plot_label_bubble = make_plot_label_bubble(label),
    plot_label_typed  = make_plot_label_typed(label, type)
  )

bad_sig <- sig_asv_tbl %>%
  count(disease_var, ASV) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
stopifnot(nrow(bad_sig) == 0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) one clean row per disease_var + ASV + vil_id
# ---------------------------------------------------------
keep_cols <- c("disease_var", "disease_label", "ASV", "vil_id", "delta_prev")
extra_cols <- c(prev_yes_col, prev_no_col, testable_col)
extra_cols <- extra_cols[!is.null(extra_cols)]

village_delta_tbl <- asv_village_tbl_all %>%
  semi_join(sig_asv_tbl %>% select(disease_var, ASV), by = c("disease_var", "ASV")) %>%
  arrange(disease_var, ASV, vil_id) %>%
  group_by(disease_var, ASV, vil_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(any_of(c(keep_cols, extra_cols))) %>%
  left_join(anno_map, by = "ASV")

# ---- derive helper vectors safely outside mutate ----
if (!is.null(prev_yes_col)) {
  prev_yes_vec <- village_delta_tbl[[prev_yes_col]]
} else {
  prev_yes_vec <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(village_delta_tbl))
}

if (!is.null(prev_no_col)) {
  prev_no_vec <- village_delta_tbl[[prev_no_col]]
} else {
  prev_no_vec <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(village_delta_tbl))
}

if (!is.null(testable_col)) {
  comparable_vec <- as.logical(village_delta_tbl[[testable_col]])
} else if (!is.null(prev_yes_col) && !is.null(prev_no_col)) {
  comparable_vec <- is.finite(prev_yes_vec) & is.finite(prev_no_vec)
} else {
  comparable_vec <- is.finite(village_delta_tbl$delta_prev)
}

if (!is.null(prev_yes_col) && !is.null(prev_no_col)) {
  both_zero_vec <- comparable_vec &
    is.finite(prev_yes_vec) & is.finite(prev_no_vec) &
    prev_yes_vec == 0 & prev_no_vec == 0
} else {
  both_zero_vec <- rep(FALSE, nrow(village_delta_tbl))
}

village_delta_tbl <- village_delta_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    plot_label_bubble = make_plot_label_bubble(label),
    plot_label_typed  = make_plot_label_typed(label, type),
    prev_yes_use = prev_yes_vec,
    prev_no_use  = prev_no_vec,
    comparable_flag = comparable_vec,
    both_zero = both_zero_vec,
    dir_cat = case_when(
      !comparable_flag ~ "NA",
      both_zero ~ "NA",
      is.na(delta_prev) ~ "NA",
      delta_prev > 0 ~ "Positive",
      delta_prev < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "Zero"
    )
  )

bad_vil <- village_delta_tbl %>%
  count(disease_var, ASV, vil_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
stopifnot(nrow(bad_vil) == 0)

# full village order
all_vil_levels <- asv_village_tbl_all %>%
  distinct(vil_id) %>%
  mutate(vil_num = suppressWarnings(parse_number(as.character(vil_id)))) %>%
  arrange(is.na(vil_num), vil_num, vil_id) %>%
  pull(vil_id)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) consistency summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
consistency_tbl <- village_delta_tbl %>%
  group_by(
    disease_var, disease_label, ASV,
    label, type, plot_label_bubble, plot_label_typed
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pos  = sum(dir_cat == "Positive"),
    n_neg  = sum(dir_cat == "Negative"),
    n_zero = sum(dir_cat == "Zero"),
    n_na   = sum(dir_cat == "NA"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_nonzero = n_pos + n_neg,
    majority_n = pmax(n_pos, n_neg),
    consistency_ratio = ifelse(n_nonzero > 0, majority_n / n_nonzero, NA_real_),
    signed_consistency = ifelse(n_nonzero > 0, (n_pos - n_neg) / n_nonzero, NA_real_),
    majority_dir = case_when(
      n_pos > n_neg ~ "Positive",
      n_neg > n_pos ~ "Negative",
      n_nonzero == 0 ~ "No nonzero",
      TRUE ~ "Tie"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sig_asv_tbl,
    by = c(
      "disease_var", "disease_label", "ASV",
      "label", "type", "plot_label_bubble", "plot_label_typed"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(disease_var, p_adj_bh, desc(abs(mean_delta_prev)))

write_csv(
  consistency_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_within_village_consistency_overview.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) long table for stacked barplot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stack_tbl <- consistency_tbl %>%
  select(
    disease_var, disease_label, ASV, label, type, plot_label_typed,
    mean_delta_prev, signed_consistency,
    n_pos, n_neg, n_zero, n_na
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_pos, n_neg, n_zero, n_na),
    names_to = "dir_cat",
    values_to = "n_villages"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dir_cat = recode(
      dir_cat,
      n_pos = "Positive",
      n_neg = "Negative",
      n_zero = "Zero",
      n_na = "NA"
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) disease-specific plotting functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_stacked_barplot <- function(target_disease_var) {
  ord <- consistency_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == target_disease_var) %>%
    arrange(signed_consistency, mean_delta_prev) %>%
    pull(plot_label_typed) %>%
    unique()

  plot_df <- stack_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == target_disease_var) %>%
    mutate(
      plot_label_typed = factor(plot_label_typed, levels = ord),
      dir_cat = factor(dir_cat, levels = c("NA", "Zero", "Negative", "Positive"))
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = n_villages, y = plot_label_typed, fill = dir_cat)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = dir_pal,
      breaks = c("Positive", "Negative", "Zero", "NA")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of villages",
      y = NULL,
      title = paste0("Direction consistency of significant ASVs: ", unique(plot_df$disease_label)),
      subtitle = "Bars show how many villages had disease > control, disease < control, zero, or unavailable differences.",
      fill = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)
    )
}

make_consistency_bubble <- function(target_disease_var) {
  plot_df <- consistency_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == target_disease_var) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_delta_prev), label) %>%
    mutate(
      plot_label_bubble = factor(plot_label_bubble, levels = rev(unique(plot_label_bubble)))
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = mean_delta_prev, y = plot_label_bubble)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = consistency_ratio, shape = type),
      size = 3.0,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colours = c("#E6E6E6", "#C6DBEF", "#6BAED6", "#3182BD", "#08519C"),
      limits = c(0.5, 1.0),
      breaks = c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0),
      oob = squish
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Mean within-village prevalence difference (disease yes - disease no)",
      y = NULL,
      color = "Consistency\nratio",
      shape = "Type",
      title = paste0("Effect size and direction consistency: ", unique(plot_df$disease_label)),
      subtitle = "Rows are ordered by descending mean within-village prevalence difference."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)
    )
}

make_sign_heatmap <- function(target_disease_var) {
  ord_asv <- consistency_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == target_disease_var) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(mean_delta_prev))) %>%
    pull(plot_label_typed) %>%
    unique()

  plot_df <- village_delta_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == target_disease_var) %>%
    select(plot_label_typed, vil_id, dir_cat) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      plot_label_typed = ord_asv,
      vil_id = all_vil_levels,
      fill = list(dir_cat = "NA")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      plot_label_typed = factor(plot_label_typed, levels = rev(ord_asv)),
      vil_id = factor(vil_id, levels = all_vil_levels),
      dir_cat = factor(dir_cat, levels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Zero", "NA"))
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = vil_id, y = plot_label_typed, fill = dir_cat)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = dir_pal,
      breaks = c("Positive", "Negative", "Zero", "NA")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Village ID",
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Direction",
      title = paste0("Village-level direction map: ", target_disease_var),
      subtitle = "Red = disease > control, Blue = disease < control, brown-gray = zero, light gray = unavailable."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) draw disease-specific plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_vars_to_plot <- consistency_tbl %>%
  distinct(disease_var) %>%
  pull(disease_var)

for (dv in disease_vars_to_plot) {
  n_asv <- consistency_tbl %>%
    filter(disease_var == dv) %>%
    nrow()

  n_vil <- length(all_vil_levels)

  p1 <- make_stacked_barplot(dv)
  if (!is.null(p1)) {
    save_plot_both(
      p1,
      file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "stacked_barplot_by_disease", paste0("stacked_barplot_", dv)),
      width = 10,
      height = min(18, max(4.5, 0.28 * n_asv))
    )
  }

  p2 <- make_consistency_bubble(dv)
  if (!is.null(p2)) {
    save_plot_both(
      p2,
      file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "consistency_bubble_by_disease", paste0("consistency_bubble_", dv)),
      width = 10,
      height = min(18, max(4.5, 0.28 * n_asv))
    )
  }

  p3 <- make_sign_heatmap(dv)
  if (!is.null(p3)) {
    save_plot_both(
      p3,
      file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "sign_heatmap_by_disease", paste0("sign_heatmap_", dv)),
      width = min(18, max(8, 0.15 * n_vil)),
      height = min(18, max(4.5, 0.24 * n_asv))
    )
  }
}

# objects needed for chunk 2
consistency_tbl_all <- consistency_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    disease_plot_label_bubble = paste0(disease_label, " | ", plot_label_bubble),
    disease_plot_label_typed  = paste0(disease_label, " | ", plot_label_typed)
  )

stack_tbl_all <- stack_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    disease_plot_label_typed = paste0(disease_label, " | ", plot_label_typed)
  )

village_delta_tbl_all2 <- village_delta_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    disease_plot_label_typed = paste0(disease_label, " | ", plot_label_typed)
  )

message("DONE: chunk 1 finished.")
message("Created objects for chunk 2:")
message(" - consistency_tbl_all")
message(" - stack_tbl_all")
message(" - village_delta_tbl_all2")
```

#sig_ASV by disease integrated
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
  library(tidyr)
})

# =========================================================
# CHUNK 2
# - integrated plots only
#
# Required objects from chunk 1:
#   consistency_tbl_all
#   stack_tbl_all
#   village_delta_tbl_all2
#   OUTDIR
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("consistency_tbl_all"))
stopifnot(exists("stack_tbl_all"))
stopifnot(exists("village_delta_tbl_all2"))
stopifnot(exists("OUTDIR"))

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "integrated_across_disease"),
           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

dir_pal <- c(
  "Positive" = "#BC3C29",
  "Negative" = "#3C5488",
  "Zero"     = "#B09C85",
  "NA"       = "#D9D9D9"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) row order
# same disease grouped together > x value descending
# ---------------------------------------------------------
row_order_tbl <- consistency_tbl_all %>%
  arrange(disease_label, desc(mean_delta_prev), label) %>%
  distinct(disease_plot_label_typed, disease_plot_label_bubble, .keep_all = TRUE)

row_levels_typed  <- rev(row_order_tbl$disease_plot_label_typed)
row_levels_bubble <- rev(row_order_tbl$disease_plot_label_bubble)

# global village order
vil_levels_all <- village_delta_tbl_all2 %>%
  distinct(vil_id) %>%
  mutate(
    vil_num = suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(vil_id)))
  ) %>%
  arrange(is.na(vil_num), vil_num, vil_id) %>%
  pull(vil_id)

write_csv(
  row_order_tbl %>%
    select(
      disease_var, disease_label,
      ASV, label, type,
      disease_plot_label_typed, disease_plot_label_bubble,
      mean_delta_prev, median_delta_prev, p_adj_bh,
      n_pos, n_neg, n_zero, n_na,
      n_nonzero, majority_n, consistency_ratio,
      signed_consistency, majority_dir
    ),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_integrated_plot_order.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) integrated stacked barplot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_stacked_barplot_all <- function() {
  plot_df <- stack_tbl_all %>%
    mutate(
      disease_plot_label_typed = factor(disease_plot_label_typed, levels = row_levels_typed),
      dir_cat = factor(dir_cat, levels = c("NA", "Zero", "Negative", "Positive"))
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = n_villages, y = disease_plot_label_typed, fill = dir_cat)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = dir_pal,
      breaks = c("Positive", "Negative", "Zero", "NA")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 92),
      breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 92),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of villages",
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Direction",
      title = "Direction consistency of significant ASVs across diseases",
      subtitle = "Each row is a disease-ASV pair. Bars show how many villages had disease > control, disease < control, zero, or unavailable differences."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) integrated consistency bubble plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_consistency_bubble_all <- function() {
  plot_df <- consistency_tbl_all %>%
    arrange(disease_label, desc(mean_delta_prev), label) %>%
    mutate(
      disease_plot_label_bubble = factor(disease_plot_label_bubble, levels = row_levels_bubble)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = mean_delta_prev, y = disease_plot_label_bubble)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = consistency_ratio, shape = type),
      size = 2.8,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colours = c("#E6E6E6", "#C6DBEF", "#6BAED6", "#3182BD", "#08519C"),
      limits = c(0.5, 1.0),
      breaks = c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0),
      oob = squish
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(
        "global core" = 16,
        "village_enriched" = 17
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Mean within-village prevalence difference (disease yes - disease no)",
      y = NULL,
      color = "Consistency\nratio",
      shape = "Type",
      title = "Effect size and direction consistency across diseases",
      subtitle = "Rows are grouped by disease and ordered by descending mean within-village prevalence difference."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) integrated sign heatmap
#    IMPORTANT:
#    - no complete()
#    - non-target villages remain empty
#    - only target villages with dir_cat are drawn
#    - add full grid lines across the heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_sign_heatmap_all <- function() {
  plot_df <- village_delta_tbl_all2 %>%
    select(disease_plot_label_typed, vil_id, dir_cat) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(
      disease_plot_label_typed = factor(disease_plot_label_typed, levels = row_levels_typed),
      vil_id = factor(vil_id, levels = vil_levels_all),
      dir_cat = factor(dir_cat, levels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Zero", "NA"))
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  nx <- length(vil_levels_all)
  ny <- length(row_levels_typed)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = vil_id, y = disease_plot_label_typed, fill = dir_cat)) +
    geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1, color = NA) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = seq(0.5, nx + 0.5, by = 1),
      color = "grey85",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = seq(0.5, ny + 0.5, by = 1),
      color = "grey85",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = dir_pal,
      breaks = c("Positive", "Negative", "Zero", "NA"),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      x = "Village ID",
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Direction",
      title = "Village-level direction map across diseases",
      subtitle = "Blank cells indicate villages not included in the disease-specific comparison for that ASV. Red = disease > control, Blue = disease < control, brown-gray = zero, light gray = unavailable."
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) draw and save integrated plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
n_rows_all <- consistency_tbl_all %>%
  distinct(disease_plot_label_typed) %>%
  nrow()

n_vil_all <- length(vil_levels_all)

p_all_stack <- make_stacked_barplot_all()
if (!is.null(p_all_stack)) {
  save_plot_both(
    p_all_stack,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "integrated_across_disease", "stacked_barplot_all_diseases"),
    width = 12,
    height = min(40, max(8, 0.22 * n_rows_all))
  )
}

p_all_bubble <- make_consistency_bubble_all()
if (!is.null(p_all_bubble)) {
  save_plot_both(
    p_all_bubble,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "integrated_across_disease", "consistency_bubble_all_diseases"),
    width = 12,
    height = min(40, max(8, 0.22 * n_rows_all))
  )
}

p_all_heatmap <- make_sign_heatmap_all()
if (!is.null(p_all_heatmap)) {
  save_plot_both(
    p_all_heatmap,
    file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "integrated_across_disease", "sign_heatmap_all_diseases"),
    width = min(28, max(12, 0.18 * n_vil_all)),
    height = min(45, max(8, 0.18 * n_rows_all))
  )
}

message("DONE: chunk 2 finished.")
message("Integrated plots saved under:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "integrated_across_disease"))
```

#significant disease-ASV bipartite network
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
})

# =========================================================
# Significant disease-ASV bipartite network
# - ASVs are grouped by their primary disease
# - disease nodes are vertically spread out more
#
# Required objects:
#   asv_assoc_tbl
#   OUTDIR
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("asv_assoc_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("OUTDIR"))

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "network"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) significant disease-ASV pairs
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sig_edge_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  filter(
    if ("sig" %in% names(.)) sig == "sig" else (is.finite(p_adj_bh) & p_adj_bh < 0.05)
  ) %>%
  select(
    disease_var, disease_label,
    ASV, label, type,
    mean_delta_prev, p_adj_bh
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      mean_delta_prev > 0 ~ "Positive",
      mean_delta_prev < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "Zero"
    ),
    effect_abs = abs(mean_delta_prev),
    sig_strength = -log10(pmax(p_adj_bh, 1e-300))
  ) %>%
  filter(direction != "Zero")

if (nrow(sig_edge_tbl) == 0) {
  stop("No BH-significant disease-ASV pairs were found.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) disease base table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_nodes_base <- sig_edge_tbl %>%
  count(disease_label, name = "degree") %>%
  arrange(desc(degree), disease_label) %>%
  mutate(disease_order = row_number())

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) define primary disease for each ASV
#    = disease with largest absolute effect
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_primary_tbl <- sig_edge_tbl %>%
  left_join(
    disease_nodes_base %>% select(disease_label, disease_order),
    by = "disease_label"
  ) %>%
  arrange(ASV, desc(effect_abs), p_adj_bh, disease_order) %>%
  group_by(ASV, label, type) %>%
  summarise(
    degree = n(),
    n_diseases = n_distinct(disease_label),
    mean_abs_effect = mean(effect_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    primary_disease = first(disease_label),
    primary_disease_order = first(disease_order),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) ASV node ordering
#    group by primary disease, then within group sort neatly
# ---------------------------------------------------------
gap_between_groups <- 2

asv_nodes_tmp <- asv_primary_tbl %>%
  arrange(
    primary_disease_order,
    n_diseases,                 # disease-specific first, then shared ASVs
    desc(degree),
    desc(mean_abs_effect),
    type,
    label
  )

group_tbl <- asv_nodes_tmp %>%
  count(primary_disease_order, primary_disease, name = "n_asv") %>%
  arrange(primary_disease_order) %>%
  mutate(
    block_start = cumsum(lag(n_asv + gap_between_groups, default = 0))
  )

asv_nodes <- asv_nodes_tmp %>%
  left_join(
    group_tbl %>% select(primary_disease_order, block_start),
    by = "primary_disease_order"
  ) %>%
  group_by(primary_disease_order) %>%
  mutate(
    within_group_rank = row_number(),
    y_raw = block_start + within_group_rank - 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

max_y_raw <- max(asv_nodes$y_raw)

asv_nodes <- asv_nodes %>%
  mutate(
    x = 1,
    y = max_y_raw - y_raw + 1
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) disease node positions
#    first anchor by median connected ASV y
#    then spread evenly while preserving order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_anchor_tbl <- sig_edge_tbl %>%
  left_join(
    asv_nodes %>% select(ASV, y_asv = y),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  group_by(disease_label) %>%
  summarise(
    y_anchor = median(y_asv, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

disease_nodes <- disease_nodes_base %>%
  left_join(disease_anchor_tbl, by = "disease_label") %>%
  arrange(desc(y_anchor), disease_label) %>%
  mutate(
    x = 0,
    y = seq(from = max(asv_nodes$y), to = min(asv_nodes$y), length.out = n())
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) edge positions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
edge_plot_df <- sig_edge_tbl %>%
  left_join(
    disease_nodes %>%
      select(disease_label, x_disease = x, y_disease = y, disease_degree = degree),
    by = "disease_label"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    asv_nodes %>%
      select(ASV, x_asv = x, y_asv = y, asv_degree = degree),
    by = "ASV"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    edge_size = rescale(effect_abs, to = c(0.4, 1.8)),
    edge_alpha = rescale(sig_strength, to = c(0.35, 0.95))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) save tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(edge_plot_df, file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_asv_network_edges.csv"))
write_csv(disease_nodes, file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_asv_network_disease_nodes.csv"))
write_csv(asv_nodes, file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_asv_network_asv_nodes.csv"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) palettes
# ---------------------------------------------------------
dir_pal <- c(
  "Positive" = "#BC3C29",  # disease-enriched
  "Negative" = "#3C5488"   # control-enriched
)

type_pal <- c(
  "global core" = "#4DBBD5",
  "village_enriched" = "#E64B35"
)

type_shape <- c(
  "global core" = 21,
  "village_enriched" = 24
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_net <- ggplot() +
  # edges
  geom_segment(
    data = edge_plot_df,
    aes(
      x = x_disease, y = y_disease,
      xend = x_asv, yend = y_asv,
      color = direction,
      linewidth = edge_size,
      alpha = edge_alpha
    ),
    lineend = "round"
  ) +

  # disease nodes
  geom_point(
    data = disease_nodes,
    aes(x = x, y = y, size = degree),
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 0.4,
    fill = "grey35",
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # ASV nodes
  geom_point(
    data = asv_nodes,
    aes(x = x, y = y, shape = type, fill = type, size = degree),
    stroke = 0.4,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # disease labels
  geom_text(
    data = disease_nodes,
    aes(x = x - 0.04, y = y, label = disease_label),
    hjust = 1,
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  # ASV labels
  geom_text(
    data = asv_nodes,
    aes(x = x + 0.04, y = y, label = label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 2.8
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = dir_pal,
    breaks = c("Positive", "Negative")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = type_pal,
    breaks = c("global core", "village_enriched")
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = type_shape,
    breaks = c("global core", "village_enriched")
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(2.5, 6)
  ) +
  scale_linewidth_identity() +
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(-0.42, 1.52),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Network of BH-significant disease-ASV associations",
    subtitle = "Edges connect diseases and ASVs with BH-adjusted P < 0.05. Red = disease-enriched, blue = control-enriched.",
    color = "Direction",
    shape = "ASV type",
    fill = "ASV type",
    size = "Node degree"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 150, 15, 150),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none",
    shape = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        size = 4,
        fill = unname(type_pal),
        color = "black"
      )
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) save
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_height <- max(6, 0.25 * max(nrow(disease_nodes), nrow(asv_nodes)))

save_plot_both(
  p_net,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "network", "disease_asv_bipartite_network_all_sig"),
  width = 14,
  height = min(28, plot_height)
)

message("DONE: disease-ASV bipartite network saved.")
message("Plot:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "network", "disease_asv_bipartite_network_all_sig"))
message("Tables:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_asv_network_edges.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_asv_network_disease_nodes.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_asv_network_asv_nodes.csv"))
```

#disease level summary of significant ASVs
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(forcats)
  library(purrr)
  library(scales)
})

# =========================================================
# Disease-level summary of significant ASVs
#
# Required object:
#   consistency_tbl
#
# Optional:
#   OUTDIR
#
# Output:
#   tables/
#     - disease_direction_summary_table.csv
#     - disease_direction_summary_long_for_plot.csv
#     - disease_asv_level_direction_table.csv
#
#   plots/
#     - disease_direction_summary_100pct.png/.svg
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("consistency_tbl"))

if (!exists("OUTDIR")) {
  OUTDIR <- "sharing_asv_disease_association_ver.2"
}

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  # PNG
  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  # SVG
  if ("showtext" %in% loadedNamespaces()) {
    showtext::showtext_auto(FALSE)
    on.exit(showtext::showtext_auto(TRUE), add = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

fmt_p <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    "NA",
    format.pval(x, digits = 2, eps = 1e-300)
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) one row per disease-ASV
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_dir_tbl <- consistency_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    disease_var,
    disease_label,
    ASV,
    label,
    type,
    mean_delta_prev,
    median_delta_prev,
    p_adj_bh,
    n_pos,
    n_neg,
    n_zero,
    n_na,
    n_nonzero = n_pos + n_neg,
    pos_frac = ifelse(n_nonzero > 0, n_pos / n_nonzero, NA_real_),
    neg_frac = ifelse(n_nonzero > 0, n_neg / n_nonzero, NA_real_),
    majority_dir_asv = case_when(
      n_nonzero == 0 ~ NA_character_,
      n_pos > n_neg ~ "Positive",
      n_neg > n_pos ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "Tie"
    )
  )

write_csv(
  asv_dir_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_asv_level_direction_table.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) helper stats
# ---------------------------------------------------------
safe_sign_test_tbl <- function(x) {
  x2 <- x[!is.na(x) & x != "Tie"]
  n_testable <- length(x2)

  if (n_testable == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      n_asv_testable = 0,
      n_asv_pos_majority = 0,
      n_asv_neg_majority = 0,
      n_asv_tie = sum(x == "Tie", na.rm = TRUE),
      dominant_asv_direction = NA_character_,
      p_value_asv_sign = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  n_pos <- sum(x2 == "Positive")
  n_neg <- sum(x2 == "Negative")
  bt <- binom.test(n_pos, n_testable, p = 0.5)

  tibble(
    n_asv_testable = n_testable,
    n_asv_pos_majority = n_pos,
    n_asv_neg_majority = n_neg,
    n_asv_tie = sum(x == "Tie", na.rm = TRUE),
    dominant_asv_direction = case_when(
      n_pos > n_neg ~ "Positive",
      n_neg > n_pos ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "Tie"
    ),
    p_value_asv_sign = bt$p.value
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) disease-level summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_base_tbl <- asv_dir_tbl %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sig_asv = n(),
    sum_pos = sum(n_pos, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_neg = sum(n_neg, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_zero = sum(n_zero, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_na = sum(n_na, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

disease_sign_tbl <- asv_dir_tbl %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ safe_sign_test_tbl(.x$majority_dir_asv)) %>%
  ungroup()

disease_pooled_tbl <- disease_base_tbl %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    pooled_directional_total = sum_pos + sum_neg,
    pooled_positive_pct = ifelse(
      pooled_directional_total > 0,
      100 * sum_pos / pooled_directional_total,
      NA_real_
    ),
    pooled_negative_pct = ifelse(
      pooled_directional_total > 0,
      100 * sum_neg / pooled_directional_total,
      NA_real_
    ),
    dominant_pooled_direction = case_when(
      pooled_directional_total == 0 ~ NA_character_,
      sum_pos > sum_neg ~ "Positive",
      sum_neg > sum_pos ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "Tie"
    ),
    p_value_pooled_binom = ifelse(
      pooled_directional_total > 0,
      binom.test(sum_pos, pooled_directional_total, p = 0.5)$p.value,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

disease_summary_tbl <- disease_base_tbl %>%
  left_join(disease_sign_tbl, by = c("disease_var", "disease_label")) %>%
  left_join(
    disease_pooled_tbl %>%
      select(
        disease_var, disease_label,
        pooled_directional_total,
        pooled_positive_pct,
        pooled_negative_pct,
        dominant_pooled_direction,
        p_value_pooled_binom
      ),
    by = c("disease_var", "disease_label")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_asv_sign_bh = p.adjust(p_value_asv_sign, method = "BH"),
    p_adj_pooled_binom_bh = p.adjust(p_value_pooled_binom, method = "BH"),
    balance_pct = pooled_positive_pct - pooled_negative_pct
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(balance_pct), disease_label)

write_csv(
  disease_summary_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_direction_summary_table.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) long table for 100% stacked bar plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_tbl <- disease_summary_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    disease_var,
    disease_label,
    n_sig_asv,
    pooled_directional_total,
    p_value_asv_sign,
    p_adj_asv_sign_bh,
    positive_pct = pooled_positive_pct,
    negative_pct = pooled_negative_pct,
    balance_pct
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label_plot = paste0(disease_label, " [ASV=", n_sig_asv, "]")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(balance_pct), disease_label) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label_plot = factor(disease_label_plot, levels = rev(unique(disease_label_plot)))
  )

plot_long <- plot_tbl %>%
  select(
    disease_var, disease_label_plot, n_sig_asv,
    pooled_directional_total,
    p_value_asv_sign, p_adj_asv_sign_bh,
    positive_pct, negative_pct
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(positive_pct, negative_pct),
    names_to = "direction",
    values_to = "percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = recode(
      direction,
      positive_pct = "Positive",
      negative_pct = "Negative"
    )
  )

write_csv(
  plot_long,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_direction_summary_long_for_plot.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) annotation table for plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
annot_tbl <- plot_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    annot_text = paste0(
      "n=", pooled_directional_total,
      " | raw p=", fmt_p(p_value_asv_sign),
      "\nFDR=", fmt_p(p_adj_asv_sign_bh)
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) colors
# ---------------------------------------------------------
dir_pal <- c(
  "Positive" = "#BC3C29",
  "Negative" = "#3C5488"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_sum <- ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = percent, y = disease_label_plot, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    data = annot_tbl,
    aes(
      x = 104,
      y = disease_label_plot,
      label = annot_text
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    lineheight = 0.95,
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dir_pal, breaks = c("Positive", "Negative")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 132),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    x = "Percent of directional village-ASV comparisons",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Direction",
    title = "Disease-level summary of significant ASV directions",
    subtitle = paste(
      "For each disease, counts of Positive and Negative directions were summed across BH-significant ASVs",
      "and converted to 100%. Positive = disease-enriched, Negative = control-enriched.",
      "Text at right shows directional comparison count, raw P, and BH-adjusted P from the ASV-level sign test."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 180, 12, 12)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_sum,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_direction_summary_100pct"),
  width = 16,
  height = max(6, 0.6 * nrow(plot_tbl))
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) optional compact console summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
message("DONE: disease-level summary plot created.")
message("Main plot:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_direction_summary_100pct.png"))
message("Main tables:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_direction_summary_table.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_direction_summary_long_for_plot.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_asv_level_direction_table.csv"))
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(forcats)
  library(scales)
})

# =========================================================
# Disease-level subtype summary of significant ASVs
# - subtype source fixed:
#     global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh + asv_subtype_tbl
# - subtype harmonized to: single / nearby / regional
# - disease order matched to disease_direction_summary_100pct
# - outputs both:
#     1) absolute count stacked bar
#     2) 100% stacked bar
#
# Required:
#   consistency_tbl
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#
# Optional:
#   OUTDIR
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("consistency_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh"))
stopifnot(exists("asv_subtype_tbl"))

if (!exists("OUTDIR")) {
  OUTDIR <- "sharing_asv_disease_association_ver.2"
}

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  if ("showtext" %in% loadedNamespaces()) {
    showtext::showtext_auto(FALSE)
    on.exit(showtext::showtext_auto(TRUE), add = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) subtype map fixed source
# ---------------------------------------------------------
core_subtype_map <- global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
  dplyr::select(ASV, subtype) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    subtype = case_when(
      subtype == "Single-peaked core" ~ "single",
      subtype == "Nearby-structured core" ~ "nearby",
      subtype == "Regional-structured core" ~ "regional",
      TRUE ~ subtype
    )
  )

village_subtype_map <- asv_subtype_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(ASV, subtype) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    subtype = case_when(
      subtype == "Single-village dominant" ~ "single",
      subtype == "Nearby-village sharing" ~ "nearby",
      subtype == "Regional sharing" ~ "regional",
      TRUE ~ subtype
    )
  )

subtype_map <- bind_rows(core_subtype_map, village_subtype_map) %>%
  distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

bad_subtype <- subtype_map %>%
  filter(!subtype %in% c("single", "nearby", "regional"))

if (nrow(bad_subtype) > 0) {
  warning("Some subtype values were not converted to single/nearby/regional.")
  print(unique(bad_subtype$subtype))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) disease order
#    match disease_direction_summary_100pct ordering
#    = same balance_pct logic from previous plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_order_tbl <- consistency_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    disease_var,
    disease_label,
    n_pos,
    n_neg,
    p_adj_bh
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sig_asv = n(),
    sum_pos = sum(n_pos, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_neg = sum(n_neg, na.rm = TRUE),
    pooled_directional_total = sum_pos + sum_neg,
    pooled_positive_pct = ifelse(pooled_directional_total > 0, 100 * sum_pos / pooled_directional_total, NA_real_),
    pooled_negative_pct = ifelse(pooled_directional_total > 0, 100 * sum_neg / pooled_directional_total, NA_real_),
    balance_pct = pooled_positive_pct - pooled_negative_pct,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(balance_pct), disease_label) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label_plot = paste0(disease_label, " [ASV=", n_sig_asv, "]")
  )

row_levels <- rev(disease_order_tbl$disease_label_plot)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) significant disease-ASV + subtype join
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sig_asv_subtype_tbl <- consistency_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(
    disease_var, disease_label,
    ASV, label, type,
    mean_delta_prev, median_delta_prev, p_adj_bh
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(subtype_map, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    disease_order_tbl %>% dplyr::select(disease_var, disease_label_plot, n_sig_asv),
    by = "disease_var"
  )

write_csv(
  sig_asv_subtype_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_sig_asv_subtype_table.csv")
)

unmatched_tbl <- sig_asv_subtype_tbl %>%
  filter(is.na(subtype))

if (nrow(unmatched_tbl) > 0) {
  message("WARNING: Some significant ASVs were not matched to subtype.")
  print(unmatched_tbl %>% dplyr::select(disease_label, ASV, label, type))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) disease x subtype summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_count_tbl <- sig_asv_subtype_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(subtype)) %>%
  count(disease_var, disease_label, disease_label_plot, n_sig_asv, subtype, name = "n_asv") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    disease_var,
    disease_label,
    disease_label_plot,
    n_sig_asv,
    subtype = factor(c("single", "nearby", "regional"),
                     levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional")),
    fill = list(n_asv = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label, disease_label_plot, n_sig_asv) %>%
  mutate(
    total_asv = sum(n_asv, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct = ifelse(total_asv > 0, 100 * n_asv / total_asv, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label_plot = factor(disease_label_plot, levels = row_levels),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("single", "nearby", "regional"))
  )

write_csv(
  subtype_count_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_sig_asv_subtype_count_table.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) palette
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_pal <- c(
  "single"   = "#1b9e77",
  "nearby"   = "#d95f02",
  "regional" = "#7570b3"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) annotation table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
annot_tbl <- disease_order_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label_plot = factor(disease_label_plot, levels = row_levels)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) absolute count version
# ---------------------------------------------------------
x_max_count <- max(annot_tbl$n_sig_asv, na.rm = TRUE)
annot_x_count <- x_max_count + max(1, round(x_max_count * 0.05))

p_subtype_count <- ggplot(
  subtype_count_tbl,
  aes(x = n_asv, y = disease_label_plot, fill = subtype)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    data = annot_tbl,
    aes(x = annot_x_count, y = disease_label_plot, label = paste0("n=", n_sig_asv)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = subtype_pal,
    breaks = c("single", "nearby", "regional")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, annot_x_count + max(1, round(x_max_count * 0.15))),
    breaks = pretty_breaks(),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of BH-significant ASVs",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Subtype",
    title = "Disease-level subtype composition of significant ASVs",
    subtitle = "Bars show absolute counts of BH-significant ASVs classified as single, nearby, or regional."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 80, 12, 12)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_subtype_count,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_sig_asv_subtype_stacked_count"),
  width = 12,
  height = max(6, 0.55 * nrow(disease_order_tbl))
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) percent version
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_subtype_pct <- ggplot(
  subtype_count_tbl,
  aes(x = pct, y = disease_label_plot, fill = subtype)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    data = annot_tbl,
    aes(x = 103, y = disease_label_plot, label = paste0("n=", n_sig_asv)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = subtype_pal,
    breaks = c("single", "nearby", "regional")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 110),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    x = "Percent of BH-significant ASVs",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Subtype",
    title = "Disease-level subtype composition of significant ASVs",
    subtitle = "Bars show the proportion of BH-significant ASVs classified as single, nearby, or regional."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 60, 12, 12)
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_subtype_pct,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_sig_asv_subtype_stacked_percent"),
  width = 12,
  height = max(6, 0.55 * nrow(disease_order_tbl))
)

message("DONE: disease subtype stacked plots created.")
message("Plots:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_sig_asv_subtype_stacked_count.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_sig_asv_subtype_stacked_percent.png"))
message("Tables:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_sig_asv_subtype_table.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_sig_asv_subtype_count_table.csv"))
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(forcats)
  library(scales)
})

# =========================================================
# Disease-level subtype composition of significant ASVs
# - diverging stacked bar plot
#   left  = Negative ASVs
#   right = Positive ASVs
#   fill  = subtype (single / nearby / regional)
#
# Required objects:
#   consistency_tbl
#   global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh
#   asv_subtype_tbl
#
# Optional:
#   OUTDIR
#
# Outputs:
#   tables/
#     - disease_asv_direction_subtype_table.csv
#     - disease_subtype_direction_summary_abs.csv
#     - disease_subtype_direction_summary_pct.csv
#
#   plots/
#     - disease_subtype_direction_diverging_abs.png/.svg
#     - disease_subtype_direction_diverging_pct.png/.svg
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("consistency_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh"))
stopifnot(exists("asv_subtype_tbl"))

if (!exists("OUTDIR")) {
  OUTDIR <- "sharing_asv_disease_association_ver.2"
}

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "plots"),  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save_plot_both <- function(plot_obj, base_path_no_ext, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  # PNG
  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".png"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  # SVG
  if ("showtext" %in% loadedNamespaces()) {
    showtext::showtext_auto(FALSE)
    on.exit(showtext::showtext_auto(TRUE), add = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    paste0(base_path_no_ext, ".svg"),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    bg = "white",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) subtype map from fixed source objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------
subtype_pal <- c(
  "single"   = "#1b9e77",
  "nearby"   = "#d95f02",
  "regional" = "#7570b3"
)

subtype_levels <- c("single", "nearby", "regional")

subtype_map <- bind_rows(
  global_core_subtype_tbl_veryHigh %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      subtype_raw = as.character(subtype),
      subtype_source = "global core"
    ),
  asv_subtype_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      ASV = as.character(ASV),
      subtype_raw = as.character(subtype),
      subtype_source = "village_enriched"
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    subtype = case_when(
      subtype_raw %in% c("Single-peaked core", "Single-village dominant") ~ "single",
      subtype_raw %in% c("Nearby-structured core", "Nearby-village sharing") ~ "nearby",
      subtype_raw %in% c("Regional-structured core", "Regional sharing") ~ "regional",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

dup_check <- subtype_map %>%
  distinct(ASV, subtype) %>%
  count(ASV, name = "n_subtype") %>%
  filter(n_subtype > 1)

if (nrow(dup_check) > 0) {
  stop("Some ASVs have conflicting subtype annotations across subtype source tables.")
}

subtype_map <- subtype_map %>%
  filter(!is.na(subtype)) %>%
  distinct(ASV, subtype, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(ASV, subtype)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) disease-ASV level table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
asv_dir_tbl <- consistency_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    disease_var,
    disease_label,
    ASV = as.character(ASV),
    label,
    type,
    p_adj_bh,
    mean_delta_prev,
    n_pos,
    n_neg,
    n_zero,
    n_na,
    majority_dir_asv = case_when(
      (n_pos + n_neg) == 0 ~ NA_character_,
      n_pos > n_neg ~ "Positive",
      n_neg > n_pos ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "Tie"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(subtype_map, by = "ASV")

unmatched_subtype_tbl <- asv_dir_tbl %>%
  filter(is.na(subtype)) %>%
  distinct(ASV, label, type)

write_csv(
  unmatched_subtype_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_subtype_unmatched_asvs.csv")
)

asv_dir_tbl2 <- asv_dir_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(subtype))

write_csv(
  asv_dir_tbl2,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_asv_direction_subtype_table.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) disease order
# ---------------------------------------------------------
disease_order_tbl <- consistency_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    disease_var,
    disease_label,
    n_pos,
    n_neg
  ) %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sig_asv = n(),
    sum_pos = sum(n_pos, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_neg = sum(n_neg, na.rm = TRUE),
    pooled_directional_total = sum_pos + sum_neg,
    pooled_positive_pct = ifelse(pooled_directional_total > 0, 100 * sum_pos / pooled_directional_total, NA_real_),
    pooled_negative_pct = ifelse(pooled_directional_total > 0, 100 * sum_neg / pooled_directional_total, NA_real_),
    balance_pct = pooled_positive_pct - pooled_negative_pct,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(balance_pct), disease_label) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label_plot = paste0(disease_label, " [ASV=", n_sig_asv, "]")
  )

disease_levels <- rev(disease_order_tbl$disease_label_plot)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) summary table: absolute count
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_abs <- asv_dir_tbl2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(majority_dir_asv), majority_dir_asv %in% c("Positive", "Negative")) %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label, majority_dir_asv, subtype) %>%
  summarise(
    n_asv = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_abs_complete <- summary_abs %>%
  complete(
    disease_var,
    disease_label,
    majority_dir_asv = factor(c("Negative", "Positive"), levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
    subtype = factor(subtype_levels, levels = subtype_levels),
    fill = list(n_asv = 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    disease_order_tbl %>%
      select(disease_var, disease_label, disease_label_plot, n_sig_asv),
    by = c("disease_var", "disease_label")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(disease_label_plot)) %>%
  mutate(
    disease_label_plot = factor(disease_label_plot, levels = disease_levels),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = subtype_levels),
    majority_dir_asv = factor(majority_dir_asv, levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
    n_plot = ifelse(majority_dir_asv == "Negative", -n_asv, n_asv)
  )

write_csv(
  summary_abs_complete %>%
    mutate(
      subtype = as.character(subtype),
      majority_dir_asv = as.character(majority_dir_asv),
      disease_label_plot = as.character(disease_label_plot)
    ),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_subtype_direction_summary_abs.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) summary table: percentage version
# ---------------------------------------------------------
summary_pct <- summary_abs_complete %>%
  group_by(disease_var, disease_label, disease_label_plot, n_sig_asv) %>%
  mutate(
    total_classifiable_asv = sum(abs(n_plot), na.rm = TRUE),
    pct = ifelse(total_classifiable_asv > 0, 100 * n_asv / total_classifiable_asv, 0),
    pct_plot = ifelse(majority_dir_asv == "Negative", -pct, pct)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(
  summary_pct %>%
    mutate(
      subtype = as.character(subtype),
      majority_dir_asv = as.character(majority_dir_asv),
      disease_label_plot = as.character(disease_label_plot)
    ),
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_subtype_direction_summary_pct.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) plot: absolute count version
# ---------------------------------------------------------
max_abs_n <- max(abs(summary_abs_complete$n_plot), na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(max_abs_n)) max_abs_n <- 1

p_abs <- ggplot(
  summary_abs_complete %>% filter(!is.na(disease_label_plot)),
  aes(x = n_plot, y = disease_label_plot, fill = subtype)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = subtype_pal,
    breaks = subtype_levels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of significant ASVs",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Subtype",
    title = "Disease-specific subtype composition of significant ASVs",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Left = Negative ASVs (control-enriched), Right = Positive ASVs (disease-enriched).",
      "Bars are subdivided by ASV spatial subtype."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_abs,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_subtype_direction_diverging_abs"),
  width = 12,
  height = max(6, 0.55 * nrow(disease_order_tbl))
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) plot: percentage version
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_pct <- ggplot(
  summary_pct %>% filter(!is.na(disease_label_plot)),
  aes(x = pct_plot, y = disease_label_plot, fill = subtype)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = subtype_pal,
    breaks = subtype_levels,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%"),
    breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Percent of classifiable significant ASVs",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Subtype",
    title = "Disease-specific subtype composition of significant ASVs",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Left = Negative ASVs (control-enriched), Right = Positive ASVs (disease-enriched).",
      "Percentages are calculated within each disease using classifiable ASVs only."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

save_plot_both(
  p_pct,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_subtype_direction_diverging_pct"),
  width = 12,
  height = max(6, 0.55 * nrow(disease_order_tbl))
)

message("DONE: disease subtype diverging plots created.")
message("Plots:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_subtype_direction_diverging_abs.png"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "plots", "disease_subtype_direction_diverging_pct.png"))
message("Tables:")
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_asv_direction_subtype_table.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_subtype_direction_summary_abs.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_subtype_direction_summary_pct.csv"))
message(" - ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "disease_subtype_unmatched_asvs.csv"))
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
})

# =========================================================
# Recurrent taxa with same disease-association direction
# - Uses significant disease-ASV pairs only
# - Groups ASVs by the lowest available taxonomic rank
# - Keeps taxa appearing in >= 2 diseases with the same direction
#
# Required:
#   asv_assoc_tbl
#   OUTDIR
# =========================================================

stopifnot(exists("asv_assoc_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("OUTDIR"))

dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Helper: lowest available taxon
# ---------------------------------------------------------
extract_rank_token <- function(x, prefix) {
  stringr::str_extract(as.character(x), paste0(prefix, "[^|;[:space:]]+"))
}

clean_taxon_token <- function(token) {
  token <- as.character(token)
  token <- stringr::str_replace(token, "^g__", "")
  token <- stringr::str_replace(token, "^f__", "f__")
  token <- stringr::str_replace(token, "^o__", "o__")
  token <- stringr::str_replace(token, "^c__", "c__")
  token <- stringr::str_replace(token, "^p__", "p__")
  token <- stringr::str_replace(token, "^d__", "d__")
  stringr::str_squish(token)
}

extract_lowest_taxon <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  genus  <- extract_rank_token(x, "g__")
  family <- extract_rank_token(x, "f__")
  order  <- extract_rank_token(x, "o__")
  class  <- extract_rank_token(x, "c__")
  phylum <- extract_rank_token(x, "p__")
  domain <- extract_rank_token(x, "d__")

  taxon_raw <- dplyr::coalesce(genus, family, order, class, phylum, domain, x)

  taxon_rank <- dplyr::case_when(
    !is.na(genus)  ~ "Genus",
    !is.na(family) ~ "Family",
    !is.na(order)  ~ "Order",
    !is.na(class)  ~ "Class",
    !is.na(phylum) ~ "Phylum",
    !is.na(domain) ~ "Domain",
    TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
  )

  tibble(
    taxon_label = clean_taxon_token(taxon_raw),
    taxon_rank = taxon_rank
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Attach taxon annotation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
taxon_anno_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  distinct(ASV, label) %>%
  arrange(ASV) %>%
  bind_cols(extract_lowest_taxon(.$label))

sig_taxon_tbl <- asv_assoc_tbl %>%
  filter(sig == "sig") %>%
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      mean_delta_prev > 0 ~ "Disease-enriched",
      mean_delta_prev < 0 ~ "Control-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "Zero"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(direction %in% c("Disease-enriched", "Control-enriched")) %>%
  left_join(taxon_anno_tbl, by = c("ASV", "label"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Simple recurrent taxon summary
#    Same taxon + same direction across multiple diseases
# ---------------------------------------------------------
recurrent_taxa_same_direction <- sig_taxon_tbl %>%
  group_by(taxon_label, taxon_rank, direction) %>%
  summarise(
    n_diseases = n_distinct(disease_label),
    diseases = paste(sort(unique(disease_label)), collapse = "; "),
    n_disease_asv_pairs = n(),
    n_asvs = n_distinct(ASV),
    asvs = paste(sort(unique(ASV)), collapse = "; "),
    types = paste(sort(unique(type)), collapse = "; "),
    n_global_core_pairs = sum(type == "global core", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_village_enriched_pairs = sum(type == "village_enriched", na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_delta_prev = mean(mean_delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_delta_prev = median(mean_delta_prev, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_padj = min(p_adj_bh, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_diseases >= 2) %>%
  arrange(direction, desc(n_diseases), desc(n_disease_asv_pairs), min_padj)

write_csv(
  recurrent_taxa_same_direction,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_disease_recurrent_taxa_same_direction.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Genus-only version
# ---------------------------------------------------------
recurrent_genera_same_direction <- recurrent_taxa_same_direction %>%
  filter(taxon_rank == "Genus") %>%
  arrange(direction, desc(n_diseases), desc(n_disease_asv_pairs), min_padj)

write_csv(
  recurrent_genera_same_direction,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_disease_recurrent_genera_same_direction.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Print quick inspection tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("\nRecurrent taxa with same direction across >=2 diseases:\n")
print(recurrent_taxa_same_direction)

cat("\nRecurrent genera with same direction across >=2 diseases:\n")
print(recurrent_genera_same_direction)

cat("\nSaved:\n")
cat("- ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_disease_recurrent_taxa_same_direction.csv"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", file.path(OUTDIR, "tables", "sharing_asv_disease_recurrent_genera_same_direction.csv"), "\n", sep = "")
```
